jobs.title: New Product Development Lead - Foods
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Vitalpro Consumer Pvt Ltd is an emerging leader in India’s hospitality and food and beverage sector, known for its innovative and quality-driven approach. The company builds beloved brands such as Saffron & Mishri, which reimagines traditional Indian mithai, and 224 Craftery, which blends global chocolate-making craft with flavors tailored to Indian tastes. Vitalpro focuses on creating memorable culinary experiences that balance tradition with modernity, backed by data-driven insights, precision marketing, and hyper-personalized engagement. With a strong emphasis on creativity, excellence, and people development, the company aims to transform India’s food culture while offering team members a growth-oriented, purpose-led career journey.

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Business Head

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Innovation & Concept Development

* Drive the end-to-end new product development pipeline across food categories.
* Identify emerging consumer trends, consumption occasions and product opportunities.
* Develop innovative concepts across mithai, confectionery, chocolates, snacks and other food categories.
* Experiment with new ingredients, flavours, textures, formats and processing techniques.
* Develop differentiated products combining Indian food heritage with contemporary tastes and formats.
* Create product concepts aligned with brand positioning and consumer expectations.

2. Formulation & Product Development

* Lead product formulation, ingredient selection and recipe development.
* Conduct kitchen and laboratory trials to optimise taste, texture, appearance and overall product experience.
* Work on sugar reduction, ingredient optimisation, nutritional profiles and shelf-life enhancement.
* Explore new ingredients, functional ingredients and food technologies.
* Develop alternatives to existing formulations wherever required.
* Ensure products meet applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Translate prototype formulations into scalable commercial products.
* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.
* Work towards improving product economics through formulation and process optimisation.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.
* Experience working in FMCG, food manufacturing, confectionery or packaged foods preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful new product launches.
* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

A food innovator who combines the mind of a food scientist with the creativity of a product developer and the execution mindset of an FMCG professional.

Someone who is passionate about food, constantly curious about ingredients and technologies, and capable of converting exciting ideas into differentiated, scalable and commercially successful products.

jobs.title: Senior cosmetic formulator
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are establishing a new cosmetic manufacturing facility in Noida and are looking for an experienced
**Cosmetic Formulator and R&D Leader**
to build and lead our formulation and product development team.

We are looking for someone who has hands-on industry experience in cosmetic formulation, with a proven track record of developing products that have successfully gone to market. The ideal candidate should have experience working with existing commercial SKUs, understand the entire product development cycle, and possess the technical creativity to develop innovative, high-performance formulations rather than simply replicate existing products.

This role will be responsible for building our formulation capabilities from the ground up, developing new product formulations, optimizing existing formulations, establishing laboratory processes, and leading a team of chemists to create differentiated cosmetic products.

Key Responsibilities1. Formulation Development & Innovation

* Develop innovative, high-performance formulations across skincare, haircare, body care and other cosmetic categories.
* Create unique formulations with differentiated textures, sensory experiences, ingredient combinations and performance benefits.
* Develop products inspired by global market trends while creating original formulations with a distinct competitive advantage.
* Formulate creams, serums, gels, lotions, sunscreens, cleansers, toners, emulsions, masks and other cosmetic products.
* Work with advanced active ingredients, functional ingredients, delivery systems, emulsifiers, preservatives and rheology modifiers.
* Troubleshoot formulation challenges and continuously improve stability, efficacy, aesthetics and product performance.

2. Commercial Product & Market Experience

* Bring practical experience with cosmetic products that have already been commercialized and are available in the market.
* Understand the journey from laboratory formulation to pilot batch, manufacturing scale-up and commercial production.
* Develop formulations that are commercially viable, scalable, stable and cost-effective.
* Evaluate competing products, ingredient technologies and global cosmetic trends to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Translate product briefs and consumer requirements into technically sound formulations.

3. R&D Laboratory Setup & Operations

* Establish and organize the formulation laboratory at our new manufacturing facility.
* Identify laboratory equipment, instruments, raw materials, testing requirements and operational workflows.
* Establish formulation SOPs, documentation systems, batch records and laboratory protocols.
* Build a systematic product development process from concept and prototype through validation and production handover.
* Develop a structured raw material database, formulation library and product development pipeline.

4. Stability, Testing & Quality

* Design and execute stability testing, compatibility testing and accelerated stability studies.
* Evaluate product parameters including pH, viscosity, texture, appearance, spreadability, sensory properties and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues related to separation, oxidation, discoloration, fragrance instability, preservative efficacy and packaging compatibility.
* Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure formulations meet applicable cosmetic regulations and safety requirements.

5. Manufacturing & Scale-Up

* Transfer formulations from laboratory scale to pilot and commercial manufacturing scale.
* Work closely with production teams to establish manufacturing processes, mixing parameters, temperatures, homogenization requirements, addition sequences and processing times.
* Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and ensure reproducibility between laboratory batches and commercial batches.
* Optimize formulations for manufacturing efficiency, yield, consistency and cost.

6. Team Leadership

* Recruit, mentor, train and lead a team of formulation chemists and laboratory personnel.
* Set R&D priorities, timelines, project milestones and development targets.
* Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, innovation, experimentation and accountability.
* Review formulations, technical work and development progress while ensuring the team consistently delivers quality results.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline.
* **Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on experience in cosmetic formulation and product development.**
* Strong preference for candidates currently or previously working with established cosmetic manufacturers, skincare brands, third-party manufacturing companies or product development laboratories.
* Proven experience developing formulations that have successfully launched commercially and are currently sold in the market.
* Strong expertise in formulation chemistry, ingredient functionality, emulsification, rheology, preservation, stability and cosmetic product design.
* Experience in commercial manufacturing scale-up and production troubleshooting.
* Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading a formulation/R&D team is highly desirable.
* Ability to independently develop formulations rather than relying entirely on supplier-provided base formulas.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on formulator who is equally comfortable working in a laboratory and leading a team.

The ideal candidate:

* Has personally developed multiple successful commercial cosmetic SKUs.
* Has a strong portfolio of products they have formulated or helped bring to market.
* Has the ability to develop genuinely differentiated formulations and innovative textures.
* Is knowledgeable about new ingredients, actives, formulation technologies and global beauty trends.
* Can build a formulation laboratory and R&D team from scratch.
* Understands commercial realities including raw material costs, margins, manufacturing feasibility and scalability.
* Is proactive, entrepreneurial and capable of taking ownership of product development.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to lead and build the formulation R&D function at a new cosmetic manufacturing facility.
* Freedom to experiment, innovate and develop proprietary formulations.
* Access to laboratory infrastructure, raw materials and product development resources.
* Leadership role with direct influence over the company's product portfolio and innovation strategy.
* Opportunity to build and lead your own formulation team.
* Monetary incentive

Application Requirements

Candidates should share:

* Updated CV detailing formulation and R&D experience.
* List of cosmetic products/SKUs they have developed or contributed to that have been commercially launched.
* Categories and formulation technologies they specialize in.
* Previous employers and nature of their responsibilities.
* Experience in laboratory setup, team leadership and manufacturing scale-up.

**Candidates without hands-on commercial cosmetic formulation experience will not be considered.**

jobs.title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*
**Worker Type**
Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Bangalore Technical Centre
  
  
**Additional Locations :**
**Job Posting Start Date**
2026-10-23

jobs.title: Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**
Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.
  
  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* Technical expertise: recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* People leadership: develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* Stakeholder management: communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* Delivery focus: plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* Quality, safety and integrity: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

**Additional Information**
**People are at the heart of what we do:**

* Once a year Full body check
* Competitive insurance scheme
* Employee assistance program – to take care of your and your loved ones mental health
* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves
* Education assistance – for your career growth
* People first culture translated into ‘Most Preferred place to work 2022-23 by Times group’

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Learn more about our D&I initiatives here: https://www.syngenta.com/careers/working-syngenta/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

Hiring: Head Chef – Arabian Cuisine & Product Development (R&D)

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ years preferred

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and passionate
**Arabian Cuisine Chef**
, preferably with expertise in traditional Middle Eastern cooking and Arabic bread preparation, to join our team.

This is a specialised culinary development role focused on creating authentic recipes, developing new menu items, standardising food preparation processes and building comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Arabian cuisine, an understanding of traditional cooking techniques and the ability to translate culinary expertise into standardised, repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple restaurant outlets.

**1. Recipe Development & Menu Innovation**

* Develop authentic Arabian and Middle Eastern recipes.
* Create and refine recipes for Mandi, grilled meats, Alfaham, Shawarma, BBQ, kebabs, marinades, sauces, dips and other Arabian specialities.
* Experiment with ingredients, spices, cooking techniques and flavour profiles.
* Develop new menu items while maintaining authenticity and consistency.
* Conduct food trials, tasting sessions and product evaluations.

**2. Arabic Bread & Bakery Specialisation**

* Develop recipes and preparation methods for traditional Arabic breads.
* Expertise in Khubz, Pita, Saj, Khameer, Tannour and other Middle Eastern breads is highly desirable.
* Standardise dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking temperatures and cooking techniques.
* Establish consistent bread quality, texture, thickness and shelf life.

**3. SOP Development & Standardisation**

* Create detailed recipe documentation with exact ingredient quantities and preparation procedures.
* Develop step-by-step SOPs for food preparation, cooking, storage and handling.
* Establish standard portion sizes, cooking times, temperatures and plating specifications.
* Develop batch preparation methods for commercial kitchen operations.
* Ensure recipes are scalable and consistently reproducible across multiple outlets.

**4. Kitchen Training & Implementation**

* Train kitchen staff on newly developed recipes and preparation techniques.
* Demonstrate standardised cooking procedures.
* Establish quality control and consistency benchmarks.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs within kitchen operations.

**5. Food Costing & Quality Control**

* Assist in ingredient selection and sourcing.
* Develop recipes with commercial viability and cost efficiency in mind.
* Calculate recipe yields, portion costs and wastage.
* Maintain consistency in taste, presentation and product quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of professional culinary experience preferred.
* Strong specialisation in Arabian, Middle Eastern or Gulf cuisine.
* Previous experience working in Gulf countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman or Bahrain) is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in traditional Arabic bread making is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in recipe development and menu creation.
* Ability to document recipes and create structured kitchen SOPs.
* Experience training and managing kitchen teams.
* Good understanding of commercial kitchen operations, food costing and standardisation.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in chefs who understand the difference between simply preparing food and developing a consistent, commercially scalable food product.

The candidate should be passionate about authentic Arabian cuisine, detail-oriented, experimental and capable of building structured culinary systems from the ground up.

**Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on Gulf culinary experience and expertise in both Arabian cuisine and Arabic bread preparation.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume along with details of their culinary specialisation, previous experience and examples of recipes or menus they have developed.

* **We look forward to working with someone who can bring authentic Arabian flavours and professional culinary systems to our growing restaurant business.**

jobs.title: Design Team Leader - Bakery, Bars & Confectionery

This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. ● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

jobs.title: Food Technology Manager – Micronutrient Premixes, Food Quality and Safety
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
GAIN is seeking to recruit a
**Food Technology Manager – Micronutrient Premixes, Food Quality and Safety**
to strengthen food safety and quality assurance for micronutrient premixes and fortified foods. Combining practical premix formulation expertise with sound quality judgement, you will help ensure that products supplied through the GAIN Premix Facility (GPF) meet agreed specifications, applicable standards and customer requirements.
  
  
Alongside GPF supplier assurance and formulation work, you will provide technical support to GAIN country offices, food manufacturers, governments and partners on large-scale food fortification. You will also support micro, small and medium-scale enterprises (MSMEs) to improve food safety, quality and processing practices.
  
  
Reporting to the Programme Lead, Large Scale Food Fortification, you will work closely with the GPF team, country programme teams, the GPF certification agent and partners including WFP and UNICEF.
  
  
This role will be offered on a
**two (2) year fixed-term contract**
, subject to availability of funding, and is open to applicants based in a country where GAIN has an office in Africa or Asia i.e. India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Indonesia, Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda, Mozambique, Rwanda, Nigeria, Benin. GAIN encourages early applications and reserves the right to close the advert ahead of the advertised deadline if we receive a high volume of interest.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Manage food safety and quality assurance for GPF premixes, maintaining and improving the quality management system and ensuring compliance with agreed specifications and customer requirements.
* Develop and validate procurement-ready vitamin and mineral premix formulations, including complex applications such as Ready-to-use Therapeutic Foods (RUTF), against customer, quality and food safety requirements.
* Assess and monitor suppliers, make approval recommendations, and review certificates of analysis, batch records and independent test results to support product-release decisions. Manage quality investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical support to GAIN country offices, manufacturers and millers on fortification, regulatory compliance and QA/QC systems, including optimising premix dosing equipment and resolving production bottlenecks.
* Support MSME food processors to improve food safety, quality and processing practices and meet market and regulatory requirements.
* Train food control agencies and inspectors on risk-based inspection, sampling and rapid testing, and advise government and standards bodies on feasible fortification, food safety and quality regulations.
* Develop compliance-study protocols for technical review and approval, contribute evidence and draft content to global premix production standards, and produce practical SOPs, QA/QC manuals and training tools.
* Coordinate consultants and technical studies, support laboratory-capacity development, and collaborate with NGOs, donors and industry associations on practical technical interventions.

**About You**
You will bring extensive experience in the food or pharmaceutical industry, with strong expertise in food safety, quality assurance and regulatory compliance, and proven responsibility for QA/QC and product-quality decisions. Hands-on experience developing vitamin and mineral premixes for complex applications, such as Ready-to-use Therapeutic Foods (RUTF), is essential. You will be able to translate customer specifications and applicable standards into formulations that meet demanding quality requirements, drawing on sound technical judgement.
  
  
You will have proven auditing experience and familiarity with food safety and quality frameworks such as FSSC 22000, HACCP and GMP, alongside technical competence in vitamin technology or related products. Relevant laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, will enable you to interpret technical documentation and quality evidence.
  
  
You will be confident advising industry, regulators, governments and international partners, and contributing to the development of technical standards or guidelines in a multi-stakeholder setting. Strong analytical, organisational and interpersonal skills, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to balance detailed work with broader priorities will be important to your success.
  
  
Experience in large-scale food fortification programmes is desirable. Experience in low- and middle-income country food systems, including hands-on support to micro, small and medium-scale enterprise (MSME) food processors, would be a distinct advantage. Educational background in chemistry, food technology, food science or microbiology, together with relevant industry certifications is required.
  
  
**About Our Offer**
Below are our offices in Africa & Asia. The starting gross salary ranges for this role are listed below, depending on location and experience. All figures are gross per annum.
  
  
Bangladesh: BDT 2,467,308 – 2,821,272

**Working Conditions**
All of our positions are based in one or more of GAIN’s designated offices as stated on our job advertisements. Successful candidates will be based in one of GAIN’s country offices and must have the existing right to live and work within a reasonably commutable distance of the relevant city / cities in which the role is advertised.
**Please note, that GAIN does not sponsor working visas and relocations.**
**Use of Artificial Intelligence during interviews and assessments**
GAIN is committed to ensuring a fair and authentic recruitment process. The use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools or other technologies to generate, formulate or provide answers during a live or recorded interview, written tests or assessment is not permitted, unless expressly authorised by GAIN in advance. Candidates who require assistive technology for accessibility purposes should inform the recruitment team in advance so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

jobs.description:
### Job Summary

Lattice is seeking candidates for the position of Senior Signal and Power Integrity Engineer. This is a full-time position located in India.

### Responsibilities

* Perform pre-layout and post-layout SI/PI simulation flows for chip, package and system integration.
* Own package-level SI/PI analysis for high-speed SerDes (Gen 3/4/5 with readiness for higher-generation SerDes), MIPI, HPIO supporting LPDDR4/LPDDR5/DDR4/DDR5, and WRIO interfaces.
* Perform channel analysis and electrical performance optimization, e.g., insertion/return loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, jitter, and SSN/SSO.
* Perform DC IR drop and AC impedance (PDN) simulation, and define decoupling and power delivery strategy at die, package and board level.
* Work closely with the package design team on package routing, layer assignment, via structures and ball map tweaking to meet SI/PI targets.
* Work with architects and silicon teams to review bump map and floor plan from an SI/PI perspective.
* Develop SI/PI design guidelines and package design rules for advanced packaging technologies (FC, WB, WLCSP, FO), and evaluate technology options for next-generation SerDes.
* Create simulation models and develop simulation methodology; correlate simulation with lab and test data.
* Use simulation and lab data to support design troubleshooting, propose corrective actions, and drive failure analysis, root cause and design of experiments.
* Work with testing and system teams on interface validation and customer support.
* Generate simulation reports with clear package and SI/PI recommendations.

### Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
* 5+ years of recent Signal Integrity and Power Integrity experience, with proven package-level SI/PI experience; 7+ years preferred for the senior level.
* Experience with high-speed SerDes (28G and above, such as PAM4 or 56G/112G) and knowledge of evolving higher-generation SerDes requirements.
* Experience with MIPI D-PHY/C-PHY and with DDR4/DDR5 and LPDDR4/LPDDR5 memory interface SI/PI analysis; experience with HPIO and WRIO type I/O is an advantage.
* Knowledge of package-level system architecture, I/O structures and topologies.
* Experience with 3D EM modeling (Ansys HFSS) and simulation tools (Keysight ADS or similar).
* Experience with SI/PI analysis tools (e.g., HSPICE, Cadence Sigrity, SIwave, PowerDC).
* Ability to work with package designers on routing, via and ball map optimization; familiarity with package and PCB design constraints.
* Excellent communication skills in English, as this person will interact with engineers in different disciplines and with members of management.

### Additional Information

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in India.

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Engineering Manager

\_\_

**Mission of the Role**

Are you interested in cybersecurity governance and motivated to be part of a global company transforming the industry with advanced technology? ABB is looking for a **Cyber Security Specialist** to join our **Automation Engineering and Service organization** in Machine Automation.

New European Union regulations set rules for how applications must be engineered and delivered. In this role, you will define the first cybersecurity governance and security guidelines for these applications. You will be the primary contact for cybersecurity matters. If you have experience in GRC, IEC 62443 and ISO/IEC 27001, and you are ready to turn regulations into practical controls, this opportunity is for you!

  

**Work model:** Hybrid

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define, maintain and continuously improve the cybersecurity governance framework for global automation engineering and services.
* Translate ABB requirements, customer obligations, regulations and standards (such as IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2) into practical controls, processes and responsibilities.
* Coordinate cybersecurity risk assessments, treatment, risk acceptance by designated risk owners, escalation and exception management. Maintain risk and compliance reporting.
* Define the secure development lifecycle, decision rights, RACI models and minimum requirements for engineering projects, service activities and lifecycle changes.
* Coordinate compliance assessments, audits and corrective actions. Develop reusable policies, templates, checklists and control mappings.
* Monitor regulatory and standards developments, including NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and coordinate the required governance updates.
* Support and advise customers on cybersecurity requirements and help them apply practical security measures in their automation applications.
* Align with Product Cyber Security, R&D, IT, Quality, Legal & Integrity and regional organizations, providing practical guidance on governance, risk and compliance.

  

**Requirements**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Practical experience in cybersecurity, risk and compliance, including direct technical security work.
* Good knowledge of IEC 62443 and ISO/IEC 27001, and familiarity with NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act and cybersecurity risk management principles.
* Understanding of customer cybersecurity requirements, third-party governance and the practical implementation of security controls in engineering and service environments.
* Ability to structure risk decisions, control frameworks, exceptions, audit evidence and KPIs, and to translate complex requirements into practical guidance.
* Solid technical writing, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with a pragmatic, risk-based working style and the ability to work without formal authority.
* Fluent English.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience in industrial automation, OT or other industrial environments.

  

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to be part of a global company engaged in large-scale industrial projects.
* The chance to build the first cybersecurity governance guidelines of this kind for the organization.
* Collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a supportive development culture.
* Growth possibilities within a solid technical career path inside ABB.
* Hybrid work model.

  

**About ABB's Machine Automation Division**

The Machine Automation division of ABB **(B&R Industrial Automation)** works with automation engineering and service teams and customers worldwide. Our teams develop solutions that support digital transformation and improve operational performance for our customers.

  

AUSTRIA: The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is 4.472,11 EUR monthly for a full-time position as of November 2026. But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience .

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

* Coordinate Zeptos twice-weekly POs and resolve supply-chain or lead-time issues with the internal supply-chain team and marketplace SCM contacts.

**6. Marketing, Visibility & Performance Advertising Coordination**

* Maintain marketing decks, discounting files, listing guidelines, NPI files and monthly plans.

**7. Commercials, Claims, Settlements & Reconciliation**

* Verify marketing-investment and discount debit notes (DNs), claims and supporting workings before approval/sign-off, as applicable to each marketplace.
* Coordinate with MKKLs online and Accounts-Receivable teams for discount and advertising settlement checks.
* Track Nykaa D JBP claims against pre-agreed slabs and coordinate applicable visibility, discount and claim settlements.
* Coordinate Purplle visibility, MOQ, discount and PREP settlements with the marketplace POC; flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Coordinate the applicable 1% West Bengal TOT claim with the Accounts team for Nykaa D.
* Maintain an audit-ready record of approved discounts, claims, bills, DNs, settlement status and supporting files.

jobs.description:
**Overview**   
   

As a PD specification writer, the role requires ensuring that the necessary criteria and requirements in building the specification of ING and Non INGs (Excluding Packaging Label) are met. This role will drive the legacy specification migration to SAP initially and provide support to PepsiCo Product Developers on new ING NON-ING PD Spec development to ensure they comply with the standards and requirements Post System rollout in the sector.

  
 **Responsibilities**   
   

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the PepsiCo PLM and SW ways of working in legacy systems (offline) and in SAP including Global Ingredient Standard and Supplier Standard and become proficient in the CAST Program and IT Applications associated.
* Drive accurate migration of Legacy Specs (ING and Non ING) in SAP systems and validate with regional teamsPre Go live on CAST.
* Collaborate with Regional teams to review and update ING Non-ING specifications in line with the regular spec renewal dates.
* Collaborate with Regional Cross Functional Teams and external resources to develop ING and Non-ING specifications (Excluding Label Packaging) that are clear, concise, and accurate to be handed over to run operations- Post Go Live on CAST.
* Ensure all requests are processed, documented, and delivered within defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
* Identify potential areas for process improvements to make recommendations to RD Leadership for continuous improvement.
* Raise necessary CRs on behalf of sector R D teams when needed and aligned.

**ING Specs**  :

* Work with and provide guidance to suppliers in completing the requirements of the specification through the completion of relevant tools i.e. ISSQ, in the following Key areas:

* Ingredient Composition
* All Chemical, physical and other parameter requirement.
* Claims/Compliance related with QA/FS
* Food safety Requirements
* Allergen
* Test method and limit of for FS and Performance parameters
* Ingredient Micro sensitive assessment.
* Other Spec General information

* Validate correct migration of data to the Global Ingredient Specification system, includes review of the information and supporting documents/evidence collected from the supplier.
* Work with Functional approver to review and align the specifications created/updated. Communicate with Operations and vendors for acceptance on specification change as needed. Coordinate uploads with SDSA teams.
* Work with Functional Approvers (Regulatory, Quality, Food Safety, Product Development, Analytical and Micro), and facilitate engagement with the relevant stakeholders like GP, SQA and QC for enrichment of specifications as per Global business workflows.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards.
* Collaborate with LiSU to assess impact on higher level specs if any and manage with regional partners.
* Upload all paperwork (i.e., Supplier Specs) and materials qualifications into the SAP system and track workflow.
* Manage Supplier relationships and serve as point of contact to gather information/data needed to build specifications; complete timely follow-ups to keep the process moving to completion.

**Non ING Specs (Scope- Formula, Process, FGE):**

* Collaborate with and provide guidance to regional PD, TDC and Packaging teams in completing the requirements of the Non-ING specs through the completion of relevant tools- AMESA Spec Request Form PLM Templates.
* Align ER release per the project classification (Innovation, Productivity, TBS, Ingredient Change etc).
* Digitize the Non ING specs accurately per the information received from PDs and review ER progress against the agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with PD,TDC, Pkg partners to ensure ER closure on time.
* Collaborate with SDSA, RA Pkg partners to ensure the necessary uploads in R D repositories.
* Escalate the risks/challenges faced (if any) well in time with the stakeholders through the progress on ER(s) for the projects.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards

**System associated activities:**

- Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of systems related to creation of specifications (e.g. SAP) as may

be required. Report gaps, roadblocks or findings and support on finding solutions and help facilitate closure with

IT SMEs

  
 **Qualifications**   
   

* Bachelors degree in Food Engineering, Food Safety, Food Technology, Food Science and Microbiology, or adjacent subjects. MS is desired.
* Min. 2-3 years of experience on Regulatory, QA/QC, Food Analytical experience or other Food related FMCG in a technical role; 1-2 years of which on Product Development or Specification Writing.
* Well-versed on Microsoft Office and Excel.
* Effective communication skills, both verbal (i.e. presentation, conference calls) and written (i.e. reports, e-mails) in English.
* Confident and able to speak or present to senior leaders when needed.
* Learning agility, self-motivation and desire for continuous self-improvement.
* Team player and works well with cross-functional, cross-regional and cross-cultural teams.
* Can work independently and has initiative for problem solving

jobs.title: Data Science & Analytics Strategy- Night Shift
jobs.description:
WORK YOULL DO

As a Data Science Consultant/Senior Consultant within CS&D, you will deliver data-driven insights, actionable recommendations, and cutting-edge analytical solutions. Youll play a pivotal role in supporting clients commercial strategies with a blend of technical depth and strategic thinking.

1. **Data Science & Analytics Strategy**

* Design and implement data strategies aligned to business goals across pricing, sales, marketing, and product development.
* Integrate data science into cross-functional business workflows with teams from product, marketing, finance, and operations.
* Develop predictive models, ML algorithms, and advanced statistical methodologies (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, hierarchical clustering, Lasso/Ridge regression).
* Recommend best practices in data governance, quality, and integration.
* Build customer segmentation and clustering frameworks for tailored marketing and product strategies.

2. **Advanced Data Analysis & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct pricing and transaction-level analysis to identify optimization opportunities.
* Build financial models to assess pricing strategies impact on revenue and profitability.
* Track market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive benchmarks to inform client strategies.
* Execute campaign analytics, market-mix modelling (MMM), and conjoint / product affinity analyses to guide customer engagement efforts.

3. **Domain-Specific Data Solutions**

* Healthcare & Life Sciences: Predictive analytics for patient outcomes and clinical trial optimization.
* Sales & Marketing: ML-powered dynamic pricing and campaign optimization.
* Product Innovation: Data-driven decisioning in product design based on real-time customer insights.
* Consumer & Retail: Demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and customer loyalty analytics.
* Technology Sector: Predictive performance modeling and QA automation using AI.

4. **Advanced Analytics & Model Development**

* Build and optimize ML models for classification, regression, clustering, and recommendation systems.
* Use NLP and deep learning (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) to derive insights from unstructured data.
* Maintain and recalibrate existing analytical models to ensure ongoing business relevance.

5. **AI Engineering & Emerging Tech**

* Design AI solutions integrated with agentic platforms, LLMs, and orchestration pipelines for intelligent automation.
* Apply concepts from AI engineering to productionize ML models and scale data pipelines using tools like **Apache Spark**, Hadoop, MLflow, and MLOps principles.
* Utilize cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy scalable AI solutions.

6. **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Align pricing and data strategies with C-suite objectives through collaborative workshops and executive presentations.
* Communicate complex analytical findings in business-friendly language.
* Educate clients on data science tools and methods to foster internal capability-building.

7. **Infrastructure & Technology Assessment**

* Evaluate clients' existing data and analytics maturity.
* Recommend advanced data platforms and scalable architectures.
* Lead deployment of new tools and ensure integration with enterprise systems.

8*.* **Practice Development**

* Contribute to business development by leading proposal creation and solutioning for data science use cases.
* Publish thought leadership, build proprietary toolkits, and mentor junior staff.
* Act as a topic lead in data science, driving eminence and knowledge sharing across the firm.

KEY AREAS OF EXPERTISE

* Customer Segmentation & Clustering
* Market-Mix Modelling & Campaign Analytics
* Price & Profit Optimization
* Conjoint Analysis & Product Affinity Modeling
* Machine Learning Algorithms: XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, Time Series, Hierarchical Clustering, Ensemble Methods, Gradient Boosting
* AI Engineering: Model Deployment, MLOps, Intelligent Agents, LLM Integration
* Big Data: Apache Spark, Hadoop
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Deloitte is seeking an Experienced Practitioner with deep expertise in Data Science and Technology, underpinned by strong analytical acumen, strategic consulting experience, and cross-industry exposure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in applying data science to drive customer-centric growth strategies, with a focus on pricing, segmentation, marketing effectiveness, and advanced analytics. This role sits within the Customer Strategy and Design team and plays a critical part in delivering impactful outcomes across global engagements.

* Professional experience: Experience in strategy consulting from consulting firms, Big 4 firms, OR experience within pricing department in industry with a focus on pricing strategy, planning and technology.
* Industry experience: across below listed industries is preferable:
* Retail, Consumer Goods & Industrial Products

jobs.title: VP R&D Injectable Products
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Off Targets Research is building a pipeline of differentiated, complex injectable products for regulated markets, developed through the 505(b)(2) and complex-generic routes and out-licensed to commercial partners. The Vice President R&D, Formulation Development (Injectables) will own formulation and process development end to end, from product feasibility to technology transfer and regulatory submission.

This is an executive role. You will set the technical strategy for the function, decide which products and formulation approaches the company pursues, hold the function accountable for timelines, quality and regulatory success, and represent Off Targets technically with partners, CDMOs and regulators. You will remain close to the science and will lead from technical depth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and portfolio**

* Define the formulation development strategy for the complex injectable portfolio, including suspensions and nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal and lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, ready-to-use solutions and depot / long-acting injectables.
* Assess the technical feasibility, risk and commercial attractiveness of new product opportunities, and advise the CEO and Board on which to pursue, delay or drop.
* Design formulation approaches that are patent-aware and non-infringing, working with IP counsel on freedom-to-operate and carve-out strategy.
* Own the development plan, milestones and budget for the function, and report progress and risks to the CEO and Board.

**Technical leadership and execution**

* Lead preformulation, prototype development, optimisation, scale-up and exhibit batch execution for assigned programmes, either directly or through senior scientists.
* Apply QbD and risk-based approaches (CQAs, CPPs, DoE, control strategy) to formulation design, process understanding and troubleshooting.
* Resolve the hardest formulation and process problems, including stability failures, particle size and polymorph control, precipitation, injectability, reconstitution behaviour and process robustness.
* Make sound sterilisation and manufacturing-route decisions (aseptic, terminal, filtration, lyophilisation, container closure) and understand their effect on product quality and regulatory risk.
* Oversee technology transfer to pilot and commercial manufacturing sites and CDMOs, and challenge their execution where needed.

**Regulatory, quality and CMC**

* Own the formulation and process development sections of regulatory filings (including 3.2.P.2) and the scientific justification behind them, and lead responses to regulatory queries.
* Work with Analytical R&D, QA and Regulatory Affairs to align methods, specifications, characterisation, in-vitro performance testing and stability programmes.
* Set and uphold standards for documentation, data integrity, laboratory discipline and technical review across the function.

**Commercial and partner engagement**

* Lead the technical side of out-licensing, co-development and contract development discussions, including due diligence responses and partner presentations.
* Build and maintain relationships with CDMOs, CROs, technology providers and external experts.

**People and capability**

* Build, lead and mentor the formulation team, including senior scientists and managers, and develop the next level of leaders.
* Set the culture of the function: scientific rigour, accountability, speed and a bias for solving problems at the root.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Ph.D. in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline (strongly preferred), or M.Pharm / M.S. with an exceptional track record.

**Experience (must have)**

* 25 or more years in pharmaceutical R&D, with at least 20 years in injectable or sterile product development.
* A record of taking injectable products through to regulatory submission and approval in the US, preferably through 505(b)(2) or complex-generic routes.
* Hands-on depth in at least two complex dosage forms from: suspensions or nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal or lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, depot or long-acting injectables.
* Proven experience in scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing sites or CDMOs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in specialty pharma, complex-generic or injectable CDMO environments.
* Familiarity with patent landscapes and non-infringing formulation design.
* Exposure to licensing, partnering or technical due diligence.
* Experience working with regulators, including FDA meetings and deficiency responses.

**Leadership attributes**

* Technical authority that earns the respect of scientists and partners.
* Strong judgement under uncertainty, and the courage to give the CEO and Board a straight view.
* Clear written and spoken communication with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* High ownership, urgency and accountability for delivery.

**Why Join Off Targets**

* A senior role with direct access to the Chairman and CEO and real influence on which products the company develops.
* A pipeline of differentiated injectable products with commercial relevance, built for out-licensing to partners.
* Scientific rigour paired with speed and accountability, in a company small enough for a leader to shape how things are done.
* Competitive fixed compensation, together with a performance-linked incentive tied to out-licensing outcomes.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV to the contact provided with this description. All discussions are treated in confidence.

jobs.title: AM - Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To lead and manage the complete Quality Assurance and Quality Control function of a high-precision aerospace CNC manufacturing facility, ensuring compliance with AS9100D Rev. D, ISO 9001:2015, aerospace customer requirements, engineering drawings and applicable industry standards.

The candidate must possess strong practical experience in aerospace quality management systems, APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, Gauge R&R, CMM inspection, GD&T, AS9102 First Article Inspection, special process control and aerospace customer quality management.

The individual should be capable of independently handling customer quality audits, technical discussions, quality escalations and approval requirements.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Aerospace Quality Management System AS9100D Rev. D**

* Establish, implement, maintain and continuously improve AS9100D Rev. D Quality Management System.
* Ensure effective implementation of ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain Quality Manual, procedures, work instructions and quality records.
* Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits.
* Coordinate external certification audits, surveillance audits and customer audits.
* Manage NCR, CAPA, corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure risk-based thinking, operational risk management and continual improvement.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace customer-specific quality requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of the Quality Management System.

**B. APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning**

* Lead APQP activities for new aerospace product development.
* Prepare and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* Prepare and implement Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
* Develop and implement Control Plans.
* Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* Establish quality planning and inspection requirements for new components.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering for process validation.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality planning during NPI.
* Review and approve quality documentation before production release.

**C. MSA – Measurement System Analysis and Gauge R&R**

* Strong practical knowledge of Measurement System Analysis (MSA).
* Conduct and review Gauge R&R studies covering repeatability and reproducibility.
* Evaluate measurement system capability and suitability.
* Establish calibration and verification systems for measuring instruments.
* Understand measurement uncertainty, accuracy, precision and traceability.
* Ensure appropriate measuring instruments are selected for critical aerospace dimensions.
* Maintain calibration records and measuring instrument registers.
* Establish measurement system control for CMM and other precision inspection equipment.

**D. Dimensional Inspection and Advanced Metrology**

Must have strong practical knowledge of:

* CMM operation, programming and inspection methodology.
* Contour measuring instruments.
* Profile projectors.
* Height gauges, bore gauges and precision micrometers.
* Roundness and surface roughness measuring instruments.
* Digital and specialised precision measuring equipment.
* Calibration and measurement traceability.
* GD&T and complex engineering drawing interpretation.
* Datum structures, true position, profile, concentricity, runout and geometric tolerances.

Ensure inspection planning, first-off inspection, in-process inspection and final inspection of aerospace components.

**E. CNC Machining Quality and Process Inspection**

Experience in quality control and inspection of:

* CNC turning components.
* Twin-spindle CNC turn-mill components.
* 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milled components.
* CNC VTL components.
* Wire-Cut EDM components.
* Complex precision aerospace components with tight dimensional tolerances.

Ensure dimensional inspection reports are reviewed against customer drawings, specifications and approved inspection requirements.

**F. Aerospace Special Process Quality Management**

* Strong understanding of aerospace special process requirements.
* Control and monitor in-house and outsourced special processes.
* Experience with heat treatment, anodising, chemical conversion coating, plating, passivation and protective coatings.
* Knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) processes such as FPI, MPI, UT and radiography.
* Review special process certificates, test reports and process qualification records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace specifications and customer requirements.
* Coordinate special process supplier audits and approval requirements.
* Knowledge of NADCAP accreditation and special process supplier management will be a strong advantage.

**G. Aerospace Quality Documentation and First Article Inspection**

* Preparation and review of AS9102 First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR).
* Preparation and maintenance of APQP documentation.
* Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* PFMEA and Control Plans.
* Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* MSA and Gauge R&R reports.
* Dimensional inspection and CMM reports.
* Material traceability records and material test certificates.
* Special process certificates and qualification records.
* Non-Conformance Reports (NCR).
* Corrective Action Reports (CAR) and 8D reports.
* Calibration and measurement system records.
* Customer-specific quality documentation and approval records.

**H. Quality Tools and Continuous Improvement**

* Strong knowledge of 7 QC Tools.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Process Capability Analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp and Ppk).
* Root Cause Analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone.
* 8D Problem Solving.
* Risk Management and FMEA.
* Continuous improvement and defect prevention.
* Supplier Quality Management and supplier development.
* Reduction of internal and customer rejection.

**I. Supplier Quality Management**

* Monitor and improve supplier quality performance.
* Conduct supplier quality audits and process evaluations.
* Ensure raw material certifications and material traceability.
* Monitor outsourced special process suppliers.
* Handle supplier non-conformities and corrective actions.
* Ensure supplier compliance with aerospace customer requirements.
* Maintain approved supplier documentation and performance records.

**J. Aerospace Customer Handling and Quality Management**

* Strong experience in direct customer quality interactions with aerospace OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers.
* Independently handle customer quality audits, quality reviews and technical discussions.
* Handle customer complaints, NCRs, corrective actions and 8D reports.
* Coordinate customer FAI approvals and dimensional inspection documentation.
* Respond to customer queries related to GD&T, CMM, MSA, Gauge R&R, material traceability and special processes.
* Manage customer quality escalations and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Coordinate customer visits and represent the organisation during quality meetings.
* Ensure customer-specific quality requirements are understood and implemented across departments.

**Preferred Aerospace Customer Exposure:**

Airbus, Boeing, Honeywell Aerospace, GE Aerospace, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney, ISRO and HAL.

Experience working with their approved Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers will also be considered.

**K. Quality Team Management and Training**

* Lead and manage quality engineers, inspectors, CMM programmers and metrology personnel.
* Develop departmental responsibilities and competency matrices.
* Conduct training on AS9100D, GD&T, CMM, APQP, PFMEA, MSA and inspection methods.
* Develop employee technical competency and inspection skills.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality procedures across production and engineering.

.

**3. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience in aerospace, defence or high-precision manufacturing quality.
* Strong hands-on experience in AS9100D Rev. D implementation.
* Practical knowledge of APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA and Gauge R&R.
* Strong CMM, GD&T and precision metrology experience.
