jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Head Chef will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring consistent food quality, maintaining high standards of food presentation, managing kitchen staff, controlling food costs, and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.

The role requires strong culinary expertise, leadership capabilities, creativity, and the ability to manage kitchen operations efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kitchen Operations & Food Production:**

* Oversee and manage all daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure timely preparation and delivery of food orders.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Develop and implement standard recipes and food preparation procedures.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to company standards.
* Monitor kitchen workflow and ensure efficient coordination between kitchen sections.
* Introduce new dishes, seasonal menus, and innovative food concepts.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment and facilities.

**Menu Planning & Development:**

* Develop, review, and update food menus in coordination with management.
* Create new recipes and improve existing dishes.
* Conduct food trials and tastings before introducing new menu items.
* Ensure menu pricing is aligned with food costs and profitability targets.
* Monitor food trends and introduce innovative culinary ideas.
* Ensure menu items meet customer expectations and brand standards.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen employees.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities among kitchen staff.
* Prepare kitchen duty rosters and manage staff scheduling.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, food safety, and hygiene.
* Maintain teamwork, discipline, and a positive working environment.
* Identify training needs and support employee development.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels across all kitchen sections.

**Food Cost & Inventory Management:**

* Monitor food costs and ensure achievement of budgeted targets.
* Control food wastage, spoilage, and unnecessary expenses.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate purchasing requirements.
* Ensure proper receiving, storage, and rotation of food items.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and stocktaking.
* Establish appropriate portion control and standard recipes.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure quality and competitive pricing.
* Monitor kitchen expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene:**

* Ensure strict compliance with UAE food safety regulations and applicable municipal requirements.
* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
* Ensure proper food handling, preparation, storage, and temperature control.
* Monitor expiry dates and implement FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure staff follow personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Maintain food safety records and inspection documentation.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of hygiene or food safety violations.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction:**

* Conduct regular food quality checks before dishes are served.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, temperature, and presentation.
* Handle food-related customer complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with restaurant service teams to ensure smooth food delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement necessary improvements.
* Ensure all special dietary requirements and food allergies are handled appropriately.

**Equipment & Maintenance:**

* Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained in good working condition.
* Report equipment breakdowns and coordinate timely repairs.
* Ensure proper use and handling of kitchen tools and machinery.
* Monitor kitchen safety procedures and prevent workplace accidents.
* Maintain organized storage areas and kitchen workstations.

**Administration & Reporting:**

* Prepare daily and monthly kitchen operational reports.
* Monitor food cost percentages, wastage, and inventory consumption.
* Maintain recipe cards, food costing sheets, and kitchen records.
* Report operational challenges and staffing requirements to management.
* Assist management with budgeting and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in professional kitchen operations.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a Head Chef or Sous Chef role.
* Strong experience in menu development, food costing, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of international cuisines and modern cooking techniques.
* Good understanding of UAE food safety regulations.
* Experience in managing and developing multicultural kitchen teams.
* Previous UAE experience is a must.

**Job Purpose:**

The Executive Pastry Chef is responsible for leading the creation, development and execution of premium pastry and dessert concepts across Independent Food Company's portfolio, including the development and launch of new pastry brands.

The role combines brand creation, culinary innovation, product development and operational leadership, ensuring that each concept delivers a distinctive identity, exceptional product quality, commercial viability and a consistent guest experience.

The incumbent will lead the end-to-end culinary development of new pastry brands, from initial concept creation and menu development through kitchen design and layout planning, recipe standardization, equipment selection, team recruitment, training and successful operational launch.

While the role carries strategic and creative responsibilities, the Executive Pastry Chef must remain fully hands-on, actively participating in product development, tastings, production trials, training and new brand openings.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pastry Brand Creation & Concept Development**

1. Lead the culinary creation and development of new pastry, bakery and dessert brands, from initial concept ideation through commercial launch.

jobs.description:
**About Gradiant**

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at www.gradiant.com.

**Job Overview**

* Own and lead the development of Gradiant’s mineral extraction technologies from laboratory concept through pilot validation, scale-up and commercial deployment, covering extraction, purification, concentration and conversion to the final products.
* Set the technical direction across extraction routes (e.g. sorbents/ion exchange, solvent extraction, membranes, precipitation/crystallization), lead the R&D team, and serve as the technical authority for customers, partners and internal project teams.

**Specific Duties/Responsibilities**

*Technology strategy and roadmap*

* Define and own the technology roadmap for mineral extraction, purification and conversion, aligned with business and market needs.
* Benchmark competing technologies, evaluate new chemistries (sorbents, extractants, membranes) and partner technologies, and drive IP generation.

*Lead R&D team and manage projects*

* Lead and mentor the R&D team across SG and AD Labs (scientists, engineers and interns); set priorities and guide experimental design and data analysis.
* Oversee planning, budgets, execution and tracking of projects and procurement; liaise with vendors, contractors and internal groups; prepare key presentations and reports for leadership.

*Process development and flowsheet design*

* Develop and optimize mineral extraction flowsheets for high recovery and selectivity over competing ions (e.g. Na, K, Mg, Ca, B), including impurity control, reagent/solvent management and recycle streams.
* Perform process modelling, mass and energy balances and techno-economic inputs to produce high-purity final product.

*Scale-up and technology transfer*

* Lead the progression from lab and bench scale to pilot and demonstration; design, procure and commission pilot units.
* Resolve scale-up challenges (e.g. phase separation, solvent loss, sorbent lifetime, fouling, impurity build-up, process stability) and prepare process design packages for engineering and project teams.

*Commercialization and customer support*

* Lead end-to-end application studies on real feeds (brines, produced water, leachates) from feasibility through process validation.
* Support proposals, feasibility studies and performance guarantees; provide on-site commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization at customer plants.

*Partnerships and stakeholder engagement*

* Build and manage collaborations with customers, technology providers, universities and suppliers to accelerate technology validation and deployment.
* Represent Gradiant’s mineral extraction technology in technical discussions with customers, partners and at industry forums.

**Qualification, Skills & Experience**

*Qualification*

* Ph.D. in Chemical or Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Hydrometallurgy, Materials Science or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree with a strong industrial critical-minerals track record will also be considered.

*Skills*

* Deep expertise in at least one mineral extraction route (solvent extraction, ion exchange/adsorption, membranes or precipitation/crystallization), with working knowledge of the others.
* Process modelling and flowsheet design (mass/energy balances; tools such as Aspen, OLI or PHREEQC) and analytical methods (ICP-OES/MS, IC).
* Strong leadership, communication and customer-facing skills; able to translate technical results into business decisions.

*Experience*

* 10+ years in critical-minerals process development, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
* Proven track record taking a technology from lab through pilot to commercial or industrial operation.
* Hands-on experience in plant commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization, and in technology transfer to engineering or customers.
* Experience with industrial water/wastewater treatment and international customers is an advantage.

*Certificate*

* Preferred, not mandatory: Professional Engineer (PE/P.Eng), PMP, Lean Six Sigma or equivalent.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.

* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.
* A strong food palate and genuine passion for food, with hands-on experience in menu management, NPD and product sign-off.
* Expertise in building brand love to drive both customer penetration and frequency.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, the franchisor, country teams and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Packaging Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Manager, Packaging Development leads the Packaging Development & Industrialization team of Product Operations. This role owns the technical delivery of every packaging launch, from brief to PPS and production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, so each launch is safe, on time and proven. It applies risk-based pathways, runs pilot-first development for new high-risk packs, and decides on evidence, not on supplier statements.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Launch Portfolio Delivery**

* Own the technical delivery of the packaging launch portfolio, from brief to PPS.
* Review briefs early and give feasibility, cost, timing and risk input, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, risk and capacity.
* Personally lead a selected set of the most complex, high-risk launches.
* Escalate early any risk to launch date, quality or cost, with facts and options.

**Risk-Based Development & Evidence**

* Classify each project at the brief by what is new and its 1 to 5 risk score; propose the pathway (Fast Lane, Targeted, Full Pilot-First) for confirmation by Quality.
* For new, high-risk packs, run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests and line trials on pilot parts before any production mold.
* Prepare the evidence for the Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation and GO PROD gates.
* Apply Specifications checkpoints in proportion to risk, with an owner, evidence and sign-off for each.
* Define the test strategy and acceptance criteria with Quality.

**Packaging Engineering**

* Own drawings, critical dimensions, GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Lead functional analysis, DFMA, decoration feasibility and formula/pack/process compatibility.
* Use proven platforms and supplier standards from Packaging R&D wherever they fit.
* Keep approved specifications up to date in Specright.

**Industrialization & CM Readiness**

* Lead tooling strategy and mold validation (T0 to T3) with suppliers.
* Confirm supplier and CM technical capability at the Tech Assessment.
* Organize and attend line trials; secure PPS on the final formula.
* Manage technical changes, deviations and concessions through change control, with Quality.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging engineers and developers.
* Set clear ownership, standards and a regular project review cadence.
* Keep the project portfolio data accurate, as the basis for capacity decisions.
* Feed lessons learned into specifications, design rules and Kaizen priorities.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain and Regulatory.
* Give technical input on supplier choices; Procurement leads RFQs and negotiation.
* Represent Packaging Development in launch reviews and at the Newness Committee when required.
* Contribute to value engineering and COGS savings without trading critical risk.

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of primary packs (e.g., mascara, gloss, compacts, closures, pumps) from brief to production at external suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Strong command of technical drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and injection molding.
* Hands-on experience of mold validation, line trials, PPS and packaging test methods.
* Solid knowledge of formula/pack compatibility and filling and assembly processes.
* Experience leading or coaching packaging engineers.
* Able to review CAD models (SolidWorks or similar) and run a portfolio in a project tool (Asana or similar).
* Able to travel to suppliers and contract manufacturers in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of structured, evidence-based delivery, staying calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 8+ years in packaging development, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.

Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.

POSITION VACANCY

Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness

POSITION SNAPSHOT

Company: Nestlé

Location: Dubai - HQ

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.

* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.

* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.

* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.

* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.

* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.

* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)

* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.

* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

**Overview:**
The Senior Research Associate independently develops renovation and innovation products from formulation and laboratory evaluation through application validation, factory trials, scale-up, and transfer to manufacturing. This hands-on role requires regular work in Kemin and external laboratories and the ability to plan and execute factory trials at Kemin’s manufacturing facility. The role serves as the product owner for assigned products from concept to launch.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Renovation and Innovation Projects**

* Lead assigned renovation and innovation projects, or defined R&D workstreams within larger projects, from technical brief through formulation, laboratory evaluation, application validation, factory trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, and technical launch readiness.

* Maintain current project plans and communicate progress, technical decisions, dependencies, risks, delays, and recovery actions before milestones are missed.
* Remain accountable for assigned technical deliverables until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved, required documentation is completed, and outstanding technical issues are formally transferred to the accountable function Perform Hands-On Laboratory and Application Work.

* Design and execute robust experiments using appropriate controls, replication, statistical methods, and predefined acceptance criteria.

* Apply independent scientific judgment when reviewing AI-assisted outputs and verify the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of information before use.

**Evaluate and Recommend Packaging**

jobs.title: FirstClub - Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain Domain
jobs.description:
**About FirstClub**
At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
  
  
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
  
  
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
  
  
**The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain**

* Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
* Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
* Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
* Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
* Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
* Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
* Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
* Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.

**Why FirstClub**

* Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
* Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
* Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
* Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
* Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
* Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.

**The Role**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub - from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member.
  
  
Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.
* Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter : availability and fill rate, promise adherence, inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.
* Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.
* Architect the core systems with Engineering : a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.
* Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.
* Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners - making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.
* Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.
* Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons : forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.
* Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture - pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.
* Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.
* Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 - 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.
* Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.
* Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.
* Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.
* Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.
* Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.
* Strong analytical depth : comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.
* An AI-native mindset : you think naturally about how ML, automation and agents can change how decisions get made, not just how screens look.
* Excellent stakeholder management with senior Operations, Category, Finance and Engineering leaders.
* You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments : you'll write the spec, pull the data and walk the floor yourself, and you know the answer is usually a mix of technology, process and operational change.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
* An MBA is a plus; strong product experience matters more.

**Good To Have**

* Built or scaled a WMS, inventory platform, procurement system, TMS or promise/ETA engine.
* Experience with fresh, perishable and cold-chain supply chains, including FEFO, grading and expiry management.
* Exposure to demand forecasting, replenishment optimization, slotting, network planning or routing.
* Experience launching and scaling operations across multiple cities and high daily order volumes.
* Experience building frontline workforce products : productivity tracking, incentives, gamification or training.
* Experience shipping AI/ML-driven decisioning or agentic workflows in production operations.

jobs.description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Associate Product Manager?**

We are looking for a motivated, result-oriented and who is passionate about solving real-world business and user problems through technology and design.

In this role, you will take ownership of key product areas, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and translate customer insights and business requirements into scalable product solutions. You will work closely with engineering, design, and business teams to drive product development, ensure seamless execution, and deliver impactful solutions.

If you are enthusiastic about building innovative products and making a difference in the food-tech industry, we would love to have you on our team!

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Solutioning: Translate business challenges and requirements into well-defined product solutions, outlining scope, possible approaches, dependencies, and edge cases.
* Product Discovery: Drive product discovery through user research, market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and customer insights to identify opportunities and shape product strategy.
* Product Documentation: Create and maintain product documentation, including Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with engineering teams to assess technical feasibility, understand dependencies, evaluate effort estimates
* Design Collaboration: Partner with UI/UX teams to develop wireframes and mock-ups using tools such as Figma, ensuring designs align with business and product requirements.
* Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, design, business, and customer success teams to ensure smooth product execution and delivery.
* Product Performance: Monitor product performance through customer feedback, and data analysis to identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement.
* Agile Product Management: Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and release management while promoting Agile best practices.
* Delivery Management: Track product features throughout development, testing, and deployment, proactively follow up on dependencies and blockers, and provide regular progress updates to stakeholders

**Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience in Product Management, preferably within a B2B technology environment.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Experience in contributing to product launches, feature development, and product enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Analytical mindset with hands-on experience in working with data, KPIs, metrics, and OKRs.
* Familiarity with product discovery methodologies, user research, and market analysis.
* Understanding of wireframing and prototyping, with exposure to tools such as Figma.
* Experience in creating PRDs, user stories, Jira tickets, and acceptance criteria.
* Good understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-driven, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

jobs.title: Lead / Senior Pricing Audit Specialist

jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer - GCP

* Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini

**Nice to have**

jobs.title: Factory Manager / Plant Manager (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

jobs.title: Cnc Machine Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position: CNC Machine Maintenance Supervisor**

  

**Experience:** 5 to 6 Years

  

**Qualification:** Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Mechatronics Engineering

**Work Location:** Peenya, Bangalore

  

**Job Summary:**

To ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of all CNC machines and associated equipment by managing breakdown maintenance, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities. The role is responsible for minimizing machine downtime, improving equipment reliability, ensuring maintenance team effectiveness, and supporting uninterrupted production operations.

  

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  

**A. Breakdown Maintenance**

+ Supervise and coordinate breakdown maintenance activities for CNC Turning, VMC, and HMC machines.
+ Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic faults to ensure quick restoration of machines.
+ Identify the root causes of recurring machine failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
+ Minimize machine breakdown time and production losses through effective maintenance planning and execution.
+ Coordinate with OEMs and external service providers for critical machine repairs.

**B. Preventive and Predictive Maintenance**

+ Plan, schedule, and monitor preventive maintenance activities for all CNC machines.
+ Ensure timely execution of daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic maintenance schedules.
+ Monitor machine health and identify potential failures before they impact production.
+ Ensure proper functioning of lubrication, hydraulic, pneumatic, and coolant systems.
+ Review PM effectiveness and implement improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**C. CNC Machine Technical Support**

+ Possess working knowledge of CNC Turning, VMC, and HMC machines.
+ Understand basic CNC controls, servo motors, spindle drives, sensors, encoders, and machine alarms.
+ Troubleshoot machine-related mechanical and electrical issues.
+ Ensure proper functioning of machine tool systems, safety interlocks, and auxiliary equipment.
+ Support machine setting, alignment, leveling, and other maintenance-related activities.

**D. Team Management and Supervision**

+ Supervise and allocate daily maintenance activities to technicians, fitters, and maintenance personnel.
+ Monitor team performance and ensure timely completion of assigned maintenance jobs.
+ Guide and train maintenance technicians on troubleshooting techniques and preventive maintenance practices.
+ Ensure adequate manpower availability across shifts.
+ Maintain effective coordination between maintenance and production teams.

**E. Documentation and Maintenance Records**

+ Maintain machine breakdown reports and downtime records.
+ Ensure proper completion and updating of preventive maintenance checklists.
+ Maintain machine history cards and equipment maintenance records.
+ Monitor spare-parts inventory and ensure the availability of critical spares.
+ Prepare and analyze maintenance-related reports using MS Excel.
+ Update maintenance activities in SAP PM, wherever applicable.

**F. Safety and Continuous Improvement**

+ Ensure compliance with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and machine safety procedures.
+ Implement 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement practices in the maintenance area.
+ Ensure safe working practices during maintenance and repair activities.
+ Identify opportunities to reduce recurring breakdowns, maintenance costs, and equipment downtime.
+ Promote a safety-conscious and improvement-oriented working environment.

**G. Production Coordination**

+ Coordinate with production supervisors and managers for planned maintenance activities.
+ Prioritize breakdowns based on production requirements and machine criticality.
+ Communicate machine status, repair progress, and expected restoration time to production.
+ Support production targets by ensuring maximum machine availability.

**Experience and Technical Competencies**

+ 5 to 6 years of experience in CNC machine maintenance.
+ Preferably 2 years of experience in a supervisory or team-leading role.
+ Practical knowledge of CNC Turning, VMC, and HMC machines.
+ Good understanding of hydraulic, pneumatic, lubrication, and coolant systems.
+ Basic knowledge of CNC controllers, servo drives, spindle drives, sensors, and machine alarms.
+ Experience in breakdown troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.
+ Knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
+ Basic knowledge of MS Excel; SAP PM knowledge is preferred.

**Interested candidates may share their resumes at:**  Interested candidates may reach out to **Latha.j@cyientdlm.com**

11. Complete production and inspection records accurately as required.

* **2 to 5 years of hands-on experience** in manual soldering, PCB assembly, and PCB rework/desoldering.
* Strong experience in **through-hole (THT) and SMD component soldering**.
* Practical experience in **electronic assembly, PCB rework, component replacement, and repair**.
* Ability to read and understand **engineering drawings, circuit/assembly diagrams, BOMs, and work instructions**.
* Good knowledge of soldering tools, soldering stations, rework stations, and related electronic assembly equipment.

* Experience in **inspection, rework, and quality control** of electronic assemblies.
* Good knowledge of **ESD handling and workplace safety procedures**.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* **Good communication skills** and attention to detail.

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

The Lead Tech Project Manager is a skilled, experienced subject matter expert who leads complex technology initiatives that bring Disney Experiences’ immersive stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints. In this lead role, you will guide cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle, ensuring that digital and physical guest and consumer experiences are delivered reliably, efficiently, and with the creativity and innovation that define Disney.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Lead Tech Project Manager, you will serve as a lead and mentor for project teams, driving high-priority initiatives that support Disney Experiences’ technology and digital ecosystem across guest-facing and consumer channels. You will act as a problem-solver and team player, coordinating stakeholders, managing risk, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget. This role matters because it connects technical delivery to business outcomes, requiring a subject matter expert who can communicate complex concepts clearly, influence decisions, and foster collaboration to achieve shared goals.

* Act as a subject matter expert and lead for complex technical projects, providing guidance on project structure, delivery approach, and best practices for enterprise-scale solutions.
* Plan and prioritize work by translating organizational and segment goals into clear project roadmaps, milestones, and outcomes that align with Disney Experiences’ strategic objectives.
* Lead cross-functional, team-of-teams efforts across engineering, product, architecture, and business partners to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery throughout the project lifecycle.
* Anticipate and solve complex problems by identifying risks, issues, and dependencies early, and driving innovative, pragmatic solutions that keep projects on track.
* Build strong partnerships and collaborate across teams, facilitating productive discussions, negotiating trade-offs, and helping stakeholders adopt new perspectives when needed.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including scope, plans, RAID logs, timelines, budgets, and prioritization plans, ensuring transparency and traceability for all stakeholders.
* Monitor financials by reconciling actuals, updating forecasts, and communicating changes in budget and resource needs to leadership, supporting accurate cost management and governance.
* Lead project meetings and communication cadences, including status updates, dashboards, and executive presentations, to provide clear, data-driven storytelling on progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Train, mentor, and guide junior technical project managers and individual contributors, providing continuous coaching and feedback to elevate project management practices and team performance.
* Create an inclusive, team-oriented environment where Disney values are lived every day by encouraging creative problem solving, ensuring every voice is heard, and connecting individual contributions to team and business success.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 7 years of technical project/program management experience leading projects with technical teams developing enterprise-class solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise as a subject matter expert and lead on complex technology initiatives, with a strong track record as a problem-solver and team player in cross-functional environments.
* Proficiency with Agile, Lean, Kanban, and Waterfall methodologies, including the ability to pragmatically blend approaches to support collaboration and delivery.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, cloud, APIs, services, database technologies, platform dependencies, DevOps, and testing concepts such as CI/CD and TDD.
* Highly developed influence, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts and help others adopt different points of view.
* Experience managing large-scale project budgets, including forecasting, tracking, and explaining variances in scope, schedule, and cost.
* Strong organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience with project management and reporting tools such as MyPPM (Clarity), Jira/MyJira, Smartsheet, and Power BI or similar analytics platforms.
* Bachelor's Degree or higher.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Technical project management experience in Commerce or a closely related domain.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Agile certifications such as CSM, ACP, CSPO/CPO, SAFe, or LeSS.
* Experience supporting large-scale, global software development programs within a creative, customer-focused, and service-minded organization.

jobs.title: Lead Research Scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Purpose of the Role**

* Lead analytical method development, validation, and regulatory data generation for active ingredients and formulations.
* Ensure work meets OECD GLP, regulatory, safety, and business requirements while providing technical leadership across projects.
* To Strengthen analytical capability, innovation, and operation excellence

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead laboratory safety activities, hazard assessments, and a strong HSE culture.
* Plan and deliver complex analytical projects independently.
* Act as a technical expert for 5-batch studies, impurity profiling, analytical method development, validation, and GLP reporting.
* Develop and validate analytical methods using chromatography and spectroscopy techniques.
* Support analysis of active ingredients, formulations, impurities, degradation products, and packaging interactions.
* Serve as GLP Study Director where required, ensuring data integrity, compliant documentation, and audit-ready reports.
* Work with formulation, packaging, regulatory, sourcing, manufacturing, and supply-chain teams to deliver projects on time.
* Investigate and resolve technical issues, including manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification results, customer complaints, and regulatory queries.
* Mentor junior scientists and improve laboratory capability, quality systems, and ways of working.
* Introducing new analytical technologies, automation, digital tools, and efficiency improvements.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in HPLC/UHPLC, GC, GC-MS, LC-MS, UV-Vis, FTIR, and interpretation of NMR data.
* Experience in 5-batch analysis, impurity identification, mass balance, method validation, and regulatory dossier support.
* Good understanding of OECD GLP and global regulatory requirements, including SANCO, EPA, and FAO/WHO guidelines.
* Knowledge of data integrity, computer system validation, instrument qualification, and audit readiness.
* Experience in product chemistry, formulation testing, and stability studies.
* Ability to write and review study plans, reports, SOPs, and regulatory documents.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and scientific problem-solving skills.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**

* PhD or master’s degree in chemistry or a related discipline; Analytical Chemistry preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience with a PhD, or 12 years with a master’s degree.
* Experience in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals Industry, or GLP-certified CRO environments.
* Strong knowledge of laboratory safety, chemical hazard management, and OECD GLP.
* Proven experience in analytical method development and validation for regulatory submissions.
* Hands-on experience with GC, HPLC, and spectroscopic techniques.
* Experience with laboratory data systems such as Chromeleon, Empower, Power BI and LIMS.

**Preferred**

* Experience as a GLP Study Director or senior technical lead for Phy-chem GLP data package generation.
* Experience coordinating small study teams in an accredited GLP laboratory.
* Confidence in presenting and defending analytical data during regulatory reviews and audits.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and mentoring junior colleagues.
* Competent to handle and manage data in accordance with FAIR data, ALCOA+ principles

**Personal Attributes**

* Works independently, takes ownership, and makes sound decisions.
* Communicates complex scientific topics clearly to different stakeholders.
* Builds effective cross-functional relationships.
* Identifies risks early and solves problems proactively.
* Supports team development through coaching and knowledge sharing.

  
**Additional Information**

**People are at the heart of what we do:**

* Once a year Full body check
* Competitive insurance scheme
* Employee assistance program – to take care of your and your loved ones mental health
* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves
* Education assistance – for your career growth
* People first culture translated into ‘*Most Preferred place to work 2022-23 by Times group’*

jobs.description:
**Vacancy for Team Manager Production - CU at Pune**

Join us as a Team Manager Production - CU based in Pune to drive customer order execution, according to the agreed plan and in line with our priorities safety, quality, delivery and cost. First line manager. Coordinate between different processes and support functions.

**About the Company:**

In Alfa Laval, we are every single day contributing to a more sustainable future for our planet through engineering innovation. Our global team designs and implements the refining, recycling and purifying process that allow our customers to be better themselves. You will find our work in leading applications for water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, pharmaceutical development and much more. The people of Alfa Laval enjoy the freedom to pursue ideas and the resources to see those ideas to become reality, in an environment that welcomes drive, courage and diversity. The result is a company where we all can be very proud of what we do.

Our core competencies are in the areas of heat transfer separation, and fluid handling. We are dedicated to optimizing the performance of our customers' processes. our world-class technologies, our systems, equipment and services must create solutions that help our customers stay ahead. Please feel free to peruse our website www.alfalaval.com.

**The position / About the Job:**

In this job the Team Manager Production eensure that manufacturing processes run reliably and efficiently to get predicable and sustainable output. As process owner be responsible for:

  

* + safety of the people, processes and manufactured/delivered products
  + quality + Q-system
  + delivery
  + cost
* As owner secure the quality, via SOP audit dialogues, and execution of the SOPs
* By own presence drive performance of the team and employees
* Be responsible for own cost account, P4
* Drive performance meetings, improvement meetings and related activities
* Be a link between the factory and support functions for daily issues
* Control of quality, deviations and line stops
* Provide the team with relevant information
* Set and follow up targets for the team and each employee, broken down from unit level
* Perform audits according to ALPS
* Well familiar with handling of various type of CNC machines and controllers, aware of programs and tooling etc.
* Troubleshooter - Problem analysis & resolution by using various tools/ techniques
* Planning for optimum utilization of resources (man, Machine, Method and Material)
* Ensure all relevant procedures are described in the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensure compliance. Eg Alfa Laval production system / ISO9001 / ISO45001 / Food / PED etc
* Facilitate and initiate continuous improvement activities and safeguard the quality and necessary documentation

**Expectations & Responsibilities:**

* Production planning: Create Period program based on customer demand, material availability, and employee availability.
* Production process: Monitor and manage the production process to ensure efficiency and delivery as per commitment.
* Quality control: Collaborate with quality control teams to ensure finished goods meet drawings and quality standards requirements.
* Equipment maintenance: Ensure that manufacturing equipment is properly maintained (CLIT)
* Cost management: Manage production costs and adhere operational budgets.
* Inventory management: Work with the buyers to manage inventory levels in WIP and Finish stock
* Improvement in Productivity OYO
* Coordination within and other departments like manufacturing and support functions and Identify potential risks & pressure points so that Quality standards are not compromised within the factory
* Drive Behavior Based Safety culture and monitor the progress in the factory.
* Monthly updating of functional KPIs for Safety for Near Miss, injuries and follow-up.
* Provide support and active participation in ALPS Installation activities.
* By own presence drive performance by mapping & coaching/developing competence of TME’s
* undefined

**Who you are?**

As a Team Manager Production, you are responsible to drive result through people, be open and communicative, should have high integrity and have a strategic perspective

**What you can be?**

* undefined
* Degree in Mechanical/ Production with 7-10 years of experience in a production / Manufacturing company.
* Leadership and management skills
* Experience from improvement tools, e g 5S, Six Sigma, Kaizen
* Production finance
* Manufacturing process and techniques**-** Machining (CNC and Conventional), welding, Surface treatment, Flow forming, Pressing and packaging, Knowledge of special processes (painting, shot blasting, tinning etc etc..) and Metallurgical , Calibration

**Authority Level:**

  

* Financial authority to execute within the team´s P4 costing update frame.
* To decide capacity transfer in and out from the cell.
* To stop production in the cell in case of safety / quality / environmental deviations.
* To make ALPS (Alfa Laval Production System) audits and take corrective actions in case of deviations.

* We offer you an interesting and challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value for our customers.

jobs.description:
**Main Responsibilities / Job Summary**

1. **Product manufacture**

Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.

Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.

Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.

Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

2. **Compliance**

Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestlé policies, standards and legal requirements.

Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.

Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

3. **Maintenance integration**

Coach / train, with related parties, the technicians and operators in preventive / routine maintenance activities and machinery operations.

Ensure that CDM is fully integrated with factory operations and all operators / technicians understand and practice CDM.

4. **Data management / Systems**

Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)

Measure, analyse and control maintenance & improvement (M&I) budget and spare parts inventory by using available system / tools (NEE).

Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

5. **Continuous Improvement**

Review process failures and execute continuous improvement activities by identifying opportunities, accessing proposals and timely implementation.

Support projects (team) by setting up / installation of new equipment, test run and ensuring readiness for mass production. Wherever required, participate in standard audits (HACCP, FSMS, GMP etc.)

Ensure that the equipment history, damage code and root cause analysis are completed correctly.

6. **Knowledge management and people development**

Coach and mentor, the members of team to increase productivity and efficiency by participating in daily meetings, reviewing actions.

Train the team on safety and environmental requirements and procedures.

Review and feedback to direct reports of their performance against their principal accountabilities and behavioural competencies so as to continually improve individual and team operational and/or technical capability in line with site skills and behavioural requirements.

Communicate information flows from the management to the direct reportees and vice versa.

7. **Area of responsibility**

* Maintenance of filling & packing machines as core responsibility along with process machinery.
* Maintenance budget preparation & day to day management with strong tracking with preventive mindset
* Spares parts management for the plant, Maintenance planning & scheduling
* Engineering contractual management including development & Day to day people management of internal & external
* Problem solving techniques (GSTD, BDA, DMAIC etc,)
* Project management skills will be an added advantage
* Exposure to primary packing (horizontal flow wrapper, vertical form fills sealing machine, can/Jar filling machines, product auto feeding system into the flow wrappers), secondary packing (auto case packing, top loading, or front loading, COBOT or Robo based auto pick & place machines into grey boxes or shippers)

jobs.title: Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

We are building and enhancing ecommerce data and technology capabilities for our North America (NAR) Sales organization. These capabilities bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, and retail media data to support business reporting, analytics, and decision-making across ecommerce channels. As Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities (Ecommerce), you will work with Sales, Ecommerce, and D&T teams to understand business requirements and support the delivery of data and technology solutions. You will contribute to the development and enhancement of ecommerce data products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical capabilities. The role involves working with data engineering, BI, analytics, and technology teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, support solution development and testing, and ensure reliable delivery.Success in this role requires experience working with data and technology solutions, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage assigned deliverables in a collaborative environment. You will support solution quality, data validation, implementation, and ongoing improvements while working closely with business and technical partners.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

You will work with Sales, Ecommerce, Operating Unit business partners, and D&T teams to understand requirements and contribute to the delivery and support of reliable data and technology solutions:

  

* Bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, retail media, and other relevant data to provide NAR Sales with an integrated view of ecommerce performance; diagnose growth drivers and performance gaps.
* Frame business questions as analytical approaches, develop hypotheses, combine data sources, validate findings, and deliver evidence-based recommendations.
* Apply understanding of ecommerce business models, retailer platforms, marketplaces, quick commerce, and online grocery to identify channel performance drivers.
* Assess NielsenIQ, Circana, Numerator, retailer first-party/POS, digital shelf, and retail media data for quality, coverage, limitations, and suitability; communicate caveats.
* Measure digital shelf and retail media performance, including content quality, search visibility, availability, click-through and conversion rates, ROAS, and incremental sales where data permits.
* Partner with analysts, data engineers, project managers, BI developers, solutions architects, and business stakeholders across Sales, Ecommerce, and Operating Units to coordinate business logic and technical requirements for analytics solutions.
* Build trusted relationships across Sales, Ecommerce, Marketing, Category Management, Operating Units, and technology teams; communicate findings clearly and influence decisions.
* Serve as the ecommerce analytics SME for assigned workstreams; advise on data, processes, and solution options, and support measurement standards, data quality, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to run, operate, and transform activities for assigned analytics capabilities, coordinating priorities, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution with partners.
* Partner with technical teams on unit and integration testing, data-quality checks, and automation; constructively challenge assumptions and support solutions that meet performance, quality, reliability, and responsiveness expectations
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications, including data requirements, dependencies, expected outputs, and acceptance criteria. Seek clarification from business partners and technical teams as required.
* Support the development and maintenance of ecommerce reporting and capabilities by implementing business-defined measures and ensuring the underlying data and technology solutions are reliable and accessible. Business teams retain ownership of metric definitions and performance interpretation.
* Work with data and engineering teams to understand, validate, and integrate data from syndicated and retailer sources, including retailer first-party/POS data, digital shelf, and retail media platforms. Support data quality checks, identify and resolve data issues, and help ensure data is reliable and fit for its intended use.
* Collaborate with data engineering, data science, BI, product, and technology teams to develop and support ecommerce data products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical tools, contributing to requirements, development, testing, implementation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Manage assigned D&T deliverables and coordinate with relevant partners to track progress, dependencies, issues, and implementation activities. Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvements to ensure assigned data products and technology solutions remain reliable and fit for purpose.

jobs.title: D365 Business Central Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Agrocorp International is a Singapore-headquartered agri-commodity trading and processing group operating across more than a dozen countries. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is our core ERP platform, and we are rolling it out across group entities while deepening its use in those already live.

This is a central group role, not one tied to a single entity or site. You will lead implementations across new entities and manufacturing facilities, contribute to the redesign of our existing environment, and build the integrations and automation connecting Business Central to our wider systems landscape. The role suits someone who has moved beyond support into implementation — comfortable owning configuration and design decisions, and holding implementation partners to account on quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Business Central implementations for new group entities — functional design, configuration, testing and deployment across finance, supply chain, inventory, procurement and sales.
* Implement and configure the manufacturing module for our processing plants: production BOMs, routings, work and machine centres, production orders, consumption and output posting, MRP and replenishment, lot traceability, production costing and yield variance. Support co-product and by-product costing design.
* Contribute to the redesign of our existing Business Central environment — posting processes, system logic, reporting and financial process alignment — and replace bespoke customisation with standard functionality where possible.
* Define and support integrations between Business Central and Salesforce, banking platforms, warehouse and plant systems. Own data migration: master data, opening balances, validation and reconciliation.
* Use AI tooling actively in delivery — requirements analysis, functional documentation, configuration design, test scripts and data preparation — to shorten implementation cycles.
* Design and build agentic workflows within and around Business Central to automate routine business and system processes.
* Track new Business Central features across Microsoft's release waves, assess their relevance and bring forward those that replace manual effort or existing customisation.
* Work with implementation partners and vendors, reviewing deliverables and functional specifications against agreed requirements. Act as the internal subject matter expert across the group and support site-based team members.
* Design and lead UAT, deliver user training, and provide go-live and hypercare support including on-site presence where required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 4–7 years implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, with demonstrated hands-on manufacturing module experience in a live environment.
* Working knowledge of core accounting within an ERP: chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, period close, inventory valuation.
* Full implementation lifecycle experience — requirements, fit-gap, configuration, data migration, testing, training and go-live — including Configuration Packages / RapidStart.
* Strong documentation, analytical and stakeholder communication skills, and willingness to travel internationally for implementation phases.

**Preferred**

* MB-800 certification; process manufacturing, food or agri-processing experience.
* Understanding of AL extensions sufficient to review and specify development work.
* API and OData integration experience, particularly Salesforce to Business Central.
* Power Platform and Power BI; multi-entity, multi-currency and intercompany setups.
* Practical experience applying AI tooling or building agentic workflows in a business systems context.

**Job Summary**

The Quality Manager leads the Quality Assurance team and drives scalable, standardized quality practices across the GBS organization. Through root cause analysis and continuous improvement, the role enables operational excellence and sustainable performance.

* Partner with Operations, Process Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to standardize quality practices, resolve systemic issues, and support the onboarding of new processes into the Quality framework.
* Identify, implement, and replicate quality best practices across functions, processes, and locations to strengthen consistency and business outcomes.
Periodically assess the effectiveness of the QA framework and influence stakeholders to advance a proactive, data-driven, and continuous-improvement-focused quality culture.  

  

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Proven ability to transform Quality functions through automation, analytics, and AI-driven monitoring, reducing manual effort while increasing business impact.
* Strong track record of translating quality insights into root-cause-driven improvement initiatives that deliver measurable operational and customer outcomes.
Experience building and scaling standardized Quality frameworks across Shared Services, GBS, BPO, or Contact Center environments, driving consistency, governance, and continuous improvement globally.  

  

**Why Choose Us?**

* Play a key role in transforming Quality into a data-driven, technology-enabled function that influences business outcomes across a global organization.

Accelerate your growth through learning and development programs, while building your career in an inclusive, collaborative environment that empowers people to learn, lead, and make a lasting impact.
