jobs.description:
Designation: Sr. Executive / Executive - R&D and Production (Cheese)

Qualification: M.Tech / B.Tech - Dairy Technology / Food Technology / Food Science or similar qualification.

Experience: 4 - 8 Years

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Description:**

**Production & Process Management :**

* **End-to-End Production:** Supervise daily cheese production activities including milk standardization, pasteurization, curd preparation, cutting, molding, pressing, salting, and ripening.
* **Process Standardization:** Design and standardize critical processing parameters such as temperature, pH, coagulation, curd stretching, and syneresis (moisture control) to ensure product consistency.
* **Equipment Operations:** Operate, troubleshoot, and validate pilot-scale and industrial cheese-making equipment including cheese vats, separators, molders, and brining systems.

**Research, Development & Innovation (R&D)**

* **New Product Development:** Conceptualize, formulate, and commercialize new cheese varieties, including Mozzarella, Cheddar, Processed, Gouda, Brie, and regional artisanal cheeses.
* **Experimentation:** Innovate with adjunct cultures, enzymes, emulsifiers, and stabilizers to create differentiated flavor profiles and optimize product texture.
* **Yield Optimization:** Collaborate with production teams to scale lab trials to commercial levels while optimizing yield, cost efficiency, and quality consistency.

**Affinage (Cheese Ripening & Aging)**

* **Climate Control:** Manage cheese caves and aging facilities by strictly monitoring curing conditions like humidity (often above 90%), temperature (usually around 10°C), and aeration to promote proper microbial activity.
* **Maturation:** Turn, rotate, and apply surface treatments or washes to cheeses at appropriate intervals to maximize optimal drainage, even ripening, and flavor development.

**Quality Assurance & Food Safety Compliance**

* **FSSAI Compliance:** Ensure all formulations, packaging, and labeling comply strictly with FSSAI regulations and international food safety standards.
* **Safety Protocols:** Monitor Critical Control Points (CCP) in compliance with food safety frameworks like FSSC 22000 and HACCP.
* **Hygiene & Sanitation:** Maintain strict hygiene standards, assess environmental impact, and supervise Clean-In-Place (CIP) and manual sanitation protocols in the production area.
* **Testing:** Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to conduct sensory evaluations, organoleptic testing, and monitor chemical/microbial properties.

**Leadership & Administration**

* **Team Management:** Train, supervise, and guide production operators and junior staff on best practices in cheese handling and safety.
* **Documentation:** Document experimental data, daily production reports, batch records, and formulation processes accurately for audits and traceability, utilizing tools like SAP or other ERP modules.

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:

The Market Surveillance Compliance team sits within the Global Compliance Department. Market Surveillance focuses on establishing surveillances to cover all business units globally. Candidates should have basic knowledge of financial markets and financial products, including equities and derivatives, a genuine interest in the stock market, and a habit of following financial and market news. The role involves supporting surveillance alert reviews, research, investigations, and surveillance-related projects under the guidance of experienced team members.

* Review surveillance alerts and trading activity across equities, derivatives, and fixed income products to identify potential market manipulation, insider trading, and information barrier violations, following established procedures and team guidance.

jobs.title: Purchase In-Charge/ Manager - Food & Beverage Industry
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Purchase Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring purchasing activities across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.

The role involves working closely with Operations Managers, Outlet Managers, and other concerned employees to identify purchasing requirements, source suitable suppliers, negotiate competitive pricing, ensure product quality, monitor supplier performance, and maintain proper purchasing procedures and documentation.

The Purchase Manager is expected to ensure that all outlets obtain the required products and materials at competitive prices, with the right quality and timely delivery, while maintaining cost efficiency and accountability throughout the purchasing process.

Key Responsibilities1. Purchase Coordination

* Coordinate with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to understand daily, weekly, and operational purchasing requirements.
* Ensure purchasing requirements are properly communicated, planned, and fulfilled on time.
* Follow up on pending orders, deliveries, shortages, and urgent requirements.
* Ensure outlets purchase products from approved suppliers wherever applicable.
* Monitor purchasing activities across all brands and identify unnecessary, duplicate, or excessive purchases.
* Support outlets in sourcing products whenever required.
* Coordinate purchases for new outlets, menu launches, promotions, and special operational requirements.

2. Supplier Sourcing & Negotiation

* Identify and develop new suppliers for food products, beverages, packaging, cleaning materials, equipment, and other F&B operational requirements.
* Regularly obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, delivery terms, and payment conditions.
* Negotiate competitive prices, discounts, credit terms, delivery charges, and other commercial benefits.
* Develop alternate suppliers for key products to avoid dependency and supply disruptions.
* Maintain an updated supplier database with contact details, product specifications, pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions.
* Establish professional relationships with suppliers and maintain effective communication.
* Conduct regular market research to identify competitive suppliers and better purchasing opportunities.

3. Cost Control & Price Monitoring

* Monitor prices of frequently purchased products across all outlets and brands.
* Maintain updated price comparison records for major food ingredients and operational supplies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs without compromising product quality.
* Monitor supplier price increases and verify whether such increases are justified based on market conditions.
* Inform Management and Operations of significant price changes affecting food cost and profitability.
* Negotiate better pricing based on purchasing volume, frequency, and long-term business relationships.
* Identify opportunities for savings through alternative products, suppliers, packaging, and purchasing arrangements.

4. Coordination With Operations & Outlet Managers

* Work closely with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to ensure purchasing requirements are fulfilled efficiently.
* Understand outlet consumption patterns, menu requirements, operational priorities, and product specifications.
* Coordinate with Operations before changing suppliers, brands, product specifications, or ingredients.
* Ensure new suppliers and products are evaluated and approved by the concerned Operations team before implementation.
* Resolve supplier-related issues affecting outlet operations.
* Ensure purchasing decisions support operational requirements without compromising service, product quality, or customer experience.

5. Supplier Performance & Quality Control

* Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, pricing, delivery, reliability, and responsiveness.
* Ensure suppliers deliver products according to agreed specifications and quantities.
* Coordinate with outlets regarding complaints, rejected products, damaged goods, poor quality, and short deliveries.
* Follow up with suppliers for replacements, refunds, credit notes, and corrective action.
* Arrange product samples and trials whenever required.
* Ensure suppliers provide necessary food safety documentation, product specifications, expiry details, and other relevant documents.
* Identify and replace suppliers who repeatedly fail to meet company requirements.

6. Purchase Documentation & Approval Procedures

* Ensure purchases are supported by proper quotations, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices as applicable.
* Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and authorized approval limits. Make sure that the sytem is updated on the purchase module.
* Maintain proper documentation of supplier quotations, negotiated rates, orders, agreements, and price revisions.
* Verify supplier invoices against agreed prices and approved purchase details.
* Coordinate with Finance regarding invoices, payment terms, outstanding supplier balances, and payment follow-ups.
* Ensure proper transparency and accountability in all purchasing transactions.
* Identify and report unauthorized purchases or deviations from company purchasing procedures.

7. Purchasing Monitoring & Reporting

* Monitor purchasing expenditure across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.
* Maintain records of major purchases and supplier pricing.
* Prepare regular reports on:
* Purchasing expenditure by outlet and brand.
* Supplier-wise purchases.
* Price comparisons.
* Cost-saving achievements.
* Supplier price increases.
* Pending orders and delivery issues.
* Emergency and unplanned purchases.
* Supplier performance and complaints.
* Highlight areas where purchasing costs can be reduced or purchasing procedures improved.
* Submit reports and recommendations to Management on a regular basis.

8. New Suppliers & Product Development

* Identify suppliers for new menu items, ingredients, beverages, packaging, and operational requirements.
* Source customized and portion-controlled food products where required by the Operations Team.
* Research local manufacturers, catering suppliers, food processors, and alternative vendors.
* Arrange samples, quotations, and product trials for evaluation.
* Support Operations in sourcing products for new menus, seasonal promotions, and business requirements.
* Explore new products and alternatives that can improve cost efficiency and operational convenience.

9. Compliance & Ethical Purchasing

* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and approval procedures.
* Maintain transparency in supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing decisions.
* Avoid conflicts of interest and ensure no personal benefits, commissions, or unauthorized arrangements are received from suppliers.
* Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, commercial agreements, and company information.
* Report any irregularities, unauthorized commitments, or supplier-related concerns to Management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Purchase Manager's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Cost savings achieved through supplier negotiations.
* Competitive supplier pricing and regular price benchmarking.
* Timely fulfilment of outlet purchasing requirements.
* Reduction in emergency and unplanned purchases.
* Supplier quality, reliability, and delivery performance.
* Effective identification of alternate suppliers.
* Accuracy and completeness of purchase documentation.
* Compliance with company purchasing and approval procedures.
* Responsiveness to Operations and Outlet Managers.
* Reduction in unnecessary purchasing expenditure.
* Timely reporting and purchasing transparency.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3-5 years of purchasing/procurement experience
* **Valid UAE Driving License (Mandatory)**
* Strong negotiation and supplier management skills
* Experience in sourcing, purchasing, and inventory control
* Ability to handle multiple ou

Based at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai within the Restaurants, Bars & Experiences department in Dubai, the Barista will offer and prepare an outstanding selection of creative beverages. jobs.title: Retail Sales Executive
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Retail Sales Lead

**Industry** - FMCG / Snacking / Food & Beverages / Confectionery

**Role Overview**

The Retail Sales Lead will own the UAE retail business across distributors and retailer accounts. The role combines sales, distribution, trade marketing, merchandising, account management, commercial planning, and P&L ownership. The candidate will work closely with distributors and key retail partners to build joint business plans, drive sell-in and sell-out, improve distribution and visibility, and ensure strong execution across stores and channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Retail Sales & Key Account Management**

 Own sales and business development across assigned UAE retail accounts, including modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience, specialty retail and other relevant channels.

 Build and maintain strong commercial relationships with retailer buying, category, trade marketing and merchandising teams.

 Lead commercial negotiations covering listings, pricing, promotions, visibility, trade terms, displays, launches and annual business plans.

 Develop account-level sales plans and deliver monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.

 Track sell-in, sell-out, stock levels, distribution, rate of sale and promotional performance by account.

**2. Distributor Management & Distribution**

 Manage company's UAE distributor relationships and act as the primary commercial interface between the company, distributor and retail accounts.

 Set distributor targets, channel plans, assortment priorities, inventory norms and execution KPIs.

 Build Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with distributors covering revenue, distribution, new listings, promotions, inventory, working capital and marketing investments.

 Review distributor performance regularly and drive corrective actions where required.

 Ensure effective order planning, stock availability, replenishment and distribution across priority retail outlets.

 Monitor distributor inventory, ageing, returns, expiries and receivables to protect business economics.

**3. P&L & Commercial Ownership**

 Own and manage account/channel-level commercial P&Ls and understand revenue, gross margin, trade spends, discounts, promotional investments and contribution economics.

 Track actuals versus budget and identify opportunities to improve revenue quality and profitability.

 Evaluate promotional ROI, retailer investments, listing fees, visibility spends and distributor margins.

 Work with finance and management on forecasts, budgets, sales plans and commercial decisions.

**4. Trade Marketing & Joint Business Planning**

 Develop retailer-specific and distributor-specific annual and quarterly Joint Business Plans.

 Plan and execute trade marketing calendars across promotions, launches, sampling, activations, displays and in-store visibility.

 Coordinate with marketing teams to translate brand campaigns into effective retail execution.

 Identify category growth opportunities and recommend relevant activations, offers and visibility initiatives.

 Measure the commercial impact of trade marketing investments and continuously improve ROI.

**5. Merchandising & In-Store Execution**

 Own in-store visibility and merchandising standards across key retail accounts.

 Ensure correct shelf placement, planogram compliance, secondary displays, POSM deployment, pricing visibility and promotional execution.

 Conduct regular market/store visits and identify gaps in availability, visibility, pricing and execution.

 Work with distributors and merchandising teams to close execution gaps quickly.

 Build a strong understanding of the UAE retail landscape, including store formats, shopper behaviour and category dynamics.

**6. New Business Development**

 Identify and open new retail, convenience, specialty and institutional opportunities relevant to company.

 Develop retailer pitches, commercial proposals and launch plans for new accounts.

 Build a pipeline of prospective retail partners and manage the full process from prospecting to listing and execution.

 Support expansion into new channels and emirates as the business scales.

**7. Reporting & Business Reviews**

 Prepare weekly and monthly sales and distribution reports covering revenue, sell-out, inventory, distribution, promotions and key account performance.

 Lead periodic business reviews with distributors and retailer partners.

 Provide management with clear market intelligence, competitor activity, pricing observations and account-level opportunities.

 Use data to identify gaps and convert insights into specific commercial actions.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

 4–7 years of relevant experience in UAE sales, retail sales, distribution, key account management or trade marketing.

 Mandatory on-ground UAE experience with established relationships and practical knowledge of the UAE retail ecosystem.

 Experience in FMCG, snacking, confectionery, food & beverages, nutrition, consumer products or a closely related category.

 Experience working directly with UAE distributors and major retail accounts.

 Demonstrated experience in negotiating retailer terms, promotions, listings, merchandising and joint business plans.

 Strong commercial understanding of P&L, margins, trade spends, distributor economics and promotional ROI.

 Strong analytical, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

 Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

 Willingness to travel extensively across the UAE and spend significant time in-market and in stores.

 UAE driving licence is preferred.

Application Question(s):

* What's your current based location?
* Do you have experience in FMCG, snacking, or confectionery, or a closely related category?
* Do you have experience of working with UAE distributors and major retail accounts including modern trade and supermarkets?
* How many years of experience do you have in B2B sales?
* What's your current salary, AED/month
* What's your expected salary, AED/month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**The Role**

The Restaurant General Manager is accountable for the commercial and operational success of ULA, driving revenue growth, profitability, guest satisfaction and consistent service excellence.

The role is to position ULA as a leading beachfront dining and lifestyle destination, attract both in-house and external guests, build loyalty and develop experiences that keep the venue competitive.

Working closely with Marketing, Culinary and Food & Beverage teams, the Restaurant General Manager will drive business development, events and promotions, optimize performance and lead a motivated, high-performing team.

**Key Deliverables and Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Achieve revenue and profit targets by growing covers, average guest spend, beverage sales and repeat business.
* Strengthen ULA’s reputation as a leading dining and beachfront lifestyle destination in Ras Al Khaimah and the wider UAE market.
* Develop commercial action plans with Marketing, including targeted promotions, brunches, events and seasonal activations, with measurable results.
* Proactively generate external business through relationships with UAE residents, corporate clients, event organizers and relevant partners.
* Grow guest loyalty through personalized service, guest recognition and relationship management.
* Monitor competitors, trends, demand patterns and guest preferences; develop strategies for weekdays and off-peak periods.
* Partner with Culinary and Beverage teams on menu engineering, seasonal offerings, new concepts and profitable dining experiences.
* Monitor reservations, conversion, table utilization and campaign or event performance to identify revenue opportunities.

**2. Restaurant Operations & Service Quality**

* Oversee ULA’s daily restaurant, bar and assigned beach/poolside guest operations, ensuring efficient and coordinated service.
* Maintain high standards of food and beverage quality, presentation, service, cleanliness and the overall guest experience.
* Maintain a strong presence on the floor, actively engaging with guests and supporting the team.
* Ensure consistent service standards, operating procedures and brand requirements across all assigned guest areas.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and ensure effective service recovery.
* Monitor guest feedback, online reviews and satisfaction scores, implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Coordinate with Kitchen, Bar, Entertainment and supporting teams to deliver seamless events and peak-period operations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, responsible alcohol service, health and safety, and applicable venue requirements; coordinate pool/beach safety with designated teams.
* Maintain venue ambience, music, guest flow, facilities and equipment to create an attractive, safe and welcoming environment.

\*

**3. Team Leadership, Training & Development**

* Lead, motivate and inspire the restaurant team to deliver exceptional service and achieve business objectives.
* Create a positive working environment based on teamwork, respect, accountability and employee engagement.
* Ensure effective manpower planning, duty scheduling and productivity management.
* Identify training needs and organize regular training sessions covering service standards, product knowledge, upselling and guest engagement.
* Coach and develop team members through continuous feedback, performance reviews and on-the-job training.
* Identify high-potential employees and support their career development and internal promotion.
* Participate in recruitment, selection and onboarding in collaboration with People & Culture.
* Conduct regular team briefings to communicate business performance, guest feedback and operational priorities.
* Address performance issues promptly and fairly, maintaining professional standards and discipline.
* Lead by example, demonstrating professionalism, integrity and Accor values.

**4. Financial Management & Cost Control**

* Take ownership of outlet revenue, controllable profitability and achievement of approved budgets and targets.
* Prepare and review budgets, forecasts and daily, weekly and monthly performance reports with the Director of Food & Beverage.
* Monitor payroll, labour productivity, food and beverage costs, operating expenses and profit margins.
* Ensure effective inventory management, purchasing controls and stock accuracy.
* Analyze budget variances, product mix and event profitability, implementing timely corrective action.
* Ensure compliance with cash handling, billing, discount and complimentary procedures.
* Optimize resources without compromising service quality or guest satisfaction.

**5. Administration & Coordination**

* Maintain accurate operational records, reports, attendance and payroll documentation.
* Coordinate leave plans and staffing requirements in line with business demand.
* Attend Food & Beverage departmental meetings and contribute to business planning.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Culinary, Finance, Engineering, Security and other departments to support venue objectives.
* Ensure required operational documentation, licences, event approvals and safety procedures are maintained.
* Carry out any other reasonable duties assigned by the Director of Food & Beverage.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated against agreed objectives, including:

* **Revenue & Profitability:** Revenue versus budget, growth, average spend, beverage sales, staff and F&B costs, and controllable profit.
* **Business Development:** External guest covers, repeat business, reservations, event and promotion results, and new partnerships.
* **Guest Experience & Quality:** Guest satisfaction, online reputation, service recovery and service standards.
* **People & Culture:** Employee engagement, retention, training, development and team productivity.
* **Operational Excellence:** Service consistency, seat utilization, hygiene, safety and brand compliance.

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**

* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive F&B experience, including 2–3 years in a senior Restaurant General Manager role.
* Proven commercial success in a premium, high-volume restaurant, lifestyle venue, beach club or comparable dining operation.
* Demonstrated ability to grow external business, manage revenue and profitability, and deliver successful events or promotions.
* Strong knowledge of restaurant and bar operations, budgeting, forecasting, cost control and guest experience.
* Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multicultural teams.
* Commercially proactive, creative, guest-focused and results-oriented.
* Excellent communication, organizational, financial and problem-solving skills; familiarity with POS and reservations systems.
* Knowledge of the UAE F&B market, particularly Ras Al Khaimah and Dubai, is an advantage.
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage. Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and peak periods.

Pay: AED14,000.00 - AED15,000.00 per month

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Manager** for AI & Agentic Products to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens—determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define what success looks like for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience in Product Management, including defining Product Vision and owning the Product Roadmap
* Expertise in Agile or SAFe frameworks, with extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments
* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management
* Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
* Familiarity with function calling and multi-agent orchestration concepts (no coding required, but strong conceptual grasp is essential)
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the ROI of automation features
* Capability to manage product lifecycles for non-deterministic software where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable
* Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Showcase of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases using an MVP approach
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

**Work Location: Hyderabad**

**Industry: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)**

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated NPI Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead the industrialization, assembly excellence, reliability engineering, and manufacturing readiness of aerospace-grade motor assemblies and electro-mechanical systems. This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from design transfer through production ramp-up while ensuring compliance with aerospace quality, reliability, and regulatory standards.

  

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in precision motor assembly, electro-mechanical system integration, aerospace manufacturing, tooling development, quality systems, supplier development, and cross-functional team leadership. The role requires a hands-on engineering leader capable of solving complex technical challenges, driving operational excellence, and supporting customers and suppliers throughout the product lifecycle.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1. Electro mechanical Assembly Expertise**

* Lead manufacturing and assembly of high-precision aerospace motors including:

+ BLDC / AC / DC motors
+ Servo motors / actuators
+ High-speed rotating systems

* Deep understanding of:

+ Rotor-stator assembly alignment
+ Dynamic balancing (G-level accuracy)
+ Bearing selection, preload, lubrication techniques
+ Winding processes, insulation systems, varnishing

* Address critical parameters:

+ Runout, concentricity, vibration limits
+ Thermal expansion & heat dissipation
+ Noise and performance stability

* Ensure compliance with aerospace tolerances and traceability requirements

**2. Electro-Mechanical Systems Integration**

* Manage full assembly lifecycle of electro-mechanical products, including:

+ Motors + Controllers + Harnessing + Sensors

* Integration challenges:

+ EMI/EMC considerations
+ Thermal and structural interactions
+ Precision fitment of mechanical + electrical interfaces

* Validate system-level performance under:

+ Vibration, shock, thermal cycling
+ Endurance / life-cycle testing

**3. Advanced NPI & Industrialization**

* Lead end-to-end aerospace NPI programs:

+ Design transfer Proto EVT / DVT / PVT Mass production

* Drive:

+ DFM / DFA optimization
+ Manufacturing readiness reviews (MRR)
+ Risk mitigation plans (DFMEA / PFMEA)

* Establish:

+ Process flow diagrams, control plans, work instructions

* Ensure readiness for:

+ AS9100 audit compliance
+ First-time-right production

**4. Engineering Drawings & CAD Mastery**

* Expert-level capability in CAD drawing reading and interpretation:

+ GD&T (ASME Y14.5 standard preferred)
+ Tolerance stack-up analysis
+ Critical-to-function feature identification

* Ability to:

+ Identify manufacturability risks directly from drawings
+ Suggest design corrections for assembly feasibility

* Work with tools:

+ Creo / NX / SolidWorks

* Drive engineering change management (ECR/ECO)

**5. Tools, Jigs & Fixture Development (Critical Skill Area)**

* Design and validate:

+ Assembly fixtures (alignment, press-fit tools)
+ Coil winding fixtures
+ Rotor balancing setups

* Knowledge of:

+ Pneumatic / hydraulic tools
+ Torque control systems
+ Automated assembly stations

* Focus on:

+ Error-proofing (poka-yoke)
+ Repeatability & precision
+ Cycle time reduction

**6. FAIR, Quality & Aerospace Compliance**

* Lead FAIR (First Article Inspection Report) execution as per AS9102
* Strong exposure to:

+ AS9100, NADCAP (preferred)

* Drive:

+ APQP, PPAP (adapted for aerospace)
+ Control of special processes

* Perform:

+ Root cause analysis (8D, Fishbone, 5 Why)
+ Failure investigations (fractography, wear analysis, misalignment)

**7. Supplier Development & Field Problem Resolution**

* Extensive travel to supplier and customer locations for:

+ Process audits
+ Technical issue resolution
+ Qualification activities

* Manage:

+ Supplier capability assessments
+ Critical component validation (laminations, bearings, shafts)

* Act as technical leader in:

+ Customer escalations
+ On-site troubleshooting of assembly failures

**8. Team Leadership & Execution Excellence**

* Lead cross-functional teams:

+ Mechanical / Manufacturing / Quality engineers

* Drive:

+ Performance management
+ Capability building (technical mentoring)

* Establish:

+ Strong engineering governance
+ Structured problem-solving culture

  

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E / B.Tech / M.E in Mechanical Engineering

  

* 15 to 20 years in:

+ Aerospace / defense / high-reliability EMS
+ Motor assembly and electro-mechanical systems
+ NPI and manufacturing engineering

  

**Critical Technical Competencies**

* Aerospace motor assembly fundamentals
* GD&T mastery & tolerance stack analysis
* FAIR (AS9102), APQP, PPAP
* Fixture/tooling design and validation
* Failure analysis & reliability engineering
* Supplier development and audits

jobs.title: Application Chemist
jobs.description:
#### ***Toshvin Analytical is a place where opportunity meets growth. We believe in providing the best quality service to our clients and in turn, helping businesses grow. We are a team of experienced professionals, looking for bright, motivated and committed individuals.***

#### ***If you are interested in a long-term career with one of the leading instrumentation companies in India, please email your CV to:*** ***careers@toshvin.com***

  

**Position :** Application Chemist

**Reports to :** RM / SM

**Location :** Bangalore

**Minimum Years of Work Experience :** 2 years

**Maximum Years of Work Experience :** 8 years

**Minimum Qualification :** B.Sc. or equivalent Graduation in Organic Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry

**Prefered Qualification :** M.Sc. Or Equivalent Postgraduation in Organic/ Analytical Chemistry or higher

**Maximum Grade in Toshvin :** M1

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in Chromato products

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in GC, GCMS

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* Responsible for providing post sale customer on-site application support on GC, GCMS & GCMS-MS
* Supporting customer method development / method optimisation assistance pertaining to their sample matrices
* Helping customer with method validation support , Trouble shooting of customers application issues
* Demonstrating to customers advanced software capabilities and method packages with sample matrices
* Coordinate with Principals local application lab for any support required to address any unresolved customers application requests
* Conducting application training to customers chemists for effective use and utilization of the system and software
* Preparing effective application support reports detailing activities carried out and final result achieved
* Preparing and making PowerPoint presentations as and when required to customer on application support activity carried out and result achieved

**General Success Behaviours:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* **Collaboration & Teamwork:** Works effectively with others across teams and departments
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly, effectively and professionally
* **Customer & Stakeholder Focus:** Understands the internal and external customer needs
* **Integrity & Ethics:** Acts honestly, maintains confidentiality and upholds company values
* **Results Orientation:** Works proactively, manages time to meet deadlines and priorities
* **Professionalism:** Upholds professional standards and represents the organisation positively
* **Organizational Awareness:** Keeps updated on the organization’s goals and industry trends

**Any specific skills/knowledge required for this position:**

* **1. Chromatography Expertise:**
* Hands-on experience in handling chromatography products such as Gas Chromatography (GC), GC with Headspace (GC-HS), Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Triple Quad Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS). Should be comfortable in operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining these instruments
* Should have handled & managed reasonably sized field sales team members (4 to 5 & more) and also Managers (managing their team)
* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.title: Restaurant Purchase & Stores
jobs.description:
Store & Purchase Executive

**Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

Company Description

Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. (CHPL) is a hospitality-led brand house focused on creating distinct, experience-first dining concepts. Each restaurant is built with a clear identity, rooted in culture, refined through design, and elevated by attentive service and strong culinary execution.

The portfolio includes **Nksha**, an Art Deco-inspired North Indian fine dining concept; **Otoki**, a refined Japanese dining experience defined by precision and authenticity; **Tamak**, a bold North Indian concept centred on warmth and social dining; and **Fieno**, a contemporary Italian restaurant celebrating regional Italian cooking, quality ingredients and warm, refined hospitality.

CHPL approaches restaurant development as brand building rather than outlet expansion, ensuring each concept remains distinctive in character, culinary identity and guest experience.

Role Description

The **Store & Purchase Executive** is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for procurement, receiving, inventory control and store operations across Churchgate Hospitality's restaurant portfolio.

The role works closely with chefs, restaurant managers, finance and vendors to ensure uninterrupted availability of food, beverage, packaging, operating supplies and other restaurant requirements while maintaining appropriate quality, pricing and stock levels.

The Store & Purchase Executive will manage purchase orders, vendor quotations, inward documentation, stock movements and periodic physical inventories. The role requires strong attention to **purchase prices, yields, wastage, consumption patterns and stock variances**, with timely reporting of discrepancies or unusual movements.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily and periodic **purchase requirements** across CHPL restaurants.
* Consolidate outlet indents and issue purchase orders based on approved requirements.
* Obtain and compare **multiple vendor quotations** to maintain competitive pricing and consistent specifications.
* Maintain approved vendor lists and negotiate pricing, credit terms, delivery schedules and product specifications.
* Coordinate closely with chefs and operations teams on availability and specifications of fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, imported ingredients, beverages and dry goods.
* Monitor purchase rates and immediately flag **significant price increases or supplier changes**.
* Receive materials and verify **quantity, quality, weight, specification, batch, expiry and condition** against purchase orders and invoices.
* Ensure strict **FIFO/FEFO** stock rotation and appropriate storage temperatures and conditions.
* Maintain GRNs, purchase orders, invoices, stock-transfer records, return notes and other store documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of **opening stock, inward, outward/issue, transfers, closing stock and consumption**.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them against system stock.
* Investigate and report **stock variances, excess consumption, shortages, damages, wastage and slow-moving items**.
* Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels to prevent both stock-outs and unnecessary overstocking.
* Coordinate inter-outlet stock transfers and maintain proper documentation for every movement.
* Work with Accounts to ensure invoices, purchase orders, GRNs and vendor statements are correctly reconciled.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and traceability for imported and high-value products.
* Support monthly **food cost and beverage cost closing** by providing accurate purchase, consumption and inventory data.
* Maintain store hygiene, organisation, labelling and food-safety standards.
* Assist management with monthly purchase analysis, vendor comparisons and opportunities for procurement savings.

Qualifications

* **2–5 years of experience** in purchasing, stores or inventory control, preferably within restaurants, hotels or hospitality.
* Strong understanding of **food and beverage purchasing and inventory management**.
* Knowledge of restaurant ingredients, especially meat, seafood, dairy, fresh produce, dry goods and imported products, is preferred.
* Experience with **PO, GRN, stock transfer, stock issue and inventory reconciliation** processes.
* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, particularly filters, lookups, pivot tables and inventory/purchase analysis.
* Familiarity with restaurant inventory/POS/ERP systems is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate confidently with vendors while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* Understanding of **FIFO, FEFO, food safety, storage temperatures and hygiene standards**.
* Ability to identify unusual stock variances, price changes and consumption patterns.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Supply Chain, Commerce or a related discipline preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Purchase-price control and vendor competitiveness
* Product availability and reduction of stock-outs
* Inventory accuracy
* Stock variance and wastage control
* Timely PO/GRN/invoice processing
* Vendor delivery and quality performance
* Adherence to approved product specifications
* Monthly stock-closing accuracy
* Reduction of excess and slow-moving inventory
* Timely management reporting

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

JOB DESCRIPTIONField Sales Representative (FSR)

**Company:** Schwifty Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** DUDE – Juice with Nata de Coco  
**Department:** Sales & Distribution  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Field Sales  
**Reporting To:** Area Sales Manager (ASM) / Regional Sales Manager (RSM)  
**Location:** As per assigned territory

About the Company

Schwifty Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is a growing FMCG beverage company offering innovative, youth-focused beverages under its flagship brand, **DUDE – Juice with Nata de Coco**.

We are looking for energetic, target-driven Field Sales Representatives to expand our retail distribution network, acquire new outlets, strengthen distributor relationships, and drive consistent sales growth across assigned territories.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Retail Market Visits & Outlet Acquisition**

* Conduct daily market visits to retail shops, grocery stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and beverage outlets.
* Identify and onboard new retail outlets within the assigned territory.
* Pitch DUDE products to shopkeepers, communicate product benefits, and convince them to purchase and stock the products.
* Generate orders from new and existing retail outlets.
* Ensure effective product placement, shelf visibility, and availability at retail counters and refrigerators.
* Build strong relationships with retailers to encourage repeat orders and long-term business.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with retailers to monitor sales movement and prevent stockouts.

**2. Institutional Sales – College & School Canteens**

* Identify and approach college canteens, school canteens, coaching institutes, and other educational institutions.
* Meet canteen owners, contractors, and purchase decision-makers to introduce DUDE beverages.
* Negotiate commercial terms and secure product listings and initial orders.
* Coordinate product sampling and promotional activities wherever required.
* Ensure consistent product availability and regular replenishment at onboarded institutions.
* Develop long-term relationships with canteen operators to increase repeat sales and product penetration.

**3. Distributor Management & Sales Coordination**

* Coordinate regularly with assigned distributors to ensure smooth product supply and market coverage.
* Monitor distributor stock-in (incoming inventory) and stock-out (outgoing inventory) movements.
* Ensure sufficient stock availability across all DUDE SKUs and prevent stock shortages.
* Support achievement of **primary sales targets** (company-to-distributor billing).
* Drive **secondary sales targets** (distributor-to-retailer/institution billing).
* Coordinate with distributors for timely order processing, dispatches, and deliveries.
* Track slow-moving inventory and proactively recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor distributor performance, stock rotation, and sales movement.

**4. Sales Target Achievement & Market Expansion**

* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Increase the number of active retail outlets and institutional accounts within the territory.
* Maximize product availability, visibility, and sales volume across all assigned outlets.
* Generate repeat business through consistent retailer engagement and order follow-ups.
* Identify untapped markets and potential sales opportunities.
* Execute company sales schemes, promotional offers, and market activation initiatives.

**5. Merchandising & Brand Visibility**

* Ensure proper display and positioning of DUDE beverages at retail outlets.
* Place promotional materials such as posters, danglers, shelf strips, and other POSM.
* Encourage retailers to provide prominent shelf and refrigerator placement.
* Conduct regular visibility checks and ensure merchandising standards are maintained.
* Support in-store sampling and promotional campaigns to improve product awareness and consumer trials.

**6. Market Intelligence & Daily Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of daily market visits, new outlet onboarding, orders, and sales achievements.
* Submit Daily Sales Reports (DSR) to the reporting manager.
* Track retailer feedback, competitor pricing, trade schemes, and market activities.

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

Guided by our employee value proposition, **Lead Today. Create Tomorrow,** we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our **One Hershey** mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Sr Executive - QRC leads shift-level Quality & Regulatory Compliance activities across aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing. The role ensures effective in-process controls, product quality, food safety and regulatory compliance while managing deviations, consumer complaint investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. It also provides technical guidance to QRC and shop-floor teams and collaborates cross-functionally to uphold Hershey Quality and Food Safety standards.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

Lead shift-level quality assurance for aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing, including monitoring critical process and quality parameters.

Ensure in-process controls, product analysis, and timely escalation and disposition of quality deviations.

Identify process and product deviations and collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions on root cause analysis and CAPA.

Conduct food safety, GMP, and hygiene audits and ensure timely closure of observations.

Support HACCP activities and reinforce food safety controls across processing and packaging stages.

Support regulatory compliance for food safety and packaging and sustain readiness for GFSI, Hershey Global Standards, and HALAL certification requirements.

Investigate consumer complaints, establish root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Drive continuous improvement opportunities in product quality, process control, and food safety.

Maintain accurate quality records and shift reports and communicate quality risks and actions to stakeholders.

Provide technical guidance and shift leadership to staff and worker employees and collaborate with internal and external partners on relevant best practices.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

Experience:

Minimum 5-6 years of experience in a food, beverage, or aseptic packaging environment, primarily in Quality and Food Safety. Strong knowledge of GMP, HACCP, sanitation and hygiene standards, process quality controls, packaging compliance, Quality and Food Safety Management Systems, root cause analysis, CAPA, deviation management, and consumer complaint investigation is required.

Education:

Graduate or postgraduate degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

----------------------------------------

The Senior Microbiologist is responsible for microbiological quality assurance and food safety activities across six manufacturing lines and ten SKUs. The role supports product safety and release by leading microbiological sampling and testing, environmental and hygiene monitoring, laboratory and shift activities, audit readiness, documentation, corrective actions, GMP implementation, and microbiology performance reporting.

Manage the Environmental Microbiological Monitoring Program (EMMP), personnel hygiene monitoring, and ATP monitoring.

Support validation of cleaning and sanitation programs and troubleshoot microbiological issues.

Manage microbiology shift activities and maintain microbiology laboratory management system documentation and records.

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) meetings for microbiological issues, follow up actions, and report outcomes.

Handle and report proficiency testing activities and verify microbiology records.

Conduct weekly and monthly GMP and personnel hygiene audits and support audit readiness.

Train food handlers on GMP and encourage a Right First Time quality culture.

Perform trend analysis of plant microbiology issues and prepare monthly KPI and data reports.

Support SAP release of finished goods.

Experience:

Minimum 4-5 years of experience handling microbiological analysis of food products and/or beverages. Sound microbiology knowledge and ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues are required, along with team management, influencing, and communication skills.

Education:

M.Sc. in Microbiology.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Buying
jobs.description:
**We are seeking a Product Owner with deep retail business platforms expertise to lead the full product development lifecycle within the Buying and Sourcing domains. This is an end-to-end ownership role — from discovery to delivery — requiring strong domain knowledge in retail buying and sourcing operations, advanced hands-on AI skills, and the ability to independently drive a skilled engineering team without day-to-day management overhead.**

* Own and drive the full product development lifecycle within the Buying & Sourcing domain — discovery, PRD, story writing, delivery, testing, and rollout — with full accountability for outcomes, not just process.
* Lead and engage a skilled, and independent engineering team; set clear priorities, remove blockers, and create the conditions for the team to move fast without constant hand-holding.
* Work directly with buying and sourcing business teams across brands to understand end-to-end workflows, capture pain points, and design platform-first solutions through structured discovery, live walkthroughs, and rapid prototyping and experimentations.
* Apply advanced AI skills across the product development lifecycle — discovery mocks, PRD and spec generation and engineering acceleration — and bring a strong point of view on where AI can embed intelligence directly into buying and sourcing workflows.
* Translate business requirements into well-defined workstreams and hold a high bar for engineering-ready specs that do not require repeated clarification.
* Lead concept rollout — onboarding new departments and brands, running UAT with business stakeholders, and driving adoption and change management with minimal escalation.
* Define and track input & output metrics to measure feature impact and guide prioritization.
* Maintain a clear understanding of system integrations across — Planning , PIM, Merchandising and PLM — and how integration states affect buying and sourcing workflows.
* Champion process standardization across concepts; challenge per-concept customization that creates technical debt and drive alignment on platform-first, scalable workflows.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership; prepare and present updates independently without requiring significant oversight.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

**Job Experience**

* **5–8 years of overall experience**
  with at least 3 years in a Product Owner role with end-to-end ownership — discovery through delivery — in a business platform environment.
* Demonstrated experience working on business platforms in a retail context is a must; enterprise SaaS or consumer app-only experience alone is not sufficient.
* Buying and sourcing domain exposure in a retail or fashion context is strongly preferred; candidates who understand the end-to-end buying & procurment cycle will be prioritized.
* Advanced, hands-on AI skills are mandatory — not just familiarity. Must demonstrate practical use of AI across the product development lifecycle: discovery acceleration, PRD and spec generation, prototyping, test case design, and engineering productivity. A strong point of view on embedding AI into operational workflows is expected.
* Proven ability to independently lead and engage a small, skilled engineering team — setting direction, managing priorities, and creating delivery momentum without requiring day-to-day oversight of team output.
* Experience with PLM systems (Bamboo Rose, Centric, or similar) is a strong added advantage.

**Required Leadership Skills**

* Independently drives full product development — from blank-page discovery to shipped capability — without needing to be managed. Owns outcomes, not just tasks.
* Strong engineering team engagement — creates clarity, sets pace, and builds trust with a skilled team that needs direction and sharp prioritization, not micromanagement.
* Structured stakeholder management — holds productive discovery conversations with senior business leaders and translates outcomes directly into engineering-ready specifications.
* Drives clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving requirements; does not wait for perfect information before moving forward.
* Clear, confident communicator — runs workshops, stakeholder reviews, and leadership updates independently and with credibility.
* Bias toward standardization and scalable platform thinking — challenges requests that create per-concept complexity and advocates for workflows that hold across multiple brands.
* High bias for action in a fast-moving environment where processes and norms are still being built.

jobs.title: Brand Manager, NOW (Leading Nutraceutical Brand)
jobs.description:
The
**Brand Manager, NOW (**
www.nowfoods.com) is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned nutraceutical brand across GCC markets, covering strategy development, commercial performance, and operational execution. The role is accountable for delivering revenue growth, profitability, and market share, while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, internal governance standards, and brand guidelines.

The position requires a structured and analytical approach to translating market insights into actionable plans and ensuring consistent execution across multiple channels, including healthcare, e-commerce, modern trade, and tender business. The Brand Manager works closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Digital teams to align priorities, optimise performance, and address operational challenges.

In addition, the role contributes to portfolio development and long-term brand sustainability by identifying growth opportunities, supporting new product initiatives, and strengthening customer and stakeholder engagement. The Brand Manager is expected to operate with a high level of accountability, collaboration, and integrity, in line with NCH Culture, ensuring both business performance and organisational alignment.

**What You Will Own**

Brand Strategy, Business Planning & P&L

* Own the short and long-term strategy for NOW across the GCC, translating market opportunities into clear commercial priorities and growth plans.
* Lead the annual business planning process, setting objectives for revenue, profitability, market share, distribution, portfolio development and brand investment.
* Take direct accountability for the brand P&L, including revenue, gross margin, marketing investment, trade spend and overall profitability.
* Manage the trade-offs between sales growth, margin, investment, pricing, inventory and long-term brand development.
* Lead regular business reviews, identify performance gaps and determine corrective actions to ensure commercial commitments are delivered.

Distribution & Channel Development

* Define and implement distribution strategy, ensuring optimal presence across key accounts, channels, and customer segments.
* Expand distribution in high-potential accounts while rationalising underperforming channels to improve efficiency and return on investment.
* Monitor channel contribution and account performance, reducing over-reliance on single customers or channels.
* Contribute to tender and institutional business planning, supporting pricing, participation decisions, and volume planning in coordination with commercial and regulatory teams.

Marketing Strategy & Budget Governance

* Develop and manage the annual brand marketing and trade budget across offline and online channels, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and ROI targets.
* Allocate resources across medical, trade, and digital activities based on performance data, customer insights, and channel roles.
* Ensure full compliance with brand guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal financial controls.
* Monitor budget utilisation, manage accruals and variances, and optimise spend effectiveness in coordination with Finance.
* Partner with principals to translate global strategies into locally relevant, compliant, and commercially effective marketing plans.

Brand Activation & Omnichannel Execution

* Translate brand strategy into integrated marketing plans covering medical promotion, trade activities, and digital campaigns.
* Ensure consistent execution of brand messaging, positioning, and visual identity across all channels and customer touchpoints.
* Drive campaign effectiveness by continuously evaluating performance and optimising promotional activities.
* Leverage digital platforms and data analytics to enhance customer engagement, improve campaign effectiveness, and support omnichannel growth.

Forecasting, Supply & Inventory Management

* Lead brand-level forecasting and demand planning, ensuring alignment with sales trends, promotional plans, and market dynamics.

* Monitor inventory health, proactively managing slow-moving and near-expiry stock through corrective actions.
* Support lifecycle planning including launches, relaunches, and phase-outs in coordination with relevant functions.
* Identify portfolio gaps and contribute to new product initiatives, line extensions, and portfolio optimisation based on market needs and performance insights.

Field Excellence & Customer Engagement

* Define medical detailing priorities, target segments, and core messages aligned with brand strategy and scientific positioning.
* Develop and refine customer segmentation and targeting strategies to optimise field force effectiveness and resource allocation.
* Ensure field teams are equipped with compliant, up-to-date materials and clear execution objectives.
* Conduct selective field visits to assess execution quality, provide coaching, and ensure alignment with brand standards.

Team Contribution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Support team development through coaching, feedback, and alignment on objectives and priorities.
* Drive effective cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment, speed, and execution excellence.
* Promote a culture of ownership, integrity, and continuous improvement across all interactions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to support brand growth and execution excellence.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Nutrition, or a related field, with an MBA.
* 8+ years of experience in brand management and business development in the wellness/healthcare industry and across channels, including pharmacies, tender and e-commerce channels.
* Strong experience managing teams within nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, consumer healthcare or another relevant consumer-led sector.
* Proven responsibility for a significant brand, category, portfolio or business unit and hands-on experience managing P&L, revenue, gross margin, pricing, budgets and profitability.

**About the Role**

The Research Scientist – Microalgal cultures, is responsible for developing and running the microalgal culture operations of the aquaculture research program. is responsible for the development and implementation of research projects fitting in the Center’s research directions in the topic of microalgae. The Research Scientist will develop methods to carry out hypothesis-led laboratory experiments as well as to study marine ecosystems/populations/individuals in situ. The Research Scientist – Microalgal Cultures, will also contribute in the daily operations of the YSWRR for knowledge dissemination and education.

Main responsibilities include:

* Developing and carrying out research projects aligned with the Center’s priorities
* Leading the maintenance and monitoring of multiple microalgal species

* Leading the quality control of microalgal stock
* Leading the production of scientific communication and articles
* Supporting the Center in its activities and contributing to its overall success
* Supervising high-school and undergraduate students
* Developing local collaborations

**Key Responsibilities**

**Developing and leading the microalgal culturing capabilities of the Center**

* Maintain and culture microalgae strains under laboratory conditions
* Optimize protocols to enhance efficiency, stability and upscaling
* Records information on appropriate production records, logs and other report forms. Provides inputs to reports as required
* Lead experiments and record relevant data
* Prepare and analyze experimental data, documenting results accurately
* Troubleshoot technical challenges related to microalgae, associated equipment and assays

**Leading research projects**

* Acts as Principal Investigator on research projects related to Microalgae to develop proposals and conduct projects; with undertaking and supervision of routine laboratory operations
* Leads the production of high-quality scientific publications, research reports, and other communication material

**Management of research facility and equipment**

* Oversees supply and equipment inventory to sustain research and routine operations
* Supervises the adequate use, schedule and maintenance of the experimental laboratory equipment and facilities of the Center with production of SOPs and check lists/schedules
* Follow laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean work environment

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the research training program
* Supports the rescue and research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRRC projects by performing all other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master degree in marine biology or related fields
* Minimum of 3-year experience in a research laboratory with microalgae culturing facility
* Demonstrated success in publishing research results in refereed scientific journals and peer-reviewed publications
* Evidence of effective communication skills, particularly in communicating research findings to non-academic audiences
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to scientific community, general public, media, government agencies, and non-governmental associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* Previous experience in the GCC region is an advantage
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Packaging Development and Industrialization Director
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Senior Director of Packaging leads the Packaging pole of Product Operations: Packaging Development & Industrialization, and a new Packaging R&D capability. This role owns the technical packaging solution from brief to production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, moves technical risk upstream through risk-based pilots and evidence, and builds proven, PPWR-ready platforms for future launches. It works with an independent End-to-End Quality team.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Packaging Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own the packaging technical strategy and roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Lead two sub-poles, Development & Industrialization and Packaging R&D, through strong leads with clear decision rights.
* Protect R&D time and budget from live-launch pressure; escalate trade-offs to the VP, Product Operations.
* Size the team from real workload and portfolio data.

**Packaging Development & Industrialization**

* Own the technical delivery of every launch, from brief to PPS.
* Run risk-based pathways, set from the 1 to 5 risk score and confirmed by Quality.
* Secure pilot molds and homologation before production tooling for new, high-risk packs.
* Lead drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, functional analysis, DFMA and formula/pack compatibility.
* Own tooling validation, line trials, PPS and scale-up readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers.

**Packaging R&D & Innovation**

* Build and lead Packaging R&D: platforms and technology, advanced development and innovation, Kaizen.
* Build a library of proven packs, supplier standards, design rules and test files.
* Lead technical and experience sourcing.
* Hand concepts over to development only once proven.

**Sustainability & PPWR**

* Own the packaging sustainability roadmap, balancing consumer experience, brand, cost and regulation.
* Lead PPWR readiness for new launches and the existing portfolio, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Set clear ownership: R&D builds PPWR-ready solutions, Development applies them in each launch, Regulatory and Legal advise on compliance.
* Prioritize changes to existing packs by risk and business impact, with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Technical Governance & Risk Ownership**

* Adapt assessments to project risk, with clear ownership, evidence and approval at each checkpoint.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for the Product Operations gates: Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation, Go Prod.
* Own packaging specifications and drive the adoption of the internal specification tool.
* Never trade an unresolved critical risk for cost or timing; any skipped step goes to the Newness Committee.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.
* Respect Quality's independent co-signature of homologation and its ownership of release and CAPA.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging developers, engineers and R&D specialists.
* Recruit and grow sub-pole leads; build succession for critical technical roles.
* Act as a role model for technical rigor and evidence-based decisions.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Commercial and Finance.
* Bring feasibility, cost, timing and risk input at the brief, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Represent Packaging at the Newness Committee and in launch readiness reviews.
* Drive value engineering and COGS improvement without trading critical risk; manage the packaging technical budget

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of complex primary packs from concept through tooling, line trials and scale-up at suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Deep expertise in materials, processes, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and formula/pack compatibility.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, homologation and stage-gate governance.
* Experience building a pre-development, R&D or platform program.
* Proven leader of leaders, delegating through clear decision rights.
* Able to read and challenge CAD models and technical drawings.
* Solid understanding of packaging sustainability and the EU PPWR, and their impact on design, cost and supply.
* Experience with global supplier bases in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of evidence-based judgment, comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 15+ years in packaging development and industrialization, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Chief Growth Officer
jobs.description:
**Our Client**

An established regional food business with a portfolio of brands and categories operating across multiple markets. The next phase of growth calls for sharper portfolio choices, faster innovation and stronger commercial returns.

**Your Role**

Margins are under pressure. Consumer preferences are shifting at different speeds across markets. Innovation cycles don’t always keep pace, and supply chain volatility affects each category differently.

The challenge is not simply to grow the portfolio. It is to decide where growth should come from, which categories and geographies deserve investment, and how to protect profitability while the business evolves.

We are looking for a Chief Growth Officer who has built businesses through marketing and innovation, with direct P&L accountability. Someone who has grown brands across categories and markets, gained share through disruption and understands the commercial consequences of the decisions made.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Portfolio growth:**
  Set priorities across brands, categories and geographies, balancing market share, margin and long-term growth potential.
* **Innovation:**
  Build a consumer-led innovation agenda that responds to changing tastes and delivers profitable, incremental growth.
* **P&L performance:**
  Shape pricing, product mix, investment and channel strategy to improve margins and commercial returns.
* **Market expansion:**
  Identify and scale opportunities across existing and new markets, adapting to different consumer and competitive dynamics.
* **Business leadership:**
  Work across marketing, sales, R&D, supply chain and finance to ensure growth plans are commercially viable and executable.

**Must-Have**

* 18+ years in food or beverage FMCG, with substantial business leadership experience.
* **Direct P&L ownership**
  , not simply marketing budget responsibility.
* A strong marketing and innovation foundation, with evidence of building and scaling brands and categories.
* Experience managing multi-category portfolios across GCC and international markets.
* Demonstrated market share gains, profitable growth and successful innovation through changing market conditions.
* Strong understanding of pricing, portfolio economics, channel profitability and supply chain constraints.
* The judgment to make difficult portfolio and investment decisions, not just recommend them.

jobs.description:

**Robertet**

At
**Robertet Middle East**

Joining Robertet means becoming part of a company that values creativity, technical excellence, entrepreneurship, and passion for the world of scent.

**GC-MS Analyst**
to join our
**Dubai Creative Center**
. Reporting directly to the Managing Director of Robertet Middle East, you will provide analytical support to our Fine Fragrance Division across the region.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of science and perfumery, collaborating closely with our Sales, Evaluation, and Laboratory teams in Dubai, as well as our GC-MS specialists and Perfumers in France. * Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Good laboratory practices (GLP) and laboratory safety awareness.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

**Preferred**

* Basic olfactory skills and the ability to recognize fragrance ingredients and odor profiles.
* Exposure to fragrance reformulation or raw material analysis.
* Knowledge of natural raw materials and essential oils.

**Why Join Robertet?**
