**Marketing Associate – UAE & GCC**

**Location**: Dubai, UAE

**Industry:** FMCG / Food & Beverages / Packaged Foods / Confectionery preferred

**About Company**

The company is a modern snacking and confectionery brand focused on building products for contemporary consumers. As the brand expands across the UAE and GCC, we are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Marketing Associate to help build the brand, lead social media execution, manage agencies and marketing partners, and create strong consumer and commercial activation programs.

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Associate will be a hands-on marketing and brand-building role responsible for driving company's social media and digital marketing efforts across the UAE and GCC. The role will work closely with creative and marketing agencies, influencers, e-commerce platforms, distributors and internal teams to develop ideas, briefs, campaigns and marketing collateral that build the brand and drive commercial growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media & Organic Brand Growth**

* Own the day-to-day social media marketing agenda for company across Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
* Stay connected with current social media trends, formats, creators, memes, cultural conversations and emerging content opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to drive organic reach, engagement, community growth and brand awareness.
* Work with creative teams and agencies to develop high-quality social-first content, reels, static creatives, videos and other formats.
* Track social media performance and continuously recommend improvements based on learnings and consumer response.

**2. Agency & Marketing Partner Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for creative, social media, digital, PR, influencer and other marketing agencies.
* Prepare clear and actionable briefs for agency partners covering objectives, target audience, proposition, deliverables, timelines and expected outcomes.
* Lead regular agency meetings and ensure projects move from brief to execution efficiently.

**3. Brand Strategy & Campaign Ideas**

* Contribute to and develop brand ideas, campaigns and consumer activations for the UAE and GCC markets.
* Translate Company's brand positioning and product proposition into relevant local consumer communication.
* Develop campaign concepts around launches, flavours, products, occasions, cultural moments and consumer trends.

**4. E-commerce & Retail Marketing Collaborations**

* Work directly with e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms to plan and execute marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate with e-commerce partners to secure campaign opportunities, visibility, banners, placements, content and promotional activations.
* Prepare and deliver marketing collateral to e-commerce partners within agreed timelines and specifications.
* Coordinate campaign briefs, creative requirements, product information and commercial inputs with internal and external teams.

**5. Distributor & Trade Marketing Support**

* Work closely with the sales and distribution team to support distributor and retailer marketing requirements.
* Develop marketing collateral and activation ideas for distributor and retail partners.
* Coordinate co-marketing initiatives, launches, sampling, events, retail visibility and other consumer activations.

**6. Creative Development & Design Coordination**

* Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, photographers, agencies and other creative partners.
* Develop clear creative briefs and provide constructive feedback on designs and content.
* Help create marketing collateral including social media creatives, digital banners, product communication, presentations, retailer assets, POSM and campaign materials.

**7. Performance Marketing Understanding**

* Have a good working understanding of Google and Meta advertising ecosystems and the role of paid media in brand growth.
* Work with agencies or internal partners to understand campaign objectives, budgets, targeting, creatives and performance.
* Understand basic metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and conversion.

**8. Campaign Execution & Project Management**

* Own multiple marketing projects simultaneously and ensure deadlines are met.
* Coordinate internal teams, agencies, designers, vendors, e-commerce platforms and commercial partners.
* Create project timelines, action trackers and follow-up mechanisms to ensure timely execution.

**10. Marketing Reporting**

* Prepare regular reports on social media, campaign, agency and partner activity.
* Track key brand and marketing KPIs and communicate key learnings to management.
* Monitor competitor activity and share relevant market intelligence.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand management, social media, digital marketing or an integrated marketing role.
* Strong practical experience managing social media and content marketing activities.
* Experience working with creative/social/digital agencies and managing external marketing partners.
* Working knowledge of Google and Meta advertising and performance marketing concepts; hands-on expertise is not mandatory.
* Good understanding of basic marketing budgets, P&L and campaign economics.
* Experience in FMCG, food & beverage, packaged foods, confectionery, snacking or consumer brands is preferred.
* UAE/GCC market experience is preferred.

* Do you have at least 3 years of marketing experience in the UAE?
* Do you have experience of marketing confectionary products - chocolates?
* What's your current salary AED/month
* What's your expected salary AED/month

**WHO WE ARE**

Sapaad is a global leader in unified commerce platforms, delivering world-class software solutions for the food and beverage industry. Our flagship product, also named Sapaad, has achieved remarkable success over the past decade—empowering thousands of F&B businesses across 40+ countries, with many more coming onboard each day.

Driven by a passionate team of developers, designers, and product experts, Sapaad is constantly evolving—introducing innovative, industry-defining features that set the benchmark for F&B technology. Headquartered in Singapore, with offices across five countries, Sapaad is backed by seasoned technology veterans with deep expertise in web, mobility, and e-commerce.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a driven, field-based Field Sales Executive to join our Sales team in the UAE. This is a hands-on sales role focused on introducing Sapaad’s technology solutions to businesses across the food and beverage industry.

This is a true door-to-door sales role. You will proactively visit businesses, meet owners and managers face-to-face, present the value of Sapaad’s solutions, and convert prospects into customers. You will be responsible for building and managing your own sales pipeline, driving conversions, and consistently delivering against your sales targets.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Hit the field daily:** Visit SME businesses and F&B establishments in your assigned areas, proactively approaching owners, managers, and decision-makers to introduce Sapaad’s technology solutions.

**Build your own pipeline:** Identify prospects independently through area mapping, cold visits, referrals, and other field prospecting activities. Follow up consistently and convert interest into new customers.

**Pitch and demonstrate:** Conduct face-to-face presentations and product demonstrations, highlighting how Sapaad’s solutions can streamline business operations, improve efficiency, and address customers’ business needs.

**Close the deal:** Handle questions and objections, negotiate where needed, present relevant commercial terms, and convert prospects into paying customers.

**Achieve targets:** Work towards individual targets for new customer acquisition and revenue generation, contributing to Sapaad’s growth in the UAE.

**Keep accurate records:** Log visits, leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and pipeline status in the CRM or designated tools.

**Hand over smoothly:** Work with the onboarding and support teams to ensure newly acquired customers are successfully onboarded and their solutions are implemented smoothly.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

**Field sales experience (preferred):** 1 to 3 years in field sales, business development, or a customer-facing role. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and real drive are welcome.

**Confidence in cold approaches:** Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation with the owner.

**Persistence:** A self-motivated, target-driven mindset with the discipline to follow up until the deal closes.

**Clear communication:** The ability to explain a technology product simply to non-technical business owners.

**Objection handling:** The ability to understand a customer’s needs and adjust your pitch for each type of business.

**Self-management:** Good organisation to plan your own daily routes, visits, and follow-ups.

**Field readiness:** Comfortable travelling across the UAE and spending most of the day out of the office.

**Languages:** Fluent English. Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, or other regional languages are an advantage.

**Driving:** A valid UAE driving license is an advantage.

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED6,000.00 per month

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

jobs.title: R&D PDM Associate - Self Care
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.

You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
The role is ideal for a high-calibre individual with the necessary skill set to manage hands on scientific and technical issues on a range of products and projects primarily focussed on a challenging and complex base business resiliency plan to sustain future growth, primarily, the Self-care product portfolio.
  
  
This diverse role is to collaborate with R&D product development teams, other R&D PDM teams, Regulatory, Marketing, Supply and Production groups to deliver “best in market” consumer solutions.

The experience we're looking for

* Working knowledge of CTD modules and regulatory frameworks
* Proven track record as a leader in planning, prioritization and implementing projects as well as identifying costs savings and problem solving
* Proven track record in active collaboration with R&D and non-R&D functions

The skills for success
  
  

* The candidate should be comfortable with ambiguity and be a ‘self-starter’ with the ability to quickly learn and implement to keep up with the fast pace of the role
* Technically diligent and able to grasp new science and visualise a business benefit
* Prioritisation and time management skills are essential
* Stakeholder collaboration, communication and the ability to manage expectations are also key
* Strong leadership, influencing, motivational and interpersonal skills.
* Capable of building strong working relationships and motivating teams to deliver outstanding results.
* Strong negotiating skills.
* Strong analytical and technical skills.
* Ability to anticipate, plan and realize significant projects involving multiple technical and scientific hurdles.
* Ability to perform solid thinking into action (a thinker and an achiever).

* Openness to change and ability to think out of the box.

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. **Company:** Northern Solvents Private Limited

**Compensation:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**Location:** Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About the Company**

Northern Extracts is a manufacturer of oleoresins, essential oils, and herbal extracts, specializing in North Indian herbs and spices. We serve the seasonings, flavors, fragrance, and nutraceutical industries across domestic and international markets.

Our Corporate Office is in Jaipur, with a manufacturing facility in Roopangarh, near Ajmer. The company is committed to quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance, with applications for FSSC 22000, ISO, Kosher, Halal, and FSSAI certifications.

**Role Overview**

To ensure timely procurement, optimum inventory availability, supplier performance, material traceability, and cost-effective purchasing in coordination with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, Stores, Finance, and other functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Purchase & Procurement:** Procure raw materials, essential oil ingredients, botanical materials, packaging, chemicals, and consumables; obtain quotations; negotiate commercial terms; prepare POs; follow up deliveries; and maintain approved suppliers.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain optimum stock, minimum/maximum and safety levels; monitor slow/non-moving and excess stock; conduct physical verification; reconcile ERP records; and ensure FIFO/FEFO and batch-wise control.
* **Material Planning:** Coordinate with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, and Stores; review production plans; prepare MRP; ensure critical material availability; and identify shortages in advance.
* **Food-Grade / Essential Oil Control:** Procure against approved specifications; coordinate COA, food-grade, allergen, MSDS/SDS and origin documentation; support incoming inspection; maintain batch/lot traceability and suitable storage conditions.
* **Vendor Management:** Develop alternate suppliers; negotiate annual/long-term rates where practical; monitor TAT (Turn Around Time), rejection, lead time and competitiveness; resolve supplier issues; and conduct vendor performance reviews.
* **Stores & Warehouse Coordination:** Coordinate inward receipt, GRN (Goods Receiving Note), inspection and issue; maintain identification, labeling and location control; support segregation of approved/rejected/under-inspection/expired materials; and coordinate returns/transfers.
* **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) & Documentation:** Maintain Purchase request, RFQ (Requisition Form), quotation comparison, PO (Purchase Order), GRN (Goods Receiving Note), stock and supplier records; ensure authority-matrix compliance; support audit documentation; and coordinate PO/GRN/invoice matching with Finance.
* **Cost Control:** Identify purchase savings and optimization opportunities; compare historical/market prices; control emergency purchases and excess inventory; and negotiate improved commercial terms without compromising quality or supply continuity.

**Key Competencies**

* Procurement & negotiation
* Inventory planning & stock control
* Vendor management
* MRP / material planning
* ERP-based purchasing
* Food-grade documentation & traceability
* Cross-functional coordination
* Cost optimization
* MIS reporting
* Problem solving

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Purchase/Procurement, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Education: Graduate/Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Commerce, Operations or a related field.
* Good communication, coordination, follow-up and negotiation skills.
* Strong numerical accuracy and documentation skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP/system-based purchasing and inventory transactions.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment and manage time-sensitive material requirements.
* Experience in food, herbal, chemical, pharmaceutical, FMCG or similar manufacturing industries will be an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Based in Jaipur (local candidates preferred)
* Age: 30 years and above
* Self-motivated and disciplined

**Why Join Northern Extracts?**

* Hands-on exposure to Purchase, Stores & Inventory Operations.
* Opportunity to build a career in Procurement, Supply Chain and Manufacturing.
* Cross-functional exposure to various manufacturing and business functions.
* Opportunity to work with experienced professionals and take responsibility.

jobs.description:
The research group of Prof. Sunil Kumar in the Division of Engineering, New York University Abu Dhabi, seeks to recruit a Research Scientist to conduct research in the area of microfluidic devices. Applicants with a background in cell biology, bioengineering, tissue engineering, or translational medicine are encouraged to apply. Terms of employment include competitive salary and benefits.
  
  
Research in Prof. Kumar’s Lab focuses on developing paper based microfluidic platforms for translational medicine applications, including immunoassays and cell migration assays, cell culture applications and disease diagnosis, as well as new methods for spheroid and organoid culture for drug testing. Our projects are highly interdisciplinary and require collaboration with chemistry, biology, and engineering faculty.
  
  
The applicant must be able to independently design, plan, and carry out research project tasks, co-mentor doctoral researchers, write journal and conference papers, conduct experiments and analyze data, as well as manage day-to-day functioning of the lab.
  
  
Applicants must have a PhD with at least 6 years of relevant experience in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, biology, biotechnology, or virology, and significant experience with experimentation, design of experiments, and data analysis, including cell culture studies.
  
  
To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree / copy of highest degree, research statement, and at least 2 contact references.
  
  
Applications will be accepted immediately. candidates will be considered until the position is filled. If you have any questions, please reach out to: sunil.kumar@nyu.edu.
  
  
**About NYU Abu Dhabi**
https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/
  
  
NYU Abu Dhabi is the first comprehensive liberal arts and research campus in the Middle East to be operated abroad by a major American research university. Times Higher Education ranks NYU among the top 30 universities in the world, making NYU Abu Dhabi the highest-ranked university in the UAE and MENA region. NYU Abu Dhabi has integrated a highly selective undergraduate curriculum across the disciplines with a world center for advanced research and scholarship. The Trabolsi Research Group at New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) invites applications for a Post-Doctoral Associate position in Organic and Supramolecular Chemistry. The successful candidate will conduct innovative and interdisciplinary research focused on the rational design, synthesis, and characterization of complex organic molecules, supramolecular architectures, and functional porous materials, particularly covalent organic frameworks (COFs). The research will emphasize the development of responsive molecular systems with tailored structural and functional properties for applications in water treatment, health, and energy. Particular attention will be given to designing functional COFs for the selective recognition, capture, and removal of emerging contaminants from water, including pharmaceuticals, endocrine disruptors, and persistent organic pollutants. The candidate will investigate molecular recognition, host–guest interactions, self-assembly, and structure–property relationships to advance the fundamental understanding and practical applications of these materials.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Conduct research in organic synthesis, supramolecular chemistry, and the development of functional molecular architectures.
* Design, synthesize, purify, and characterize complex organic molecules, macrocycles, supramolecular assemblies, and functional building blocks for COFs.
* Develop innovative synthetic strategies for preparing responsive molecular systems and porous organic materials.
* Investigate molecular recognition, host–guest interactions, self-assembly, and structure–property relationships.
* Develop and optimize functional COFs for selective contaminant removal, molecular capture, and environmental applications.
* Explore potential applications of supramolecular systems and functional materials in biomedical and energy-related technologies.
* Prepare high-quality scientific manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present research findings at scientific conferences.
* Contribute to the preparation of research proposals, grant applications, and scientific reports.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a large genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and automation of large-scale genomic data processing workflows, ensuring reliable, scalable, and reproducible analysis across diverse sequencing technologies. The position contributes to the advancement of production genomics capabilities through workflow innovation, cloud-based computing solutions, quality control frameworks, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable bioinformatics pipelines and workflows for large-scale genomic data processing.
* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.
* Develop and manage workflow orchestration platforms such as Nextflow and equivalent workflow management systems.
* Improve workflow scalability, reproducibility, monitoring, performance, and reliability across high-volume sequencing datasets.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and integrate new bioinformatics tools, sequencing technologies, and analytical approaches into production environments.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and unexpected analytical results.
* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.
* Contribute to cloud-based genomic computing environments, containerization technologies, workload optimization, and reproducible software deployment practices.
* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Significant experience in production bioinformatics, genomic computing, workflow development, cloud genomics, or related technical fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale genomics infrastructure, pipeline development, or workflow automation projects.
* Experience working with whole genome sequencing (WGS) datasets and large-scale genomic analysis environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration frameworks, and high-performance computing environments is strongly preferred.
* Scientific publications, open-source contributions, or ownership of large-scale genomics systems are advantageous.
* Strong programming skills in Python, shell scripting, or related languages.
* Advanced Linux command-line proficiency.
* Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of genomic processing tools such as DRAGEN, Sentieon, GATK, bcftools, samtools, and related technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Singularity/Apptainer, containerized workflows, and reproducible software environments.
* Strong understanding of genomic file formats including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and gVCF.
* Expertise in genomic quality control, variant calling, structural variation analysis, and large-scale genomic data processing.
* Familiarity with Git, software version control, and workflow testing practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary technical and scientific teams.

At OMS Pharma, we believe the next generation of pharmaceutical innovation will be shaped by artificial intelligence, computational biology and advanced scientific research.

**What Will You Work On?**

Explore machine-learning and generative AI models for molecular discovery.

Develop computational approaches to identify and evaluate potential drug candidates.

Research predictive methods for drug properties, efficacy and safety.

2. Molecular Design & Computational Chemistry

Work with molecular docking, virtual screening and protein–ligand interactions.

Explore QSAR, ADMET and molecular property prediction.

Investigate AI-assisted molecular optimization.

3. Computational Biology & Virtual Human Simulation

Explore AI models for predicting molecular and biological responses.

Contribute to research on virtual biological simulations and personalized medicine.

Explore applications of large language models and generative AI in pharmaceutical research.

Work with biological, chemical and pharmaceutical datasets.

Develop and evaluate computational prototypes.

Collaborate across AI, pharmaceutical sciences and computational biology.

* We welcome researchers and professionals from diverse scientific backgrounds, including:

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

* Computational Biology & Bioinformatics

* Computational Chemistry & Medicinal Chemistry

* Pharmaceutical Sciences & Biotechnology

* Molecular Biology & Systems Biology

* Scientific Computing & Data Science

* Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow

* RDKit, DeepChem

* Molecular docking and molecular dynamics

* Generative AI and graph neural networks

* QSAR and ADMET modeling

* Biological datasets and scientific machine learning

* Candidates with strong scientific research portfolios, published work or demonstrated independent projects are encouraged to apply.

**Why OMS Pharma?**

OMS Pharma aims to connect advanced artificial intelligence with pharmaceutical sciences and computational research.

This is an opportunity to contribute to the early development of research initiatives exploring how AI can accelerate scientific discovery and support future medicine development.

We value curiosity, scientific rigor, creativity and the ability to transform ambitious research ideas into testable computational models.

Apply through LinkedIn and share your CV, relevant research experience and portfolio.

jobs.title: Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

**Base Location: Vadodara**

Key Responsibilities

**Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance**

* Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

**Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance**

* Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

**Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification**

* Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on
  **Frozen RTE and Rice processing**
  .

**Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:**

* Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

**GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification**

* Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

**Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits**

* Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

**Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management**

* Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as
  **5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis**
  . Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

**CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification**

* Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

**Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management**

* Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

**Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

1. Travel is mandatory for this Job Profile

Required Education and Experience

1. A master’s or bachelor’s degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
2. Should have handled 3P operations
3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.
6. Lead Auditor (Any GFSI Scheme Certified PCQI Personnel Preferred.

**Preferred Knowledge**

1. Knowledge of lab technique and prior training in fundamental quality assurance technology.
2. Basic Knowledge of Quality Assurance; GFSI and Regulatory (US FDA); FSMA and other Regulatory standards.
3. Good Technical skills.
4. Good communication skills.
5. Aptitude in problem-solving.
6. Working with start-up environment

Competencies

1. Teamwork.
2. Communication.
3. Consultation.
4. Ethical Practice
5. Problem Solving

jobs.title: Business Development & Customer Relations Executive
jobs.description:
**About Nourish'd**

Nourish'd is a nutrition-focused food brand offering thoughtfully prepared, protein-rich vegetarian meals for people who care about their health, fitness and lifestyle.

  

We are looking for a confident, articulate and proactive **Business Development & Customer Relations Executive** to represent Nourish'd, build business relationships and manage customer communications.

This is a remote position suited to someone who enjoys speaking with people, developing business opportunities and communicating professionally over phone, email and WhatsApp.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Lead Generation**

* Identify and reach out to potential corporate clients, IT parks, technology companies, corporate offices, fitness centres, gyms and wellness centres.
* Make outbound calls to HR managers, administration teams, facility managers, gym owners and other decision-makers.
* Introduce Nourish'd and explain its corporate meal plans, healthy food offerings and potential partnership opportunities.
* Generate qualified business leads and arrange meetings with relevant decision-makers.
* Coordinate follow-ups and maintain relationships with prospective corporate and business partners.
* Help organise product presentations, food tasting sessions and business meetings.

**2. Customer Communication & Support**

* Handle incoming phone calls and respond to customer enquiries.
* Respond to emails, WhatsApp messages and other business communications professionally.
* Share information about Nourish'd's menu, meal plans, subscriptions and services.
* Follow up with interested customers and convert enquiries into potential orders or subscriptions.
* Ensure timely and professional communication with customers and business partners.

**3. Administrative & Coordination**

* Maintain an organised database of prospects, customers, calls and follow-ups.
* Schedule meetings and coordinate appointments with prospective clients and company representatives.
* Prepare basic email communications, proposals and business presentations.
* Provide regular updates on lead generation, meetings scheduled and business development activities.

Candidate Requirements

* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Confident and professional telephone communication.
* Ability to initiate conversations with senior professionals and decision-makers.
* Good interpersonal, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and following up with prospective clients.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, email and WhatsApp.
* Good organisational skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* A proactive, positive and result-oriented attitude.

  

**Preferred:** 1-5 years of experience in business development, inside sales, telecalling, customer relations or lead generation. Experience in B2B sales, corporate sales, food, fitness or wellness businesses will be an advantage.

What We Offer

* Fully remote work opportunity.
* Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to contribute to the growth of an emerging health and nutrition brand.
* Direct interaction with the founding team.
* Scope to grow into a larger business development or customer relations role.

**If you have excellent communication skills, enjoy interacting with people and want to be part of a growing health-focused brand, we would love to hear from you.**

jobs.description:
**Location**Bengaluru**Experience**Minimum 5 years in conveyor and/or packaging machine design**Qualification**BE / B.Tech in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering (Diploma with strong relevant experience considered)**Employment type**Full-time**Reports to**[Head Engineering / Technical Director]Role summary  
Own the mechanical design of conveyor systems and packaging machines from customer requirement to released drawings. You will lead design on projects, mentor junior engineers, and work closely with sales, manufacturing, controls and service teams to deliver reliable, cost-effective machines.  
Key responsibilities  
 Understand customer requirements (product, container, throughput, layout, utilities) and translate them into machine concepts and line layouts.  
 Prepare General Arrangement (GA) drawings and layouts for proposals, and support the sales team with technical clarifications.  
¢ Carry out complete mechanical design of conveyors (belt, roller, slat/table-top, modular, accumulation, transfers, elevators) and packaging machine modules.  
¢ Perform design calculations: load, belt/chain pull, drive sizing (motor, gearbox), shaft and bearing selection, and pneumatic cylinder sizing.  
¢ Prepare and review detailed manufacturing drawings and BOMs, and release them for production.  
¢ Apply design for manufacturing and assembly (DFMA) and standardisation to reduce cost and lead time.  
¢ Select and specify bought-out items, and coordinate with vendors for technical approvals.  
¢ Coordinate with the controls/electrical team on sensor positions, panel interfaces, guarding and safety requirements.  
¢ Support manufacturing, assembly, FAT and site commissioning; analyse issues and implement design corrections.  
¢ Review and check the work of junior designers, and guide and mentor them.  
¢ Keep design standards, libraries and project documentation up to date.  
Skills & requirements  
¢ Minimum 5 years of hands-on design experience in conveyors, packaging machines or special-purpose machines.  
¢ Expert in SolidWorks (or equivalent 3D CAD) and AutoCAD, including large assemblies and sheet metal.  
¢ Strong knowledge of drives, power transmission, bearings, pneumatics, material selection and fabrication processes.  
¢ Sound grasp of GD&T, tolerancing, and drawing standards.  
¢ Experience with machine guarding and safety considerations.  
¢ Ability to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and interact confidently with customers.  
Good to have  
¢ Experience in FMCG, food & beverage, personal care, home care or pharma packaging lines.  
¢ Exposure to hygienic/SS design, robotic palletizing, case packing or filling lines.  
Knowledge of PDM/PLM tools and design costing.

jobs.title: Zonal Sales Manager  General Trade South & East India
jobs.description:
**Zonal Sales Manager (East & South Zone) General Trade Bangalore or Hyderabad,India**

  

We, Jabsons Foods, a company based in Bharuch, Gujarat, are seeking a qualified **Zonal Sales Manager (East & South Zone)** to contribute to our companys sales objectives. Your responsibilities include supervising the sales team and building long-term client relationships.

As the Zonal Sales Manager, you should use your creativity and thorough knowledge of sales processes to provide innovative ideas for business growth. Communication and team management skills are also essential for this position.

  

**Objectives of this Role:**

* Responsible for implementing sales plans and strategies with a view to increase sustainable market share and profitability.
* Responsible for strengthening and expansion distribution network.
* Responsible for implementing the policies and guideline for smooth functioning.
* Responsible for understanding the competition activities, demand and supply and forecasting.
* Effective & timely implementation of GTM strategy, robust field force monitoring system, people management and relationship Management
* Managing the complete business cycle in the East & South Zone, from business development and customer acquisition to payment collection.
* Responsible for implementing effective sales monitoring system, daily, weekly, monthly target achievement & business review (sales, Coverage and Fill rate)
* Minimum 12 days of retailing per month
* Drive expansion of the Jabsons General Trade footprint across the East & South Zone, including appointing distributors in under-penetrated states and towns and adapting the GTM approach to regional market dynamics.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* **Sales Achievement:** Primary and secondary sales vs. monthly and quarterly targets (value and volume), and growth over the same period last year, tracked state-wise and distributor-wise.
* **Distribution Expansion:** Number of new distributors / super stockists appointed and activated in white-space towns, and town coverage by population class.
* **Outlet Coverage:** Active outlets billed per month, new outlets added, and repeat-billing rate of existing outlets.
* **Field Force Productivity:** Productive calls %, lines per call, and average bill value per outlet.
* **Range Selling & New Launches:** Outlet-level distribution of focus SKUs and new launches across categories (peanuts, namkeen, chana, dry fruits).
* **Fill Rate & Order Servicing:** Distributor fill rate and secondary order fill rate within agreed norms.
* **Channel Partner Infrastructure, Investment & Hygiene:** Effectiveness of each distributors infrastructure (warehouse space, delivery vehicles, dedicated salesmen and DMS) against the coverage plan; partner investment in stock and working capital commensurate with business size, with healthy ROI; and operational hygiene, including stock within norms, FIFO and expiry management, accurate DMS data, and timely, documented claim settlement.
* **Sales Returns:** Returns / replacements kept within 2% of sales, with proactive management of near-expiry stock.
* **Trade Spend Effectiveness:** Scheme spend within budget as % of sales, and incremental sales delivered per scheme.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Monthly zone demand forecast accuracy for S&OP planning.
* **Team Management:** Team target achievement, attrition, time to fill vacancies, minimum 12 market-working days per month, and SFA / DMS adherence.

**Candidate Requirement:**

* Age: 38yrs to 40 yrs. (Max limit 45yrs)
* Experience: Minimum 15years, of Food industry without any gap. Out of which at least 5 years in branded snack foods. Total number of company change is not be more than 4.
* Qualification: Minimum graduate. Post Graduate in Sales & Marketing.

**Vision:** Bringing pure, desi dairy and daily essentials, grown on our farms and made the way Grandma did, to every Indian home.

**Mission:** We are on a mission to bring back the goodness our grandparents trusted. On our own farms we raise native Gir cows and feed them natural fodder grown with their own manure. This natural ecosystem gives us A2 milk, ghee, paneer and everyday desi groceries, made the way our grandparents made them, and delivered farm-fresh to Indian homes.

**Tagline:** Just Pure Desi — made the way Grandma did.

Today our customers are families who have visited the farm and the people they recommend. This role takes RootsDesi from there to homes across India and to Indian families abroad.

What you will sell: A2 milk (daily delivery); bilona ghee, curd, buttermilk, lassi, paneer, colostrum milk, butter, khoa and sweets; groundnut, coconut, sesame and other wood-pressed oils. Ghee and oils are sold in India and abroad; fresh products in India only. More products will be added based on what customers ask for.

**Role summary**

Sell our milk, dairy products and wood-pressed oils across India, and our ghee and oils abroad, profitably, and build the team to run it. You report directly to the CEO.

**Area**

**What you deliver**

**Measured by**

D2C (website, WhatsApp, subscriptions), quick-commerce, marketplaces, modern trade, and business customers: hotels, restaurants, caterers, institutions, retailers.

Revenue growth, active customers, business customers, and the mix of direct and business sales.

**Sales abroad**

Ghee and oils: first export markets chosen with the CEO; export licences, labelling and lab certificates; importers, distributors or global e-commerce partners.

Export markets opened, export orders and export margin.

**Profit, plan and cash**

Cost every product from milk to doorstep and set prices by product, channel and market; annual sales and profit plan agreed with the CEO and a monthly business review; credit limits for business customers, on-time collections and safe export payment terms.

Margin by product and channel, plan versus actual, days to collect payment and overdue amount. A product scales only once it is profitable.

**Brand and marketing**

Content, performance marketing and community; our real farm, cows and team; new products added on customer demand, and those that do not sell paused.

Cost to win a customer, new products live on schedule, reviews and rating.

**Customers and CRM**

Every customer and subscription in the CRM; service complaints (delivery, billing, subscriptions) resolved fast; customers asked what they want.

Repeat purchase rate, subscription retention, service complaint resolution time.

**Delivery**

Daily cold-chain delivery for fresh dairy; dense routes that pay for themselves; ghee and oils shipped across India and abroad through partners.

On-time delivery, cost per order, damage in transit.

**Milk supply and stock**

Demand planned with the farm and processing teams; outside A2 milk sourced and tested when needed; stock kept lean; no wastage of perishables — fresh products made only to confirmed orders.

Milk available to plan, every lot tested, zero wastage of perishables, forecast accuracy.

**Quality and compliance**

Every batch tracked from milk to customer and a recall plan ready; product quality complaints acted on fast; an SOP for every activity; launch only with an FSSAI-checked label, shelf-life test and lab report; every claim within ASCI norms.

Quality complaints per 1,000 orders, every batch traceable, SOP adherence in audits. Any compliance breach fails the quarter.

**Build the team**

Lead the existing milk delivery and sales staff; hire for sales, marketing, delivery, export and customer care; weekly reviews; every person accountable for full, on-time delivery.

Key roles filled on time, team results against targets, retention.

**Critical: bring proof with numbers**

* **Speed and 100% execution** — A plan delivered in full and on time
* **People management** — A team you built, and an under-performer you turned around
* **Scalable sales and marketing channels in dairy or D2C food** — Customers at start and at exit, and how you scaled

**Also required**

* **Cold-chain last-mile delivery** — How you lowered cost per delivery
* **Food export, ideally ghee or oils** — Markets you opened
* **FSSAI labelling and ASCI advertising norms**

**Good to have**

* Quick-commerce, marketplaces or global e-commerce.
* Business customers: hotels, restaurants, caterers, institutions, retail.

**Basics**

* Graduate; MBA preferred.
* English and Hindi required; Kannada, Telugu or Tamil a plus.

**First 90 days — outcomes we expect**

**Days**

**Outcomes**

Milk delivery and existing staff handed over; cost and margin known for every product; hiring plan agreed with the CEO; annual sales and profit plan agreed

**31–60**  **Open channels**

Ghee and oils selling online in India; first business customers signed; CRM tracking every customer; first key hires made; credit limits and collections tracking live

**61–90**  **Prove and plan**

Repeat orders growing; an SOP for every activity; batch tracking and complaint log live; fresh-dairy plan ready; export plan ready: first markets, licences, partners

**Why join**

People Inc is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor in the Internal Audit team based in Bangalore, India. The opportunity is to be a part of well-established local internal audit team in Bangalore and works closely with US Internal Audit team and stakeholders. You will be reporting to the Manager, Internal Audit India. People Incs global Internal Audit function performs operational, financial and information technology audits and data analytic/automation projects for IA across all of People Inc locations and businesses. **Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.

We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
* Data migration mapping and specification governance inpu

**Location: Northeast**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas for this position.*

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

The Senior Scientific Community Engagement Specialist supports USP's global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center initiatives by helping build and engage a scientific and technical community focused on pharmaceutical continuous manufacturing. jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Nutrition Sales Executive - Thiruvananthapuram
jobs.description:
Contribute to the long-term growth of Abbott Nutrition products in territory by increasing awareness among Health Care Professionals on the important role of nutrition in improving quality of life, and the superiority of Abbott products to competitor brands. Gain new business and grow existing business through a multichannel, customer engagement strategy that builds HCP confidence in and loyalty to Abbott brand products.

* Understand the market and category opportunities within territory to identify opportunities for market share growth at the customer/account level
* Maintain deep, current knowledge about medical and nutritional science, the evolving healthcare landscape, and emerging digital trends to support selling and educating a broad and deep network of HCPs about Abbott products
