**Job Description**

**Job title**
: Head Medical Services Hub

**Department:**
GMA Excellence and Operations

**Reports to:**
Head GMA Excellence & Operations

**Location**
: India

**Position Summary**

The Head of the Medical Services Hub is an experienced publications leader who will be responsible for the end to end development and delivery of scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, compliant, and visually effective medical and scientific publications.

He/ she will provide strategic, scientific, operational, and people leadership across all publications manuscripts, abstracts, posters, presentations, and consensus papers. The role requires an innovative mindset , strategic thinking , substantial expertise and knowledge in publication standards, quality control, applicable regulations, visual and information design, and journal- and congress-specific requirements. He/ she will manage workload allocation, develop medical writers and medical-design professionals while building scalable, high-quality publication capabilities that contribute to Galderma’s growth and purpose of “Advancing dermatology for every skin story

**Role and Responsibilities**

* This role oversees the end-to-end preparation of: Peer-reviewed manuscripts, Congress abstracts, Scientific posters and oral-presentation materials, Consensus papers and expert recommendations
* Other scientific communication deliverables supporting Galderma’s Therapeutic Dermatology, Injectable Aesthetics and Dermatological Skin care Portfolio.
* The combines advanced medical-writing and publication-planning expertise with a strong understanding of medical design, data visualization, submission requirements, and publication governance. GPP 2022 applies to company-sponsored peer-reviewed and peer-oriented publications, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and meeting presentations.
* The position leads medical writers and medical-design professionals, supports their development, and strengthens the team’s capabilities, processes and Provide senior-level scientific and editorial direction throughout publication development, from concept and data interpretation through author review, submission, revision, and final publication.
* Applies relevant European Medicines Agency (EMA) / US Food and Drug Administration(FDA) requirements and guidance, such as current product-information, Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) and Quality Review of Documents (QRD) standards. Monitor evolving requirements affecting biomedical publication, including artificial-intelligence policies. The January 2026 ICMJE recommendations state that AI technologies should not be listed as authors and that users should disclose the tool used and its purpose.
* Ensure publication objectives, scientific narratives, audiences, target journals, and congresses are clearly defined.
* Develop and maintain publication plans, timelines, priorities, resource forecasts, and delivery metrics.
* Anticipate publication risks, dependencies, and competing priorities, escalating issues and recommending practical solutions.
* Establish appropriate quality-control processes for scientific accuracy, data consistency, reference integrity, document versioning, design quality, and submission readiness.
* Ensure design choices strengthen scientific understanding without altering, overstating, or obscuring the underlying evidence.
* Confirm that final materials meet journal or congress specifications for dimensions, orientation, file format, resolution, font size, figure preparation, naming conventions, and upload requirements.
* Coordinate cross-functional input from Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, intellectual-property specialists, and other relevant partners.
* Manage external agencies, freelancers, vendors, and production partners, including scope, quality, timelines, budgets, and performance

**People leadership and team development**

* Lead, coach, and develop professionals working across medical writing, publications, medical design, data visualization, editing, and production.
* Set clear objectives, responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Allocate work according to business priorities, scientific complexity, individual capabilities, and available capacity.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted training, mentoring, recruitment, succession, or external-resource plans.

**Operational excellence tracking performance**

* Develop and improve publication workflows, standard operating procedures, templates, checklists, quality controls, and governance mechanisms.
* Maintain and improve measurable indicators for quality, timeliness, author experience, resource utilization, budget performance, and process effectiveness

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience**

* B.Sc. or PhD Excellent written and oral English communication skills with 10+ years’ experience leading small to mid size teams and developing, tracking, and optimizing demand-management and resource-planning models in a global environment
* Strong knowledge of publication standards, journal and congress submission requirements, scientific design principles, and data visualization.
* Experience people leader in organizational design, change management, Medical, R&D, and managing an integrated remote working team within the India market
* Experience managing medical writing and medical-design professionals, including workload allocation, coaching, performance feedback, and capability development.
* Practical experience with, quality standards, systems, and processes used within a pharmaceutical organization.
* Ability to manage multiple complex publication projects across brands or therapeutic areas while maintaining scientific quality, compliance, and delivery timelines.

**Job Descriptions**

The General Manager/DG,, Biotech Centre, Kumar Organic Products Limited is responsible for leading the Biotech team (which includes R&D, Pilot plant, QC-Micro) in Jigani, Bangalore to invent, develop, and commercialize new active cosmetic ingredients, innovative compounds and process technology aligned with the needs of KOPL business.

Lead the R&D Team and development of new Molecules.

Bio transfer, Gene synthesis

Design capabilities.

**Team:** Biotechnology Scientists, Research Associates, Process Development Scientists, Analytical Support and Technical Staff

  

Position Purpose

To lead the Biotechnology R&D function for development, optimization, scale-up and commercialization of biotechnology-based processes for APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, specialty chemicals and other value-added products.

The position will be responsible for converting scientific concepts and laboratory processes into commercially viable, robust, safe, scalable and cost-effective manufacturing processes.

The role will also drive innovation through fermentation, microbial biotechnology, enzymatic transformation, biocatalysis, strain improvement, process intensification and sustainable manufacturing technologies.

  

Key Responsibilities

A. R&D Strategy and Technology Development

* Develop and execute the company's 35-year biotechnology R&D strategy aligned with business objectives.

* Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their technical and commercial feasibility.
* Build internal biotechnology capabilities and technology platforms.
* Establish appropriate project stage-gate and technical review systems.

  

Product and Process Development

* Lead biotechnology process development from laboratory proof-of-concept through pilot and commercial scale.
* Develop and optimize fermentation and biotransformation processes.
* Optimize media, feed strategy, inoculum, fermentation parameters, reaction conditions and downstream recovery.
* Establish robust process parameters and operating ranges.
* Improve yield, productivity, conversion, purity, cycle time and process consistency.
* Develop processes capable of meeting required product quality specifications.

  

Scale-Up and Commercialization

Process Economics and Cost Optimization

* Drive reduction in raw-material consumption, solvent usage, utilities, waste generation and cycle time.
* Establish target cost of goods for new processes.
* Deliver measurable manufacturing cost improvements through biotechnology/process innovation.

  

E. Innovation and Intellectual Property

* Identify opportunities for patents and proprietary process technologies.
* Work with the IP/legal team on patentability and freedom-to-operate assessments.
* Generate process know-how and protect critical technical knowledge.
* Maintain awareness of competitor technologies and industry developments.
* Build a pipeline of differentiated biotechnology technologies.

  

F. R&D Project Management

* Establish project objectives, milestones, timelines, resources and budgets.
* Manage multiple R&D projects simultaneously.
* Conduct periodic technical and management reviews.
* Identify technical risks and establish mitigation plans.
* Ensure timely completion of development milestones.
* Prepare technical reports and management presentations.

  

G. Quality, Regulatory and EHS

* Ensure R&D activities comply with applicable GMP, quality, EHS and biosafety requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and traceability of development activities.
* Support regulatory submissions and technical responses where required.
* Ensure safe handling of microorganisms, enzymes, chemicals and biological materials.
* Promote safe-by-design approaches during process development.

  

H. Team Leadership

* Build and lead a high-performance biotechnology R&D team.
* Recruit, train and develop scientists and technical personnel.
* Establish technical competency and career-development plans.
* Mentor scientists in experimental design, troubleshooting and scientific decision-making.
* Develop succession plans for critical technical positions.
* Promote collaboration between R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Commercial functions.

  

I. External Collaboration

* Evaluate external technologies and licensing opportunities.

* Represent the company at relevant technical forums and industry conferences.

  

4. Key Interfaces

5. Qualification

6. Experience

To own and grow company's branded business outside India across all international regions. The Head – International Business (Brands) sets the international brand and market strategy, builds and leads the regional team, expands the distributor network, opens new countries, and is accountable for secondary sales, stock health, new product introductions and the overall international revenue, profitability and forecast.

This is a business-building role, not an export-coordination role. The incumbent must be comfortable working directly with distributor owners, KOLs and institutional buyers, and equally comfortable reviewing numbers and presenting performance to the Management.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategy and Business Planning**

* Define the international brand strategy, country prioritisation and market-entry roadmap aligned with the Company's overall business plan.
* Prepare annual and monthly regional and country business plans, budgets, forecasts and pipeline, and ensure their achievement.
* Take full P&L ownership of international brands business: revenue, pricing, margin, trade terms and receivables, in coordination with Finance.
* Evaluate new market opportunities across private market, hospitals, institutions and government tenders.

**B. Distributor Network and Market Development**

* Develop secondary sales and product movement through existing distributors and their sales teams.
* Drive repeat orders, stock liquidation and inventory health, working with distributors on monthly sales plans and execution.
* Identify, evaluate, appoint and, where required, exit distributors; negotiate distribution agreements and commercial terms.
* Open new countries and expand company's presence beyond existing markets.
* Activate and improve the productivity of distributor sales and marketing teams through training, joint field work and review mechanisms.

**C. Brand, Product and Portfolio**

* Own international brand positioning, brand plans and promotional, digital and scientific initiatives with distributor marketing teams.
* Drive new product and new pack introductions and ensure successful market launches; introduction and upselling of new formulations.
* Gather market requirements and competitor intelligence and feed these to R&D, Regulatory and Supply Chain for new formulations, pack sizes and product development.
* Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market trends and emerging clinical nutrition opportunities.

**D. KOL and Scientific Engagement**

* Build and oversee KOL networks across assigned countries.
* Plan and ensure execution of RTMs, CNEs, scientific meetings and other healthcare professional engagement programmes in coordination with Medical / Scientific Affairs.

**E. Tender and Institutional Business**

**F. Regulatory, Supply and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Production, Quality and Finance for forecasts, order fulfilment, shelf-life management, documentation and collections.

**G. Team Leadership and Governance**

* Hire, develop, coach and set KPIs for Regional Managers / BDMs; conduct regular performance reviews.
* Create a structured review rhythm: monthly secondary sales, stock and forecast reviews, quarterly business reviews and market visits.
* Present international business performance, risks and opportunities to the Managing Director and Management.
* Build a pipeline of internal talent and a succession plan for the international team.

**3. Candidate Profile**

**Essential Experience**

* 15+ years of international business, export or brand-management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple countries and a team.
* Background in Pharmaceuticals, Clinical Nutrition, Medical Nutrition, Nutraceuticals or Healthcare products.
* Proven record of working through international distributors and distributor sales teams, and of appointing distributors and opening new markets.
* Strong understanding of secondary sales, stock liquidation and repeat-order generation.
* Experience in private, institutional and tender business across emerging markets.
* Experience in KOL engagement, scientific meetings, RTMs / CNEs or medical marketing is highly preferred.
* Experience handling pricing, profitability, forecasting and a multi-million-dollar portfolio.

**Preferred Experience**

jobs.title: Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS)
jobs.description:
Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS)  
Role Overview  
The Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS) is responsible for the strategy, lifecycle, operation, compliance, and continuous improvement of the Laboratory Information Management System and related Quality applications. The role serves as the application owner and key liaison between Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, IT, Data, Information Security, and external technology partners. The position ensures that LIMS remains reliable, scalable, secure, inspection-ready, and aligned with laboratory, manufacturing, and business priorities.  
Key Responsibilities  
Application Ownership and Lifecycle Management  
•Own and manage LIMS and associated laboratory applications across their full lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, upgrades, maintenance, support, periodic review, and retirement.  
•Maintain the application roadmap in alignment with Quality, manufacturing, regulatory, cybersecurity, and enterprise-architecture priorities.  
•Standardize and harmonize LIMS platforms, master data, and processes across sites while ensuring scalability, reliability, and data integrity.  
•Identify opportunities for modernization, automation, simplification, and continuous improvement.  
Compliance, Validation, and Audit Readiness  
•Ensure compliance with GxP, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+, data-integrity principles, and applicable global regulatory requirements.  
•Lead or support the Computer System Validation strategy and required deliverables, including URS and FRS reviews, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, validation summary reports, periodic reviews, and retirement documentation.  
•Embed validation-by-design, cybersecurity-by-design, and data-integrity controls throughout the application lifecycle.  
•Support regulatory inspections, internal and customer audits, CAPA execution, and timely closure of observations.  
Systems Integration, Data, and Analytics  
•Lead integration of LIMS with MES, ERP, QMS, CDS, ELN, eBR/eBPR, laboratory instruments, data platforms, and other enterprise systems.  
•Enable secure and traceable data flow through APIs, validated connectors, and approved integration patterns, reducing manual intervention and data silos.  
•Maintain the accuracy, lineage, security, availability, and traceability of laboratory data.  
•Enable dashboards, real-time visibility, and analytics for laboratory performance, Quality risks, audit readiness, and operational decision-making.  
•Assess appropriate uses of AI, predictive analytics, and automation across Quality and laboratory processes.  
Operations and Service Management  
•Maintain application availability, performance, reliability, and business continuity for GxP-critical laboratory systems.  
•Manage incidents, problems, changes, releases, system risks, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions.  
•Define and monitor service levels, platform KPIs, support performance, disaster-recovery readiness, and business-continuity arrangements.  
•Ensure effective access management, application security, documentation, and operational controls.  
Stakeholder, Vendor, and Change Management  
•Partner with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, IT, Data, and Information Security teams to translate business and laboratory needs into compliant technology solutions.  
•Manage LIMS software providers, implementation partners, system integrators, and support vendors against agreed scope, quality, cost, timelines, and service levels.  
•Lead stakeholder communication, governance reviews, risk escalation, and executive reporting.  
•Drive user training, change management, adoption, and effective use of LIMS across sites.  
Qualifications and Experience  
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline; an advanced qualification is preferred.  
•Relevant experience managing, implementing, or supporting LIMS in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated environment.  
•Demonstrated delivery of complex digital or IT programs in GxP-controlled environments.  
•Experience with multi-site implementations, upgrades, harmonization, validation, and application lifecycle management.  
•Experience managing technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, delivery plans, and service performance.  
•Experience with related laboratory and Quality platforms such as CDS/Chromeleon, QMS, ELN, eBR/eBPR, MES, and laboratory automation systems.  
Technical and Regulatory Knowledge  
•Strong understanding of LIMS architecture, laboratory workflows, interfaces, master data, and application support models.  
•Knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, validated connectors, cloud/SaaS platforms, enterprise data platforms, and cybersecurity controls.  
•Strong working knowledge of GxP, GMP, CSV/CSA, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+, data integrity, and audit readiness.  
•Understanding of validation deliverables covering requirements, risk assessment, qualification, testing, traceability, release, periodic review, and retirement.  
Core Competencies  
•Quality and compliance leadership  
•LIMS and laboratory informatics expertise  
•Application ownership and systems thinking  
•Program, service, and vendor management  
•Data governance and integrity  
•Analytical problem-solving and risk management  
•Cross-functional stakeholder management  
•Change leadership and user adoption  
•Clear communication and executive reporting  
Key Success Measures  
•Stable, reliable, and compliant operation of LIMS and related Quality applications.  
•Timely delivery of roadmap initiatives, upgrades, integrations, and validation commitments.  
•Strong audit and inspection readiness with effective closure of risks, incidents, and CAPAs.  
•Improved process standardization, user adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency across sites.  
•Effective vendor performance, service-level achievement, stakeholder satisfaction, and transparent governance.

jobs.title: Clinical Dietician
jobs.description:
We are seeking a licensed Clinical Dietitian with Western qualifications and training to deliver evidence-based medical nutrition therapy to patients in Dubai. The role combines individual assessment and counselling with multidisciplinary collaboration, patient education and quality improvement, in line with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct nutritional screening and comprehensive assessments using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) and international standards of practice.
* Develop, implement and review individualised nutrition care plans for inpatients and outpatients, including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, renal, gastrointestinal, oncology, obesity and weight management, and paediatric nutrition as required.
* Provide enteral and parenteral nutrition recommendations and monitor tolerance and outcomes.
* Deliver culturally sensitive counselling and group education to a diverse, multinational patient population, taking account of local dietary habits, religious practices and Ramadan considerations.
* Work with physicians, nurses, pharmacists and allied health teams, attending case reviews and contributing to discharge planning.
* Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in line with DHA and facility requirements.
* Collaborate with food services on therapeutic diets, menu development, allergen management and food safety standards.
* Participate in audits, clinical protocols, research and quality initiatives; support accreditation (e.g., JCI) readiness.
* Maintain continuing professional development (CPD/CME) required for licence renewal.

**Essential**
Qualifications and Registration
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Dietetics (or Nutrition and Dietetics) from an accredited university in the UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or another recognised Western country; a postgraduate diploma or master's in Dietetics where the first degree is in nutrition or health science.
* Completion of supervised clinical training/placement (approximately 900+ hours, or equivalent to the home-country accreditation standard).
* Current professional registration in good standing, such as HCPC (UK), CORU (Ireland), CDR/RDN (USA), CDRE/provincial college (Canada), Dietitians Australia (APD), or the NZ Dietitians Board.
* Minimum two years of post-qualification clinical experience in a healthcare facility, with no significant gap in practice.
* A valid Certificate of Good Standing issued within the last six months.
* Eligibility for, or possession of, a DHA professional licence (Sheryan registration, DataFlow primary source verification and, where not exempt, the DHA licensing exam). The employer will support licence activation.
* Fluent spoken and written English.

Desirable
  
  

* Specialist experience or additional certification (e.g., diabetes education, renal, critical care, paediatrics, sports nutrition).
* Experience in a JCI-accredited or international hospital setting.
* Arabic or other additional languages.
* Prior experience working in the Gulf region.

Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong clinical reasoning and evidence-based practice.
* Excellent communication, motivational interviewing and patient education skills.
* Cultural awareness and adaptability in a multicultural environment.
* Proficiency with electronic medical records and nutrition analysis software.
* Teamwork, organisation and sound time management.

Abbott Point of Care Diagnostics | Dubai, UAE
  
  
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
  
  
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to :
  
  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

In Abbott’s Point of Care Diagnostics Division
  
  
We are transforming healthcare by delivering rapid, reliable diagnostic solutions that enable faster clinical decisions and improve patient outcomes. Our innovative point-of-care technologies support healthcare professionals across hospitals, emergency departments, clinics, and community settings, helping to enhance efficiency and drive better healthcare delivery worldwide.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are seeking a
**Market Access Manager, EEMEA**
, based in
**Dubai, UAE**
, to lead the development and execution of market access, reimbursement, pricing, and health economics strategies across key markets in the region including Saudi Arabia, UAE, Türkiye, Egypt, South Africa, North Africa, and Eastern Europe.
  
  
In this highly visible regional role, you will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Government Affairs, Regulatory, and country leadership teams to demonstrate the clinical, operational, and economic value of Abbott Point of Care solutions, ensuring sustainable patient access and business growth.
  
  
What You'll Work On
  
  

* Develop and execute regional Market Access and Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) strategies.
* Build compelling health economic value propositions that support reimbursement and funding decisions.
* Design and oversee budget impact models, cost-effectiveness analyses, cost-benefit assessments, and ROI studies.
* Adapt global economic models and evidence to local healthcare systems and market requirements.
* Develop value dossiers, payer communication tools, and reimbursement submissions for priority markets.
* Generate and leverage real-world evidence and outcomes data to support market access initiatives.
* Identify reimbursement opportunities and address access barriers across public and private healthcare systems.
* Drive inclusion of Abbott solutions in reimbursement schemes, clinical pathways, and government-funded healthcare programs.
* Lead payer engagement activities and support value-based pricing strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with Ministries of Health, HTA bodies, reimbursement agencies, healthcare insurers, and procurement authorities.
* Monitor policy and reimbursement changes and assess their impact on market access strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, Health Economics, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* Advanced degree (Master's preferred) in Health Economics, HEOR, Public Health, Health Policy, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Business.
* 3-6 years of experience in Market Access, Pricing & Reimbursement, Health Economics, HEOR, Healthcare Policy, or Government Affairs.
* Strong experience with Budget Impact Models (BIM), Cost-Effectiveness Analyses (CEA), Cost-Utility Analyses (CUA), and health economic modelling.
* Proven success in securing reimbursement, funding approvals, formulary inclusion, or policy adoption through evidence-based value propositions.
* Experience preparing submissions and value dossiers for HTA bodies, Ministries of Health, payers, and reimbursement authorities.
* Knowledge of healthcare financing and reimbursement systems across the Middle East, Africa, and Eastern Europe.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Fluency in English is required; additional languages such as French or German are advantageous.

Why Join Abbott?
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to shape access strategies across a diverse and dynamic region while contributing to innovative diagnostic solutions that improve healthcare outcomes for millions of patients. Join a collaborative, purpose-driven team where your expertise will have a direct impact on healthcare systems and patient access across EEMEA.
  
  
Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
  
  
Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

You want to contribute to a collective adventure — to undertake, test, learn and challenge yourself? Then we have (more than) a job for you.

ABOUT NAOS

NAOS is a major player in skincare with three brands — BIODERMA, INSTITUT ESTHEDERM and ETAT PUR — united by one unique approach: Ecobiology. Rather than simply healing the skin, we teach it to live in harmony with its environment, an idea that has grown into more than 80 active patents. Founded in France by pharmacist-biologist Jean-Noël Thorel, NAOS today brings together 3,400 NAOSians across 100+ countries.

Above all, we are an organisation for altruism. NAOS is owned by a non-profit foundation — our purpose is not to enrich shareholders, but to serve the living. Profits are reinvested into our people, our science, and our long-term contribution to the world. It is what allows us to go where others might not go.

OUR PLEDGE TO EVERY NAOSIAN

• Bring your convictions — be authentic, be brave.

• Dare to develop — undertake, test, learn, explore.

• Cultivate the human link — embrace the power of human relationships.

THE ROLE

Based in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain, you will join our Medical team and play a key part in driving sales growth and strengthening our brands' presence and loyalty among healthcare professionals across the territory. Your main responsibilities will include:

* Increase presence, share of voice and awareness through medical visits and effective product detailing.
* Develop strategic relationships with healthcare professionals and customers.
* Negotiate with commercial partners, manage sales, and gather competitor and market feedback.
* Report regularly on activities, outcomes and business opportunities.
* Explore and recruit new opportunities to strengthen the medical network and support growth.
* Target HCPs and account prioritization based on business potential and growth opportunities.

MONTHLY SALARY: Up to 16,000AED

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is demanding and caring at once — a person who holds a high bar for results while staying respectful and attentive to people. Concretely, we hope you are:

• Authentic and courageous — willing to speak up, challenge and propose.

• Purpose-driven — motivated by the impact of your work on people and the living.

• Curious and entrepreneurial — you take initiative, test, learn, and don't wait for permission.

• People-oriented and collaborative — you build trust easily and make the team stronger around you.

You bring at least 2 years of experience as a Medical Representative or in a similar role in the pharmaceutical, dermo-cosmetics or healthcare industry, ideally with a medical background. You have strong medical and product knowledge, proven negotiation and selling skills, strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills, and fluency in Arabic and English.

READY TO JOIN US?

Apply Here

jobs.title: Manager, Deputy QPPV UAE & Regulatory Affairs MEA
jobs.description:
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Deputy QPPV UAE & Regulatory Affairs MEA professional to join our regional team in Dubai.

This is a unique hybrid opportunity combining UAE pharmacovigilance responsibilities with broad Regulatory Affairs exposure across the Middle East and Africa. Approximately 20% of the role will focus on Deputy QPPV responsibilities, with the remaining 80% focused on Regulatory Affairs activities across MEA Partner Business markets.

As our company-employed, UAE-based Deputy QPPV, you will provide qualified backup coverage to the UAE QPPV and help ensure continued pharmacovigilance oversight, business continuity and inspection readiness. At the same time, you will lead and coordinate regulatory activities across MEA, working closely with local partners, distributors and cross-functional teams to support product registrations, lifecycle management and continued product availability.

**The Role**

In this position, you will:

* Act as the UAE-based Deputy QPPV, providing qualified backup coverage to the UAE QPPV and supporting local pharmacovigilance governance, compliance and business continuity.
* Maintain PV inspection and audit readiness, supporting local documentation, safety agreements, compliance monitoring, training evidence, CAPAs and timely resolution of findings.
* Support oversight and escalation of local safety activities, including adverse event reporting, safety information exchange, risk-minimization activities, product information updates and urgent safety matters.
* Plan and deliver regulatory activities across MEA markets, including new registrations, variations, renewals, labeling and safety updates, post-approval commitments and lifecycle maintenance.
* Translate local and regional regulatory requirements into practical strategies supporting product supply, launches, market expansion and commercial priorities.
* Manage regulatory interfaces with distributors, local agents and third-party partners, ensuring responsibilities, timelines and compliance expectations are clearly defined and monitored.
* Support interactions with Health Authorities and relevant industry bodies, directly or through local partners as appropriate.
* Monitor evolving regulatory requirements across the region and provide regulatory intelligence and recommendations to regional and global stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate regulatory data and records in company systems, including Veeva RIM or equivalent regulatory information management platforms.
* Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Medical, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal and global and regional Regulatory Affairs teams to manage risks and ensure compliant execution.

**Your Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy.
* Valid UAE Pharmacist license.
* Educational and professional background sufficient to meet applicable UAE Deputy QPPV requirements.
* Typically 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare industry experience, with significant experience in Regulatory Affairs and/or Pharmacovigilance.
* Strong practical knowledge of UAE pharmacovigilance and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with regulatory activities such as product registrations, variations, renewals, labeling or safety updates and post-approval commitments.
* Experience with pharmacovigilance systems, local safety oversight, inspection readiness, safety agreements, compliance monitoring and issue escalation.
* Experience managing distributors, local agents or third-party service providers, ideally across Middle East and Africa markets.
* Fluent English and Arabic, both written and spoken.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple markets and within a complex global matrix.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree or postgraduate qualification in Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs or a related discipline.
* Broad knowledge of regulatory and pharmacovigilance requirements across the Middle East and Africa.
* Experience using Veeva RIM or similar regulatory information management systems.

**Profile Snapshot**

**Title:**
Senior Sales Representative

**Location:**
Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

**Position Type:**
Full Time

**Overview:**

The Technical Sales Representative – Farm Solutions will support the growth of Agrivita’s Farm Solutions portfolio, starting with Biosecurity Solutions, by creating demand at Small Poultry farms (SPF), Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries and Slaughterhouses’ channels, conducting structured customer visits, demonstrating correct product application, and converting technical needs into sustainable sales. The role requires a young, high-potential profile with strong learning agility, poultry technical grounding, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to build trust with farm owners, veterinarians, production managers, and farm teams. Exposure to large animals is an added advantage.

**How Will You Make An Impact?**

**Sales Operations**

* **Demand Generation:**
  Promote Agrivita Farm Solutions, with immediate focus on Biosecurity Solutions, across poultry farms, SPF, Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries, Slaughterhouses and relevant retail/outlet customers.
* **Poultry Technical Support:**
  Provide first-line technical guidance on cleaning and disinfection programs, biosecurity routines, product selection, dilution, application method, and safe handling in line with approved labels and company guidance.
* **Customer Development:**
  Identify and qualify new farm opportunities, build strong relationships with owners, veterinarians, farm managers and production teams, and follow up consistently to convert interest into orders.
* **Farm Visits & Demonstrations:**
  Conduct regular face-to-face visits, product demonstrations, farm walk-throughs and post-visit follow-ups to reinforce correct usage and value creation.
* **Technical Learning & Product Mastery:**
  Rapidly build and maintain strong knowledge of the Farm Solutions portfolio, poultry production basics, disease pressure drivers, and competitive offerings.
* **Sales Execution:**
  Support achievement of sales, volume and margin targets through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, order follow-up and coordination with customer service and supply chain.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Capture customer feedback, competitor activity, pricing insights, product performance observations and unmet needs, and share them through structured reports.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with sales, marketing, technical, QA/lab, customer service and supply chain teams to ensure customer issues are resolved quickly and professionally.
* **Large Animal Support:**
  Support large animal Farm Solutions opportunities when required; prior exposure to ruminants/large animals is a plus.

**Special Projects**

* Support new Farm Solutions launches, customer trials, campaign rollouts, training events, and any special projects requested by Agthia leadership.

**MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare accurate and timely visit reports, sales pipeline updates, customer feedback, competitor intelligence, product performance observations and monthly progress summaries in line with Agthia and department requirements.

**Qualifications, Experience & Functional knowledge**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Poultry Science, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
* Poultry-focused technical education or training is preferred.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in poultry technical sales, animal health, farm biosecurity, farm management, or technical customer support.
* Early-career, high-potential profile with strong learning agility and willingness to spend significant time in the field.
* Experience with cleaning, disinfection, hygiene, biosecurity products or poultry farm operations is preferred.
* Exposure to large animals / ruminants is an added advantage.

**Functional knowledge**

* Good understanding of poultry production, farm biosecurity principles, disease prevention basics, and cleaning/disinfection workflows.
* Ability to learn product chemistry, dilution rates, application methods and safety requirements quickly and accurately.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to engage confidently with farm owners, veterinarians, managers and workers.
* Commercial mindset with ability to convert technical discussions into sales opportunities.
* Valid UAE driving license or willingness to obtain one is preferred.

**Grow with Agthia – For the Better**

Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food & Beverage companies, with a growing international footprint. We are a publicly listed company on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and part of ADQ, one of region’s largest holding companies.

Rooted in Abu Dhabi since 1978, we've grown into a global presence, operating in countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Turkey, and Jordan. We’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market-leading brands across Water & Food, Snacking, Protein & Frozen, and Agri-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world-first products, setting new benchmarks in industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.

Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”

Join us and be part of a team that's not just shaping the future of food and beverage but also making a meaningful impact on the world. Together, let's grow 'For the Better.'

Established in 1977, Arabian Ethicals takes pride in being a top healthcare player in the UAE. As the exclusive representative and distributor of many multinational pharmaceutical, consumer, and veterinary products in the UAE, the Company serves over 2,000 pharmacies, 150 hospitals, 600 hypermarkets, supermarkets and specialty stores, in addition to more than 100 veterinary clinics and farms.
  
  
**Job Description**
To drive the successful launch, promotion, and growth of a new hematology product by executing effective territory plans, developing strong relationships with healthcare professionals, and delivering high-quality scientific product communication. The Product Specialist will contribute to achieving sales objectives, expanding product awareness, supporting market access initiatives, and improving patient care through appropriate product adoption.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
**New Product Launch & Sales Execution**

* Execute territory launch plans and promotional activities in alignment with company objectives and brand strategy.
* Identify and prioritize key hematologists, hospitals, and healthcare institutions to maximize product awareness and adoption.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and launch objectives through effective territory management and customer engagement.
* Identify market opportunities, competitive activities, and barriers to product uptake, providing timely feedback to management.
* Monitor territory performance and collaborate with the Sales Manager to implement corrective actions when required.

**Territory & Key Account Management**

* Develop and implement territory Plans of Action (POA) and key account plans in collaboration with the Sales Manager.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with hematologists, clinical pharmacists, and relevant hospital stakeholders.
* Understand customer needs, hospital treatment protocols, formulary processes, and patient pathways.
* Support hospital product listing and availability through coordination with relevant internal departments.
* Ensure effective territory coverage and timely follow-up on customer commitments.

**Scientific Product Promotion**

* Develop strong knowledge of hematology diseases, treatment guidelines, product clinical data, and the competitive landscape.
* Deliver accurate, evidence-based product presentations highlighting approved indications, efficacy, safety, and clinical value.

**Title:**
Senior Sales Representative

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

**Overview**
The Technical Sales Representative – Farm Solutions will support the growth of Agrivita’s Farm Solutions portfolio, starting with Biosecurity Solutions, by creating demand at Small Poultry farms (SPF), Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries and Slaughterhouses’ channels, conducting structured customer visits, demonstrating correct product application, and converting technical needs into sustainable sales. The role requires a young, high-potential profile with strong learning agility, poultry technical grounding, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to build trust with farm owners, veterinarians, production managers, and farm teams. Exposure to large animals is an added advantage.
  
  
**How Will You Make An Impact?**
**Sales Operations**

* Demand Generation: Promote Agrivita Farm Solutions, with immediate focus on Biosecurity Solutions, across poultry farms, SPF, Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries, Slaughterhouses and relevant retail/outlet customers.
* Poultry Technical Support: Provide first-line technical guidance on cleaning and disinfection programs, biosecurity routines, product selection, dilution, application method, and safe handling in line with approved labels and company guidance.
* Customer Development: Identify and qualify new farm opportunities, build strong relationships with owners, veterinarians, farm managers and production teams, and follow up consistently to convert interest into orders.
* Farm Visits & Demonstrations: Conduct regular face-to-face visits, product demonstrations, farm walk-throughs and post-visit follow-ups to reinforce correct usage and value creation.
* Technical Learning & Product Mastery: Rapidly build and maintain strong knowledge of the Farm Solutions portfolio, poultry production basics, disease pressure drivers, and competitive offerings.
* Sales Execution: Support achievement of sales, volume and margin targets through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, order follow-up and coordination with customer service and supply chain.
* Market Intelligence: Capture customer feedback, competitor activity, pricing insights, product performance observations and unmet needs, and share them through structured reports.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, marketing, technical, QA/lab, customer service and supply chain teams to ensure customer issues are resolved quickly and professionally.
* Large Animal Support: Support large animal Farm Solutions opportunities when required; prior exposure to ruminants/large animals is a plus.

**Special Projects**

* Support new Farm Solutions launches, customer trials, campaign rollouts, training events, and any special projects requested by Agthia leadership.

**MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare accurate and timely visit reports, sales pipeline updates, customer feedback, competitor intelligence, product performance observations and monthly progress summaries in line with Agthia and department requirements.

**Qualifications, Experience & Functional Knowledge**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Poultry Science, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
* Poultry-focused technical education or training is preferred.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in poultry technical sales, animal health, farm biosecurity, farm management, or technical customer support.
* Early-career, high-potential profile with strong learning agility and willingness to spend significant time in the field.
* Experience with cleaning, disinfection, hygiene, biosecurity products or poultry farm operations is preferred.
* Exposure to large animals / ruminants is an added advantage.

**Functional knowledge**

* Good understanding of poultry production, farm biosecurity principles, disease prevention basics, and cleaning/disinfection workflows.
* Ability to learn product chemistry, dilution rates, application methods and safety requirements quickly and accurately.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to engage confidently with farm owners, veterinarians, managers and workers.
* Commercial mindset with ability to convert technical discussions into sales opportunities.
* Valid UAE driving license or willingness to obtain one is preferred.

**Grow with Agthia – For the Better**
Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food & Beverage companies, with a growing international footprint. We are a publicly listed company on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and part of ADQ, one of region’s largest holding companies.
  
  
Rooted in Abu Dhabi since 1978, we've grown into a global presence, operating in countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Turkey, and Jordan. We’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market-leading brands across Water & Food, Snacking, Protein & Frozen, and Agri-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world-first products, setting new benchmarks in industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.
  
  
Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”
  
  
Join us and be part of a team that's not just shaping the future of food and beverage but also making a meaningful impact on the world. Together, let's grow 'For the Better.'

**Job Requirements**
Location: Dubai (UAE) | Remote
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you ready to build your commercial career in a specialised market where animal biosecurity, food safety and hygiene make a real difference?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)**
to support the growth of LANXESS’ Material Protection Products business across the Middle East. You will focus on developing new business, strengthening customer and distributor relationships, and expanding our presence across animal biosecurity and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
The portfolio includes
**speciality biocides, disinfectants, hygiene solutions and preservation technologies**
used across animal production, poultry, dairy, livestock, food processing, beverage manufacturing and related industrial hygiene markets.
  
  
This is a commercially focused role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, spotting opportunities and developing business across different markets and cultures. You will work with customers, distributors, and internal technical, regulatory, and marketing colleagues while building your knowledge of the region and our applications.
  
  
The position is based in Dubai and covers the wider Middle East region.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop new business across the Middle East, identifying opportunities in animal biosecurity, poultry, livestock, dairy, food processing, beverage production and related markets.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, regional producers, multinational companies, distributors, consultants and other industry partners.

* Help develop country and customer growth plans and maintain a healthy pipeline of commercial opportunities.

* Support existing customers through technical selling, product qualification, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Work closely with technical experts to support customer evaluations and deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with regulatory, marketing and technical colleagues on product registrations, approvals and market-access activities.
* Monitor customer needs, market trends, competitors and regulatory developments, and turn those insights into commercial opportunities.
* Maintain sales forecasts, opportunities, customer visit reports and relevant market intelligence through CRM and IBP processes.
* Represent LANXESS at relevant exhibitions, conferences, trade associations and technical seminars.
* Support new product introductions and take commercial projects from initial opportunity through to commercialisation.
* Travel regularly across the Middle East to meet customers, distributors and other business partners.

**Work Experience**
We are looking for someone early in their commercial career who combines business drive with an interest in technical products and customer applications.
  
  
**Ideally, You Have**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Chemical Engineering or another relevant discipline.
* Relevant B2B sales or business development experience. Because this is a junior position, we can consider profiles with approximately 1–2 years of experience, provided they have strong sector exposure or directly transferable experience.
* Commercial exposure to at least one relevant area, such as animal biosecurity, animal health, poultry, livestock, dairy, veterinary hygiene, food processing, beverage production, food safety, sanitation, hygiene/disinfection or related technical solutions.

* Strong communication, relationship-building and commercial skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across an international organisation.
* Fluent English and Arabic for professional customer interaction.

**Important Eligibility Requirement**
Candidates must already be living in Dubai and have the legal right to live and work in the UAE without requiring a new visa or work-permit sponsorship for this application.
  
  
**Benefits**
This opportunity lets you develop your sales career in a regional, customer-facing role covering the Middle East, working with an international speciality-chemicals business and a technically differentiated portfolio spanning animal biosecurity, hygiene, and Food & Beverage applications.

**Job Description**
Provide individualized medical nutrition therapy (MNT) through a multi-disciplinary approach for inpatients and or outpatients in Health Care Facilities / Homecare/ Kidney Care and or Ambulatory Healthcare Services.
  
  
MNT is implemented according to the American Dietetic Association (ADA) Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which provides a framework for the Clinical Dietitians to individualize care, taking into account the patient’s needs and values and using the best scientific evidence available to make decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Encourages teamwork by creating an environment of empowerment and accountability
  
  
May supervise and liaise with Food Service related to therapeutic diets, therapeutic projects and education on therapeutic diets
  
  
Implements Departmental standards of practice
  
  
Able to utilize marketing techniques and participation in revenue generation, where appropriate
  
  
May be responsible in maintaining sufficient inventory of nutrition consumable items, general material management and equipment required for patient care and performance of duties
  
  
Responsible for Medical Nutrition Therapy and thus assess patients using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which is a systematic approach to providing high-quality nutrition care. The NCP consists of four distinct, interrelated steps: Nutrition Assessment, Nutrition Diagnosis, Nutrition Intervention, and Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation.
  
  
Responsible to individualize and evaluate care and service processes within organization systems specific to the discipline of nutrition and dietetics.
  
  
Documenting a comprehensive assessment for all consulted and referred patients as per facility policies and procedures.
  
  
Discuss and/or refer complex cases to Senior Dietitians/Supervisor for guidance to ensure high-quality evidence based nutrition care.
  
  
Responsible to update nutritional standards of care and procedures for the facility and to promote evidence based guidelines.
  
  
Being an active member of a nutrition practice group / association for the areas of work concentration.
  
  
Liaising with ward and food service management and staff concerning nutritional care plan, goals and dietary requirements of inpatients on a daily basis
  
  
May liase with Food Service on preparation of therapeutic diets, ordering appropriate menus and additional/alternative food products for individual patients
  
  
Communicating complex sensitive information in an understandable form to patients, carers, medical, nursing and food service using negotiation, counseling and behavioral change skills. This will frequently involve clients/carers who have complex emotional, physical and psychological problems
  
  
Communicating goals and progress of nutritional care plan to referring health care professionals by writing in medical case notes, file where applicable, letter to medical practitioner or verbal communication
  
  
Plan and organize provision of Nutritional items for patients being discharged on enteral (tube) feeding. May liaise with Long Term Facilities and their healthcare team to communicate nutritional plan of care.
  
  
Follow the Department of Health Abu Dhabi’s Standards of Practice
  
  
Clinical Dietitian are required to maintain Registration/license as required by the Department of Health Abu Dhabi
  
  
Demonstrates accountability for the proper use of patients’ protected health information
  
  
Research should be evidence based medicine, clinical research on human subjects within the realm of: national laws, international and local standards and guidelines, and accreditation standard requirement, by adopting the highest ethical and human subject protection criteria.
  
  
Conducting research must comply with the guidelines of local regulatory bodies such as Department of Health, Abu Dhabi.
  
  
Prepare and participate in accreditation activities. Identifying opportunities for improvement Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place
  
  
Follow facility approved reference guidelines or follow the Academy of Nutrition, ASPEN and ESPEN nutritional guidelines
  
  
Participate in Facility Quality Improvement Projects
  
  
Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for nutrition diagnosis, nutrition assessment, intervention, monitoring and evaluation to explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status
  
  
Able to establish rapport with clients/patients or groups when conducting nutrition education in an environment that enhances nutrition education outcomes
  
  
Planning and delivering training and education sessions for facility and department staff
  
  
Acting as a preceptor of dietetics or other students. Instructing and training dietetic interns, when applicable
  
  
Developing and presenting seminars or lectures for health professionals or students
  
  
Participating in departmental education projects and presentations annually
  
  
Writing, preparing and reviewing new nutrition education material
  
  
Utilizing varied techniques to educate patients regarding nutrition goals
  
  
**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BSc degree in Nutrition & Dietetics from an accredited

program
  
  

* AND Current National license

MSc in relevant clinical field (will reduce 1 year from the

jobs.description:
**Position: AMET Public Affairs Lead**
**Reporting to: AMET GM**
**Location: UAE or Turkey**
*Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.*
*Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.*
*At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.*
*Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.*
*Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at*
*www.opella.com.*
**Job Purpose**

* Opella is looking to recruit a seasoned public affairs & policy lead for their business in Africa. This role is designed to achieve Consumer Healthcare business objectives and growth ambitions by shaping the external public policy environment to support Self Care and ensuring business strategy is informed by a clear understanding of the external policy environment, as well as stakeholders’ needs and expectations.
* This role is vital to shape the external policy and operating environment in support of Self Care, conducive to grow the Opella Consumer Healthcare business in the AMET Zone (Africa Middle East and Turkey).
* The role will require a strong government affairs experience with a track record of success in public policy advocacy with the agility to navigate the complex policy, regulatory, and business environment. The candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of the continent’s landscape complexity and is able to provide clear guidance and strategic counsel to the Opella business in support of its growth ambitions in AMET - Africa Middle East & Turkey.
* Finally, the role will involve strengthening our participation in the regional industry association (MENAP-SMI), as well as those local trade associations in the key markets to support the Opella growth ambitions.

**Key Results/Accountabilities**

* The primary objective of this role is to establish and execute a robust public affairs & policy strategy and action plan aimed to grow the CHC business in AMET.
* Identify key policy priorities and levers to support business growth, provide a robust analysis of the self care policy and operating environment in AMET.
* Regularly inform the AMET GM, the Global Public Affairs Head and other relevant CHC business leaders/partners (i.e., CHC Commercial/Categories, Regulatory Affairs) to ensure seamless understanding and alignment on issues and topics.
* Anticipate public affairs & policy trends and competitive dynamics (i.e., self care, e-commerce, pharmacy channel, etc.) that represent opportunities or threats to the business; and build a clear plan of action to leverage the opportunities or mitigate threats to Opella's reputation and to the business.
* Monitor external developments and effectively communicate potential threats or opportunities to the AMET GM and the Global Public Affairs Head, and CHC business leaders/partners.
* Lead in proposing CHC positions on key issues affecting the CHC business and industry in AMET– in alignment with the AMET Zone GM, relevant counterpart CHC functions and the Global Public Affairs – and develop position papers/statements to advocate with policy makers and other key external audiences, ensuring internal sign-off prior to engagement.
* Strengthen engagement with key external stakeholders, and foster new ones, given the evolving policy environment around Self Care.
* Lead and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams ensuring that business risk is mitigated, and opportunities are swiftly identified and successfully executed.
* Develop scenarios and risk mitigation plans, which reflect a thorough understanding of the policy, government decision-making processes, decision-makers, and influencers, and provide recommendations and solutions to the CHC business
* Gain a clear understanding of Sanofi’s Consumer Healthcare strategy for growth and contribute to the formulation of such strategies.
* Remain current and alert on relevant industry changes (activities likely to include monitoring trade journals and press releases (in collaboration with the Communications team), networking with agenda-setting institutions like WHO and the African Union, venture capital firms and companies, and attending conferences to learn about and monitor new business development opportunities).

**KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

* The position holder will be a key member of the extended leadership team of AMET.
* Strong interactions with relevant functions in the AMET Zone including e.g. digital, marketing/categories, regulatory, finance, medical, communications, among others.
* Strong partnership and collaboration with the AMET Science Head and AMET Communications Lead.
* A wide-ranging network of external stakeholders to manage in the AMET healthcare ecosystem, including establishing a strong presence in our industry associations in both the regional (MENAP-SMI) and priority countries to drive the Opella agenda.
* Selection, direction, and oversight over third party agencies, firms, and/or consultants to support this role in accomplishing its objectives
* See list below for key working relationships:

**AMET GM and leadership team**

* Country Heads and leadership team (key countries supported)
* Global Public Affairs team
* Communications counterparts
* Science counterparts

**Skills, Experience & Knowledge Requirements**

* A high-calibre professional with comprehensive working experience in the public affairs, policy, and market access space (at least 8-10 years) and track record of success delivering on shaping the external environment to address business objectives; broad cross functional understanding & general knowledge of the pharmaceutical business is preferred; knowledge and experience in the field of Consumer Healthcare/FMCG a plus
* Solid experience navigating the AMET Zone healthcare ecosystem, preferably with strong existing network, having past experience proactively dealing with government ministries that have oversight on health policy, public health, reimbursement, finance, among others.
* Proven track record of successful initiatives in public affairs, market access/development, innovative reputation-building, and stakeholder engagement is required. Experience conceiving programs that join diverse stakeholders to deliver on a common public interest is an asset.
* Experience working in highly regulated environment and a demonstrated understanding of AMET's various national, provincial/regional health authorities, including experience dealing with World Health Organization Regional Office for Africa; knowledge/familiarity of New Partnership for Africa’s Development (NEPAD), the African Medicines Regulatory Harmonization (AMRH) initiative, and the African Continental Free Trade Area are a plus.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to understand consumer needs and business transformations to create new business opportunities to build CHC’s business in the AMET Zone.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment and driving results through influence is required, but with a Compliance-first mindset.
* Ability to work under a multi-country accountability, with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and matrix environment, demonstrate flexibility and superior organizational, analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Results-oriented with strong cross-functional collaboration mindset.
* Exercise a high level of independent judgment even in challenging, complex situations is required.
* Demon

**Job Summary**
This role focuses on delivering high quality support and analysis for healthcare products within commercial claims operations in a day shift office environment. The specialist will apply domain expertise to interpret claims resolve issues and improve processing efficiency while ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory expectations. Contributions will strengthen organizational performance and promote better outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze commercial healthcare claims data in detail to ensure accurate adjudication and compliance with internal policies and industry regulations driving reliable claim outcomes and operational integrity.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to clarify claim requirements product rules and benefit structures helping to minimize processing errors and improve end user satisfaction.
* Review complex healthcare product configurations related to commercial claims identifying gaps or inconsistencies and recommending adjustments that enhance claim accuracy and turnaround times.
* Coordinate with operations and quality teams to investigate claim discrepancies document root causes and support remediation activities that reduce rework and improve service levels.
* Utilize claim processing tools and internal platforms to validate eligibility coverage and pricing logic for healthcare products contributing to transparent and fair claim decisions.
* Support process improvement initiatives by tracking key metrics for commercial claims proposing practical changes that improve efficiency reduce manual effort and support sustainable growth.
* Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders using English read write and speak capabilities to explain claim outcomes product rules and process changes in an accessible and professional manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of claim analysis activities decisions and exceptions ensuring that records support audit readiness and consistent application of healthcare product guidelines.
* Engage in knowledge sharing sessions with peers to exchange insights on commercial claims scenarios emerging product features and best practices that strengthen team capability.
* Monitor day to day claim queues in the office environment prioritize work based on service commitments and ensure timely resolution of cases without requiring travel.
* Apply sound judgment to escalate complex claim issues involving healthcare products enabling quick resolution by specialized teams and protecting member and client interests.
* Support compliance with organizational standards by following established procedures validating data integrity and raising risks or anomalies that could impact claim reliability or regulatory adherence.
* Contribute to broader organizational and societal impact by helping ensure that commercial healthcare claims are processed accurately supporting fair access to healthcare services and reinforcing trust in the healthcare system.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid experience in healthcare products with practical exposure to product rules benefit structures and claim processing flows within commercial environments.
* Possess mandatory domain experience in commercial claims with hands on involvement in evaluating claim eligibility coverage determination and payment decisions.
* Bring between two and four years of professional experience in healthcare claims or related operations showing consistent performance and growing subject matter expertise.
* Use strong English read write and speak skills to articulate complex claim and product information clearly to colleagues and stakeholders across business functions.
* Show proficiency in using claim processing platforms and basic analytical tools to interpret data identify patterns and support continuous improvement of claims workflows.
* Exhibit attention to detail and structured thinking while reviewing claims enabling accurate decisions that support company objectives and positive outcomes for members and providers.

**Certifications Required**
Certified Professional Coder CPC or equivalent healthcare claims certification preferred but not mandatory.

Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented Payment Posting Specialist with 2+ years of experience in RCM to join our team. You'll work at the intersection of traditional claim submission or payment posting workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers submit claims accurately and efficiently while ensuring our automation systems perform at the highest standard.
  
  
You'll be responsible for entering charges, verifying claim accuracy, managing charge submissions to insurance companies, and tracking claims through posting and adjudication. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities—this is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Post payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs, EOBs, and lockbox files into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms
* Balance daily batches, reconcile to bank deposits, and resolve missing or mismatched ERAs
* Flag underpayments and denials
* Resolve unapplied cash, credit balances, refunds, and recoupments, and transfer balances

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong working knowledge of medical coding
* Experience with leading PM systems, including eCW, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more
* Solid understanding of insurance claim submission requirements and pre-authorization processes
* Ability to identify coding errors and clinical editing issues before claim submission
* Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through
* Ability to work US hours (9am–6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Perks & Benefits
  
  

* Competitive compensation with eligibility for a bonus on anniversary date
* Paid sick days and vacation days
* Meal stipends
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company and be an early member of a global billing team, as we expand our billing team in India

Our Hiring Promise: A safe, transparent process

**Our Values**

* Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.
* Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.
* Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here:*
*Report a Hiring Concern*
