jobs.title: Fraud Senior Analyst –Payment Integrity Provider Investigation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
The Fraud Senior Analyst plays a critical role in protecting the organization’s International Health portfolio by leading Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) investigations, driving measurable affordability outcomes, and strengthening prevention strategies across the claims lifecycle. The position combines investigative expertise, data-driven insight, and stakeholder influence to reduce financial leakage, improve claim governance and support sustainable savings delivery across the region. This role is responsible for detecting and recovering FWA payments, creating solutions to prevent claims overpayment and future spend monitoring within a dedicated region. He / She will work closely with other PI team members, Network, Medical Economics, Data Analytics, Claims Operations, Clinical partners, and Product.
  
  
**Job Profile**
Operating with a high degree of independence, the Fraud Senior Analyst owns end-to-end investigative activities within a dedicated region. The role extends beyond case handling to include proactive identification of systemic risks, development of preventive controls, and partnership with regional and global stakeholders to enhance Payment Integrity strategy. The incumbent acts as a subject matter expert, contributing to operational improvements, automation initiatives, and cross-market collaboration to strengthen FWA detection and mitigation capabilities.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Fraud Manager
  
  
**Critical Tasks And Expected Contributions / Results**

* Lead FWA investigations across International Markets, applying investigative judgement to identify billing anomalies, emerging fraud typologies, and systemic risk patterns.
* Deliver quantifiable financial impact through cost containment, recoveries, and forward-looking prevention initiatives aligned to regional savings objectives.
* Translate data insights into actionable investigation strategies by partnering closely with Data and Analytics teams to refine triggers, reporting frameworks and automation opportunities.
* Influence provider behavior through structured Provider audit engagement, negotiation, and collaboration with regional and global stakeholders to reduce future risk exposure.
* Drive continuous improvement of Payment Integrity processes by identifying operational gaps and proposing scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Produce clear, defensible investigative findings and recommendations for senior stakeholders, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
* Ensure investigations and cost containment actions are balanced with fair member outcomes, regulatory expectations, and client commitments.
* Collaborate with Customer Service and Client Management teams to support clear, consistent communication approaches that protect member experience while maintaining investigative integrity
* Operate within established governance frameworks, ensuring investigative activities are compliant with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
* Collaborate with the Member Investigation Unit on Fraud cases when required.
* Perform periodic TPA oversight and partner with TPAs on FWA investigations when required.
* Partner with Data Analytics team in building future FWA triggers automation.
* Mentor and provide support through knowledge sharing, quality review input and guidance on investigative best practices and share FWA claiming schemes.
* Ad hoc duties as assigned

**Key Challenges / Anticipated Changes In Environment**

* Rapid evolution of provider billing models and fraud schemes requiring adaptive investigative approaches.
* Increasing claim volumes and evolving FWA typologies requiring advanced analytical and investigative skills
* Balancing operational turnaround times with deep investigative rigor, stakeholder expectations and member experience considerations
* Expanding use of automation, data analytics, and cross-market collaboration within Payment Integrity operations
* Managing complex provider relationships while maintaining firm compliance and cost containment positions

jobs.title: Medical Records Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Medical records & billing analyst**
with practical experience reading and interpreting medical documentation and billing records from the United States and/or Germany.

Healthcare billing remains surprisingly manual. A single patient case can generate hundreds of pages of documentation from hospitals, clinics, specialists, laboratories, imaging providers and other healthcare organizations. Much of this information still arrives as PDFs, scans, faxes or paper documents rather than through clean, structured data interfaces.

Large billing operations may employ hundreds of people to manually review these documents, identify the relevant medical and financial information, classify it and transform it into structured billing data.

We believe this workflow is particularly well suited to
**AI-assisted automation**
, but building reliable automation requires people who understand what the documents actually mean.

This role sits at the intersection of
**medical documentation, billing operations, data quality and AI**
.

**What you would do**

You will work with medical records and billing documentation from healthcare providers in the
**United States and Germany**
, including hospitals, clinics, physicians and specialists.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Review large medical records, including cases containing hundreds of pages of clinical and billing documentation.
* Read and interpret hospital bills, physician bills, treatment records, discharge documentation, diagnostic reports and related medical documentation.
* Identify treatments, procedures, diagnoses, services, providers, dates, charges and other relevant information contained across multiple documents.
* Understand how information in clinical documentation relates to the corresponding billing information.
* Convert unstructured information from PDFs, scans and other documents into structured data.
* Detect missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate entries and potential billing discrepancies.
* Compare medical records and invoices to determine whether the documentation supports the billed services.
* Review data extracted automatically by AI systems and determine whether the results are correct.
* Identify recurring document structures and patterns that can be automated.
* Define rules, examples and edge cases that help our technical team improve document-processing and AI models.
* Create and maintain structured reference examples and validation datasets.
* Work with developers and AI specialists to test new extraction and classification workflows.
* Investigate cases where automated processing fails and explain why.
* Help design quality-control processes that allow AI-assisted workflows to operate reliably at scale.

**US medical billing knowledge**

For US documentation, relevant experience may include working with areas such as:

* Hospital and physician billing
* Itemized medical bills
* Explanation of Benefits documentation
* Medical coding and claims documentation
* ICD diagnosis information
* CPT and HCPCS procedure information
* Facility and professional charges
* Provider documentation
* Insurance claims and billing workflows

You do not necessarily need to be a certified medical coder, but you should be comfortable navigating complex medical and billing records and understanding how the different documents relate to one another.

**German medical billing knowledge**

For German documentation, relevant experience may include:

* Krankenhausrechnungen
* Arzt- und Facharztrechnungen
* Ambulante und stationäre Behandlungsunterlagen
* Entlassungsberichte
* Leistungsnachweise
* Diagnosen und Prozeduren
* GOÄ / GOZ billing
* EBM-related documentation
* DRG-related hospital documentation
* ICD-10-GM and OPS information
* Private and statutory healthcare billing processes

Experience does not need to cover every billing system. Deep practical knowledge of either the German or US healthcare billing environment is valuable.

**What we are looking for**

You could come from a number of professional backgrounds, including:

* Medical billing
* Medical coding
* Hospital billing departments
* Medical claims processing
* Healthcare administration
* Revenue cycle management
* Medical documentation
* Health insurance claims
* Medical auditing
* Clinical documentation review

The most important requirement is that you have
**hands-on experience working with real medical records and can confidently interpret complex documentation**
.

You should also:

* Be highly detail-oriented.
* Be comfortable reviewing large volumes of documents.
* Be able to identify relevant information quickly within long patient files.
* Understand that medical documentation is often incomplete, inconsistent or poorly structured.
* Be comfortable making structured decisions based on defined rules.
* Be able to explain why a particular extraction or classification is correct or incorrect.
* Be interested in technology and AI.
* Be comfortable working closely with technical teams.
* Have strong written English and/or German skills.

**Particularly valuable experience**

Experience in any of the following areas would be especially useful:

* Reviewing medical records for billing companies
* Medical bill auditing
* Revenue cycle management
* Coding quality assurance
* Claims review
* Insurance or reimbursement analysis
* Medical-legal record review
* Training or supervising medical billing teams
* Building SOPs for medical-document processing
* Working with OCR, document-processing or AI-assisted healthcare software

**The opportunity**

This is not simply a role for manually processing medical bills.

The objective is to take workflows that today require large teams of people reading documents page by page and determine how they can be transformed into a combination of:

**AI extraction → automated classification → structured validation → human review of exceptions**

The analyst plays a critical role in that process.

You bring the domain knowledge required to understand what the AI should extract, where mistakes typically occur, which decisions can be automated safely and where human judgment is still required.

Over time, the role can develop from reviewing individual cases into helping design the
**medical billing intelligence and quality-control systems**
that process them.

**Location**

Remote.

Candidates with experience in either the United States or German healthcare system are encouraged to apply. Experience across both systems is particularly valuable.

We are looking for a seasoned finance leader to join our Global Capability Hub (GCH) in Bangalore as Head of GCH Management Accounting (Director level). * Management Accounting & Close Leadership: Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close performance (timetable, quality, cycle time) across EMEA and ANZ entities. Oversee journals, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and consolidation submissions to Group Reporting and FP&A.

* Bangalore GCC Transformation & AI Adoption: Evolve the Bangalore GCH from task execution to end-to-end accounting ownership. Spearhead automation (close orchestration, reconciliation tools) and deploy AI-enabled capabilities (anomaly detection, automated variance commentary).

**Candidate Profile & Requirements:**

* Qualification: Fully qualified accountant - Chartered Accountant (ICAI), ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

* GCC Experience: Proven track record of leading distributed/shared-service finance teams (managing managers) within an India-based GCC/GCH setup.

jobs.title: Repair Engineer
jobs.description:
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITY:**

* Develop new cleaning, inspection & repairs for commercial engine components by utilizing conventional or innovative repair techniques.
* Evaluate engine component damages reported by customer/airline to develop cleaning, inspection & repair schemes and coordinate with engine manufactures for timely approvals.
* Evaluating the cost advantage between repairing a part & buying a new part and ensuring cost savings for airline customer.
* Developing new or revising technical data on engine components.
* Evaluating service bulletins (SB), Airworthiness Directives (AD), etc issued by aircraft/engine manufactures.
* Creating Substantiation Memo documents and Instructions for Continued Airworthiness (ICA’s) in accordance with FAA code of federal regulations for applicable repair scheme.
* Co-ordination with other disciplines like IPT leads, Structures, Design, Metallurgy, Standard Practices and Customer Technical Support in evaluating the CIR technical data.

* 3- 7 Years of experience in customer technical services or repair development engineering
* A good team player, people leader who can work well under pressure or in stressful and demanding situations or environments.
* Well aware of Aircraft /Aero Engine components and functional details along with their operation procedures.
* Good at understanding in various processes (e.g Machining, Thermal spray coating/plating, Welding, Paint, NDT & Cleaning) & Engineering drawings.
* Having good knowledge on GD&T and ASME Y14.5 1994 standards.
* Effective communicator and should have the ability to lead client discussions with all stakeholders on Technical subject related and take decisions accordingly.

* Ability to train, mentor and control the new joiners in the team.

Worked with Aero Engine OEM (RR or GE)

jobs.title: Content Platform & Services Manager
jobs.description:
**Content Platform & Services Manager**

  

**About ZS**

ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.

  

**About the Role**

ZS seeks a Content Platform & Services Manager to join our team in Bengaluru, India. This role will own end-to-end content operations for marketing and promotional materials and Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review workflows. The position sits at the intersection of content production and compliance process management, ensuring that content moves efficiently and compliantly from creation through approval to publication and archival.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing content lifecycle platforms, such as Veeva Vault PromoMats or an equivalent platform, in a regulated industry and is comfortable partnering with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and Regulatory stakeholders to keep review cycles on track. The role will also lead the evaluation, build, and rollout of AI-based accelerators, such as automated tagging, claims and reference checking, and pre-MLR quality screening, that reduce manual effort and accelerate review cycles.

We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management, ideally within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industries. A bachelors degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field is required; an MBA is preferred.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Own content operations.** Manage intake, tagging and metadata, routing, review coordination, approval, publishing, and archival of promotional and non-promotional materials.
* **Manage MLR reviews.** Schedule review cycles, track reviewer comments and claims, ensure timely turnaround, and maintain complete audit trails.
* **Administer the platform.** Optimize Veeva Vault PromoMats or similar DAM/CLM systems, including user access, workflows, and metadata taxonomy.
* **Enable review-ready content.** Partner with Brand and Marketing teams to plan content pipelines and ensure correct references, claims substantiation, and formatting.
* **Coordinate cross-functionally.** Work with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance reviewers to resolve bottlenecks and maintain SLA adherence.
* **Maintain compliance.** Ensure content meets internal standards, brand guidelines, and applicable pharmaceutical marketing and regulatory requirements prior to release.
* **Govern the content lifecycle.** Maintain accurate records of approved content, expiry and renewal dates, and withdrawal of outdated materials.
* **Improve operations.** Identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement across workflows, templates, and SOPs.
* **Report performance.** Create leadership dashboards covering review cycle time, throughput, bottlenecks, and compliance metrics.
* **Build capability.** Train internal stakeholders and agency partners on platform usage and MLR submission best practices.
* **Shape AI use cases.** Identify opportunities in metadata tagging, claims and reference validation, pre-review compliance checks, content reuse, and modular content, and build business cases.
* **Deliver AI accelerators.** Lead requirements, pilots, testing, output validation against MLR standards, and impact measurement with Technology, Data, and vendor partners.
* **Establish AI governance.** Set validation, human-in-the-loop, auditability, and compliance guardrails for AI-assisted content workflows.
* **Integrate and scale AI.** Evaluate Veeva AI features, GenAI tools, and workflow automation, and lead stakeholder and agency adoption.

  

**What You'll Bring**

* **Content operations expertise.** 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* **Platform experience.** Hands-on experience with content lifecycle or DAM platforms such as Veeva Vault PromoMats, Aprimo, or similar systems.
* **MLR knowledge.** Working knowledge of MLR review processes and regulatory and compliance requirements for promotional materials.
* **AI and automation delivery.** Demonstrated experience building, piloting, or testing AI/GenAI accelerators or automation solutions, including defining success metrics and validating outputs.
* **Technical partnership.** Ability to convert operational pain points into AI and automation requirements and work effectively with technical teams through delivery.
* **Modular content.** Experience with content reuse and modular content strategies enabled by AI.
* **Stakeholder leadership.** Ability to coordinate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Technology, Data, and agency partners.
* **Operational discipline.** Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage concurrent review cycles and deadlines.
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field; MBA preferred.

  

**Preferred Experience**

* **Industry background.** Prior experience at a pharmaceutical company or healthcare-focused marketing or content services organization.
* **Content governance.** Familiarity with taxonomy, metadata standards, and digital asset management best practices.
* **Process improvement.** Experience driving automation or continuous improvement within content operations.
* **Reporting tools.** Exposure to Power BI or Tableau for operational reporting and dashboards.
* **GenAI tools.** Hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM tools, prompt design, or low-code automation applied to content or compliance workflows.
* **Responsible AI.** Understanding of validation, auditability, data privacy, and responsible AI in regulated industries.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Faster, more predictable review cycles with improved throughput and sustained SLA adherence.
* Accurate, compliant, and audit-ready content across the complete lifecycle.
* Measurable reduction in manual effort through validated AI accelerators and workflow automation.
* Strong adoption of content platforms, MLR best practices, and AI-enabled ways of working across internal and agency teams.
* Clear operational visibility through reliable metrics on cycle time, bottlenecks, throughput, quality, and compliance.

  

**Why Join ZS**

At ZS, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of AI-enabled content operations while working alongside world-class consultants, technologists, data experts, and business leaders. You will help translate emerging technologies into compliant, scalable workflows that improve speed, quality, and impact across the content lifecycle.

Senior Associate, Promotional Materials, **Cardiovascular**

  
  

**Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.

  
  

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas - Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease - we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

  
  

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Role summary**

  
  

The Senior Associate, Marketing Operations and Promotional Materials will coordinate Repatha label update implementation, maintain the evergreen claims workbook and support personal promotion materials across Cardiovascular Business Unit teams. The role will maintain asset inventories and field resource guides and coordinate print inventory and physical material production with agencies and vendors.

Working with U.S. brand, field, agency and medical, legal and regulatory teams, the individual will track approved updates from intake through implementation, maintain source traceability and coordinate material availability. Medical, legal and regulatory partners retain responsibility for label interpretation, claim substantiation and approval.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**

  
  

**Label update implementation and asset control**

Maintain the implementation plan for approved label changes, including affected assets, owners, milestones, review status and deployment dates. Confirm the affected asset inventory and required actions with brand and review owners.

Coordinate updates across web, email, field, patient and other relevant materials. Track dependencies, follow up on outstanding reviews and escalate timing, source and approval questions to accountable owners.

Coordinate agency revisions, review routing and implementation handoffs. Maintain accurate asset inventories and version history and identify materials requiring replacement or retirement.

Check final versions against documented update instructions, coordinate replacement of superseded materials and retain evidence of completion in approved systems.

Provide implementation status and closeout reports, track overdue actions and recurring issues and recommend improvements to review and asset management workflows.

  
  

**Evergreen claims workbook**

Maintain approved claim wording, source references, usage status, version information and review dates provided by accountable owners.

Update records from approved materials and documented decisions and flag incomplete or conflicting entries for resolution.

Link claims records to relevant promotional materials and source documents to maintain traceability across updates.

Record owner decisions, approved revisions and applicable usage guidance so workbook entries reflect the latest approved position.

Maintain a review queue for stale references, unresolved questions and claims records requiring owner confirmation. Coordinate follow up with brand and review partners.

  
  
  

**Personal promotion resources and print management**

Maintain field resource guides for

Maintain personal promotion resource inventories, including current versions, approval status, expiration dates and ordering or access information. Coordinate guide updates when materials change, expire or retire.

Coordinate printouts and physical material production with Tag, SGI and other designated vendors. Confirm approved files, production specifications, quantities and delivery requirements with accountable business owners.

Maintain print inventory records and coordinate stock checks, replenishment requests and distribution with relevant partners. Flag low stock, excess inventory and obsolete materials and coordinate agreed actions.

Coordinate replacement or retirement of printed materials following label or content updates. Track vendor production and delivery status, resolve routine issues and retain print and inventory records.

  
  

**Required qualifications**

Experience coordinating marketing materials, document control or regulated review workflows.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage asset records, timelines and follow up across stakeholders.

Ability to coordinate multiple asset updates and maintain clear ownership, approval status, source traceability and version history.

Ability to coordinate vendor deliverables, maintain resource and inventory records and escalate label, claim and review questions to appropriate subject matter experts.

**Preferred qualifications**

Experience supporting U.S. pharmaceutical label updates, claims documentation or personal promotion materials.

Familiarity with Veeva PromoMats or comparable promotional asset management systems.

Experience maintaining field resource guides, approved claims workbooks or source libraries.

Experience coordinating print production, physical material distribution or inventory management with agencies and vendors.

Experience supporting Repatha, cardiovascular marketing or field sales teams.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Quality Assurance Manager leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the facility's Quality Management System and patient safety programs. The role ensures compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) requirements and international accreditation standards, including Joint Commission International (JCI), and drives a culture of safety and continuous improvement across clinical and non-clinical departments.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer / Medical Director |
**Location:**
Dubai, UAE
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Quality Management System
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System, including annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.
* Maintain controlled policies, procedures, and guidelines with effective document control and version management.
* Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.

Patient Safety and Risk Management
  
  

* Lead patient safety initiatives; monitor incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, and complaints.
* Coordinate incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA); develop and track Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Conduct risk assessments, maintain risk registers, and escalate serious or high-risk findings to senior management.

Audits and Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute annual clinical and operational audits, including medical record, infection prevention and control, medication management, and patient identification audits.
* Develop and monitor KPIs and quality indicators; prepare monthly and quarterly dashboards for senior leadership and committees.
* Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.

Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation
  
  

* Ensure continuous readiness for DHA inspections and other regulatory assessments.
* Oversee preparation for JCI and other accreditation surveys, including mock surveys and gap assessments.
* Monitor changes in UAE healthcare regulations and accreditation standards and implement required changes.
* Liaise with regulators, surveyors, and external auditors.

Continuous Improvement and Leadership
  
  

* Lead quality improvement projects using PDCA/PDSA, Lean, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Chair or coordinate quality and patient safety committees, producing agendas, reports, and action trackers.
* Manage, mentor, and develop the quality team; provide staff training on quality, safety, and accreditation requirements.
* Monitor patient complaints and satisfaction results and lead patient experience initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field from a recognized Western institution (US, UK, Canada, Australia, or EU); Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of healthcare experience, including at least 3 years in a quality, patient safety, or accreditation leadership role.
* Proven experience leading a facility through successful JCI accreditation or re-accreditation.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA regulations and UAE healthcare standards.
* Professional certification preferred: CPHQ, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, or equivalent.
* Eligibility for DHA professional licensing, where applicable.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, and data-driven decision-making.
* Strong knowledge of quality improvement and statistical methodologies.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and lead change.
* Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Quality & Risk (Hospital)
jobs.description:
**Senior Manager Quality & Risk (Hospital) | Dubai, UAE**

**About Us**

Our client is a new premium tertiary hospital in Dubai Healthcare City, opening in 2027. Backed by Scope Investment, it is being developed as an academic medical centre for the region. Advanced gastroenterology is its flagship programme, supported by a growing range of specialist services and centres of excellence. The hospital combines the latest medical technology with an academic approach to care, teaching and research, in a state-of-the-art building with premium design and a seamless digital patient journey. Care is physician-led and organised around the patient, and the hospital is designed to meet JCI standards from day one. Joining us now means helping to shape a new hospital from the ground up and building your career in an academic setting, with teaching, research, and fellowship opportunities alongside clinical practice.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Quality & Risk to establish and lead the Quality, Patient Safety and Risk Management function for our new multi-specialty tertiary hospital in Dubai.

The successful candidate will lead the hospital’s quality governance, regulatory and accreditation readiness, patient safety, clinical risk management, performance improvement, clinical audit and policy management programmes.

This role requires a senior healthcare quality leader with proven UAE hospital experience and hands-on involvement in new hospital commissioning, DHA licensing and inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, go-live and post-opening stabilisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Quality and Risk Management workstream through hospital commissioning, pre-opening, phased activation, go-live and operational stabilization.
* Establish and maintain the hospital-wide Quality Management System, Quality and Patient Safety Plan, governance framework, policies, procedures and reporting mechanisms.
* Lead DHA licensing, inspection and regulatory readiness, including gap assessments, compliance trackers, mock inspections, evidence files and corrective action follow-up.
* Drive JCI accreditation readiness through mock surveys, tracers, standards interpretation, evidence management and closure of identified gaps.
* Lead patient safety and clinical risk programmes, including incident reporting, adverse-event review, near-miss analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and risk registers.
* Develop and manage the hospital’s clinical and operational audit programme, leadership rounds, patient safety rounds and compliance monitoring activities.
* Establish quality indicators, KPIs and dashboards; ensure data validation, trend analysis, executive reporting and timely escalation of significant risks or performance gaps.
* Lead multidisciplinary improvement initiatives using recognised methodologies such as PDCA, PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma and DMAIC.
* Oversee policy development, document control, review cycles, approvals, version control and compliance with approved hospital policies and procedures.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, safety culture and service-quality indicators, and coordinate sustainable improvement actions.
* Build and lead the Quality and Risk team and collaborate closely with Medical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, Infection Prevention and Control, Health Information Management, Facilities, IT, HR and other project stakeholders.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, Allied Health, Quality Management, Public Health or a related healthcare discipline. A relevant Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, clinical governance or risk management, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven UAE hospital experience; direct involvement in commissioning, opening, licensing, or major expansion of a hospital is highly desirable.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA requirements, JCI accreditation standards, patient safety principles, clinical governance and healthcare risk management.
* Demonstrated experience in mock surveys, tracers, clinical audits, incident investigations, RCA, CAPA, risk registers, quality indicators and executive dashboards.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary quality-improvement projects and support organisational change in a complex hospital environment.
* Experience managing quality teams, governance committees, policies, training programmes, departmental budgets and regulatory or accreditation evidence.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CPPS, Lean Six Sigma, Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor or an equivalent healthcare quality or risk credential is preferred.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

**We are particularly interested in healthcare quality leaders who have successfully supported the commissioning and opening of a new hospital in the UAE and can establish the complete Quality and Risk function from the ground up.**

Candidates should demonstrate direct responsibility for DHA inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, Quality Management Systems, patient safety, incident investigation, RCA, CAPA, clinical audits, risk registers, KPIs, dashboards, policy management, and post-opening stabilisation.

**Please note: This position requires extensive hospital Quality and Risk leadership experience. Applicants without relevant hospital experience will not be considered.**

A leading group of medical centers in the UAE needs an experienced RCM Specialist to run the full revenue cycle across its facilities. The specialist will:

**Company Description**

Emirates Electrical & Instrumentation Company LLC.  
For almost 20 years, we have made vital contributions to the Oil & Gas sector of the UAE, executing both onshore and offshore projects. Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) is one of our main clients along with Tier 1 and Tier 2 EPC contractors in this sector. We have the expertise to carry out full EPC&M services for electrical and instrumentation works and bring our intrinsic knowledge to measure and automate exploration, production, separation, refining processes, and distribution through our localized services.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations leads the operational and financial performance of EEIC's EPC projects and service divisions (Maintenance Contracts and Secondment Services), owning the Operations P&L, budgets, forecasts, OPEX, gross profit, cash flow and resources, and ensuring delivery to contract, schedule, HSE, quality and profit targets.

The role protects and improves margins through robust budgeting, monitoring, corrective action, cost optimisation and variation recovery, ensuring forecasts are backed by validated progress, realistic cost-to-complete and quantified risks. It resolves issues within delegated authority and escalates material matters to the General Manager with impact and recommendations.

Leading the Head of Projects, Engineering Manager and Head of Division, and through them Project Managers and teams, the role strengthens leadership, governance and execution standards. It requires a commercially astute EPC professional with contractor-side experience managing multiple projects across planning, engineering, procurement, construction, subcontracting and clients

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Financial, Budget & P&L Management**

* Own the financial performance and P&L of the Operations Department, including the EPC project portfolio and operational service divisions, ensuring achievement of approved revenue, gross profit and profitability targets, and provide the General Manager with timely visibility of material financial deviations, risks and opportunities.
* Lead preparation of the annual Operations Department budget (revenue, gross profit, OPEX, manpower and other cost assumptions), provide reliable operational inputs to the General Manager and Finance for business planning, and control OPEX within approved budgets.
* Lead and challenge individual project budgets following award, ensuring they reflect the approved commercial baseline, execution strategy, resources, procurement and subcontracting strategy, risks and expected profitability, and endorse budgets and revisions in accordance with the Delegation of Authority.
* Review project P&Ls regularly – revenue, actual and committed costs, accruals, cost-to-complete, EAC, gross profit, margin and cash flow – and hold Head of Projects and Project Managers accountable for budget ownership and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts of revenue, cost, GP and cash flow, supported by validated progress, realistic cost-to-complete, contractual entitlements, committed costs and quantified risks and opportunities.
* Identify margin erosion and cost overruns early, establish root causes and drive corrective action, and lead initiatives to protect and improve gross profit – through cost optimisation, productivity, procurement savings, variation recovery and improved execution methods – without compromising HSE, quality, contractual or client requirements.
* Monitor billing, certification, unbilled revenue, receivables and cash collection in coordination with Commercial and Finance, ensuring alignment with physical progress and revenue recognition.
* Ensure operational managers own and validate their financial assumptions, delivery commitments and recovery plans. Finance supports reporting and validation; the Director of Operations remains accountable for operational forecasts and performance commitments.

**Project Delivery & Operational Management**

* Lead and oversee the execution of EEIC's EPC project portfolio from award through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and close-out, in accordance with contractual requirements, approved budgets, baseline schedules, HSE and quality standards.
* Oversee the Maintenance Contracts and Secondment Services divisions, ensuring service levels, manpower utilisation, contract renewals and divisional profitability meet approved targets.
* Ensure appropriate execution strategies, mobilization plans and project management structures are established for newly awarded projects.
* Conduct structured project performance reviews covering progress, schedule, cost, profitability, cash flow, engineering, procurement, construction, subcontracting, resources, commercial matters and key risks, maintaining portfolio-level visibility of status, milestones and priorities.
* Identify underperforming projects early and lead the development and implementation of corrective action and recovery plans.
* Ensure effective coordination between Projects, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Planning & Project Controls, Commercial, Finance, HSE and Quality functions.
* Optimize manpower, equipment and other resources across the project portfolio according to operational priorities.
* Provide visible HSE leadership across all projects and service sites, ensuring HSE plans, resources and performance meet company and client (including ADNOC) requirements.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) Technical Service: Distilling & Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.
  
  
You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
* Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
* Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
* Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
* Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech), Master’s degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
* Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
* Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Senior Manager - R&D
jobs.description:
Senior Manager – Research & Development (R&D)

**Company:** Rajshree Biosolutions LLP  
**Location:** Varadaraj Nagar, Periyakulam Taluk, Theni, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Research & Development  
**Designation:** Senior Manager – R&D  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong R&D professional with excellent leadership capabilities to independently lead and manage the Research & Development function at Rajshree Biosolutions LLP.

The ideal candidate should possess in-depth knowledge of microbial biotechnology, microbiology, fermentation technology, product development and industrial-scale biological manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for independently managing the R&D department, leading the research team, driving innovation, developing commercially viable products and taking complete ownership of R&D operations and deliverables.

Major Responsibilities

**1. Independent R&D Function Leadership**

* Independently lead, manage and take complete ownership of the R&D department.
* Develop R&D strategies, research roadmaps and annual departmental objectives.
* Lead, guide and supervise scientists, research associates and laboratory personnel.
* Take independent technical decisions and resolve complex research and process-related challenges.
* Establish accountability, performance standards and project timelines for the R&D team.
* Report research progress, challenges and achievements to senior management.

**2. Research & Product Development**

* Drive the development of innovative biological products for Agriculture, Aquaculture, Poultry and Industrial Enzyme applications.
* Lead microbial strain screening, identification, characterization and development.
* Develop and optimize microbial formulations, probiotics, biofertilizers, biocontrol agents and other biological products.
* Identify new research opportunities and technologies for business expansion.
* Ensure successful transition of research innovations into commercially viable products.

**3. Microbial Biotechnology & Fermentation**

* Possess strong practical expertise in industrial microbiology and microbial biotechnology.
* Lead submerged fermentation (SmF) and solid-state fermentation (SSF).
* Manage fermentation process optimization, scale-up and technology transfer.
* Optimize microbial growth, yield, productivity and process efficiency.
* Troubleshoot contamination, fermentation failures and production inconsistencies.
* Oversee downstream processing, formulation and product stability.

**4. Technical Excellence & Innovation**

* Develop new technologies and improve existing products and processes.
* Establish research protocols, validation procedures and technical standards.
* Evaluate new scientific developments and implement relevant technologies.
* Establish research collaborations with universities, institutions and external technical experts.
* Drive patentable innovations and scientific publications where commercially and strategically relevant.

**5. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Production, Quality Control, Regulatory and Marketing teams.
* Provide technical support for production-related issues and product performance.
* Ensure effective technology transfer from R&D to manufacturing.
* Support product registration and technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

* M.Sc. / M.Tech. / Ph.D. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Industrial Microbiology, Agricultural Microbiology or relevant life-science disciplines.
* Ph.D. will be an added advantage.

Required Experience

* 10–15 years of relevant experience in R&D within biotechnology, industrial microbiology, microbial products or fermentation-based industries.
* Proven experience in independently leading an R&D department or managing a substantial R&D team.
* Strong hands-on experience in microbial product development and industrial fermentation.
* Demonstrated experience in laboratory-to-industrial-scale technology transfer and product commercialization.
* Experience in Agriculture, Aquaculture, Poultry, Probiotics or Industrial Enzyme sectors will be preferred.

Essential Leadership Competencies

* Strong technical and scientific knowledge.
* Independent decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent team leadership and people-management skills.
* Strategic research planning and execution.
* Ability to take complete departmental ownership.
* Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Result-oriented approach with commercial and business awareness.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with details of their relevant R&D experience to hr@rajshreebio.com / +91 - 7826907618**

* Provident Fund
